rows.title: Junior Commercial Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Our Company

At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The role

Our Commercial Insights team is growing! We're looking for a Junior Commercial Insights Analyst to join our team in London.

In this role you'll own real analysis from day one, turning data from across the business into reporting and recommendations that commercial, marketing, and product teams rely on.

Own a set of dashboards and reports that leaders check every weekWork across BigQuery, SQL, and Tableau on questions that matter commerciallyPartner directly with teams across the business, not behind a request queueGrow fast, with a clear path toward a Commercial Insights Analyst role

Key Responsibilities

Identify and investigate commercial questions across all areas of marketing, commercial, product and technology - and turn the findings into recommendations that drive meaningful outcomesPartner directly with marketing, product, and commercial teams to scope analytical work - you define the brief as much as you respond to itUse data visualisation tools such as Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Tableau, Power BI and Looker with guidance from senior analystsBuild and maintain models that support commercial decisions - channel performance, cohort analysis, and GP forecastingUse AI to accelerate analysis and develop new approaches to problem solving, better and faster analytics and automationWrite and optimise SQL queries against BigQuery to answer commercial questions

About You

Degree in a maths or science based subjectOne to two years of hands-on experience in an analytics or data role, including placements or internshipsAI native. AI is embedded in how you work. You reach for it to accelerate analysis, challenge your thinking, and do in hours what used to take days. You are curious about where the technology is going and are actively developing your skills in it. Working knowledge of SQL and confidence with a BI tool such as Tableau, plus Excel and GA4Commercially curious, keen to understand the why behind the numbers and turn it into recommendationsAble to manage multiple tasks and deliver to deadlines with growing independenceYou thrive when working as part of a teamComfortable in a fast-paced environmentYou communicate findings clearly and with conviction - written and verbal, to technical and non-technical audiences equally. 

What You’ll Get

Private Health Care (Bupa)Hybrid Working (3 days in office)Travel InsuranceCompetitive Base SalaryCompany Bonus SchemePaid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)Market-Leading Training ProgrammeRecognition & Reward SchemeAnnual Company Conference Regular Happy Hours & Team LunchesFree Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

If you like the sound of what we're all about at Quantum and want to join a team where you can make an impact, please apply or contact us at careers@quantum.media.

rows.title: Insights Analyst, FOW
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Derivia Intelligence is a leading provider of specialist data and insights to the global financial services industry. Through its brands Futures & Options World (FOW), Structured Retail Products (SRP) and GlobalCapital (GC), the group delivers mission-critical products that enable clients to navigate complexity and drive performance across some of the most intricate areas of global finance.

About FOW

FOW focuses exclusively on futures and options. FOW enjoys a long history and a strong reputation as a trusted, comprehensive source of futures and options data and market intelligence, helping business drive smarter decision making and trade with confidence. Find out more at www.fow.com

Job Purpose

FOW is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our editorial team.

As Data Analyst, you will be responsible for overseeing and visualising our large, global, futures and options trading volumes database. Working alongside our busy team of editors, you will be called upon to create ad hoc charts appearing in the articles they are producing throughout the day. You will be responsible for producing regular data reports and chartbooks highlighting trends in the futures and options market. With a dotted line to our data team, you will also ensure our data are timely and accurate.

Key Responsibilities

Provide data support to the editorial team.Establish a template for FOW graphics.Produce ad hoc charts to appear in daily editorial articles.Develop a format for, and produce, data reports, dashboards, and visualisations. Create a database of regularly used charts.Oversee the Data Insights section of the FOW website.Identify trends through data analysis.Run error checks to ensure accuracy across our extensive volumes database.

Key Interfaces

Work closely with the Director of Content to ensure data content adheres to editorial standards.Closely collaborate with the editorial team to add a data perspective to their reports.Work with the data team to ensure timely and accurate data. Make suggestions for additional data and improvements where necessary.

Essential

Skills and Experience

Proven experience in a Data Analyst or similar role.Strong proficiency in managing and visualising data in Microsoft Excel.Strong data manipulation skills.Report formatting and production using Microsoft Powerpoint and Word.An excellent eye for detail.Native-level fluency in English, both oral and written.Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.Self-motivated and capable of working independently while also collaborating with colleagues across time zones.

Desirable

Familiarity with using AI platforms for data analysis.SQL, APIs, Python or R competency would be a plus.Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.Ability to suggest new processes and platforms for managing data.Familiarity with financial markets data.A degree or postgraduate qualification in a relevant subject.

rows.title: Insights Analyst, Mobile for Development
rows.descriptionText:
Team: Emerging Tech programme

Location: London, candidates must have right to work in the UK

Position type: 1 year contract (inside IR35)

What The Hiring Manager Says

‘Artificial intelligence is reshaping economies around the world but unlocking its potential in low- and middle-income countries requires robust evidence, practical insights and strong collaboration across the ecosystem. As an Insights Analyst in the EmergingTech programme, you'll join a collaborative team exploring how AI and emerging technologies can drive sustainable development. You'll contribute to research that informs industry, policymakers and donors, while developing your expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of technology and international development. This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys solving complex problems and wants to contribute to research with real-world impact.’

Eugénie Humeau, Senior Insights Manager - EmergingTech

About The Team

GSMA Mobile for Development (M4D) is a dedicated global team within the GSMA, which brings together our mobile operator members, tech innovators, the development community and governments, to prove the power of mobile in emerging markets.

The GSMA EmergingTech programme accelerates sustainable development and climate action by fostering the adoption of AI and emerging technologies in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We work with innovators across the public, private and third sectors to support the development and scaling of inclusive and responsible AI solutions.

About The Role

As an Insights Analyst, you will contribute to the delivery of high-quality research on AI and emerging technologies, helping generate evidence and insights that help address real-world challenges in LMICs. Working alongside a team of researchers and specialists, you'll contribute to every stage of the research process, from evidence gathering and analysis through to stakeholder engagement, publication and dissemination.

You'll help produce research that is rigorous, practical and influential, working with innovators, mobile operators, governments, researchers and development partners. Whether contributing to reports, analysing emerging trends, interviewing ecosystem stakeholders or developing presentations, you'll help translate complex technological developments into insights that inform decision-making.

Key Responsibilities For This Role Include

Support qualitative and quantitative research on AI and emerging technologies, including literature reviews, desk research and interviews, while working closely with Insights Managers and Senior Insights Managers.Analyse and synthesise research findings, contributing to reports, blogs, presentations, briefing papers and other knowledge products for industry, policymakers and development partners.Support the delivery of research projects by coordinating project activities, managing timelines and documentation, and liaising with external research partners and suppliers to help deliver high-quality outputs on time.Contribute to the dissemination of research findings by identifying relevant events and engagement opportunities, supporting webinars, workshops and conference activities, and developing presentations and other communication materialsMonitor developments in AI and emerging technologies, identifying relevant evidence, case studies and emerging trends that strengthen the programme's research and thought leadership.Work collaboratively across the EmergingTech programme and the wider M4D team, contributing to cross-programme research, events, thought leadership and knowledge sharing.

About You

We're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, digital innovation and international development. You'll bring strong research skills, excellent written communication and experience in (or a desire to learn about) emerging technologies and their application in low- and middle-income countries. While prior experience in every aspect of our work isn't expected, you'll be motivated to learn quickly and develop expertise in a collaborative environment.

We welcome applications from individuals with the following demonstrated qualifications and skills:

Demonstrable experience conducting or supporting qualitative and/or quantitative research, using appropriate research methodologies and synthesising evidence into clear, evidence-based insights.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyse complex evidence, apply structured approaches to research questions and extract meaningful insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing reports, presentations or other research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts in clear and accessible language.Understanding of, or strong interest in, AI, emerging technologies and their application in international development. Familiarity with the mobile ecosystem or broader digital development landscape would be advantageous.Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and contributing to multiple research projects.Comfortable engaging with stakeholders from different sectors and cultural contextsA proactive and intellectually curious approach, with a willingness to learn, take initiative and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

About Your Skills

This role is based on the following core capabilities:

Analysis – Analysis is central to this role, enabling the interpretation of evidence, identification of trends and translation of complex information into clear, actionable insights that underpin high-quality research.

Communication – Essential for producing high-quality research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to audiences across industry, government and the development ecosystem.

Delivery – Strong delivery skills ensure research activities are effectively managed, priorities are balanced and outputs are delivered to a high standard.

Agility – Agility is essential in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, enabling continuous learning, adaptability and responsiveness to emerging developments.

Teamwork – Teamwork is fundamental to the way we work, supporting effective collaboration with colleagues and partners across GSMA and the wider ecosystem.

Contract type

Short term Contractor

Worker type

Contingent Worker

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.

Being You at the GSMA

We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.

GSMA Values

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

rows.title: Marketing Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why Arup?

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world.  Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We solve the world's most complex problems and deliver what seems impossible, with curiosity and creativity. We’re a thriving and growing organisation which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, our Marketing, Communications, and Business Development (MCBD) team enables Arup to build and protect our reputation, deepen client relationships, win quality work, and attract top talent. This role will be key in achieving our strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to hire a Marketing Data Analyst to strengthen our MCBD function.

The Opportunity

This role is within the evolving global business development team. You will be working with business development personnel across the firm, including those responsible for the development of client systems and those running business development programmes such as the client programme, the contractor programme and initiatives identified by the Business and Markets Executive / Business Growth and Client Systems leadership. The winning of work and associated activities are key to the success of Arup, more than ever before. This is an opportunity to be part of the team enabling firm growth.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop and assist in the development of all forms of Power BI reporting utilizing CRM, finance and other data for use by the marketing, communications, business development and Business and Markets communities across Arup.  Work with leadership, MCBD and other members of the Client Systems team to define requirements for reporting, to sketch out possible solutions, and to elicit feedback once reporting has been created.  Support the coordination of the Marketing Data Warehouse. Work with our digital marketing experts on our data warehouse that stores data from our digital marketing platform, Marketo, and its evolution to encompass website and social media data. Its aim is to give a complete picture of the operation of our digital marketing channels.  Bring your expertise in reporting to support the development of CRM and other tools so that our data is best configured to produce the reporting we need.  Explore the use of AI to support development of reporting solutions as well as generate insights into our business growth department.  Collaborate with the wider ARUP’s analytics community in predictive modeling and statistical analysis projects that would help surface insights around improving our work-winning processes. 

Is this role right for me?

Requirements

 Experience in the use of Power BI plus high-level Excel skills.  Desire to grow these skills. Potential interest in languages such as Python and tools such as Databricks and SQL querying.  Experience working with CRM and/or finance data. Knowledge of how to clean data prior to processing.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to think laterally to suggest potential solutions.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. 

Qualifications And Accreditations

 Degree, postgraduate qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Knowledge Management or a related field. 

Knowledge And Experience

 Experience in data management, knowledge management and analytics.  Knowledge of client systems and software development.  Proficiency in marketing and communications related technologies, and knowledge of marketing data including bidding and clients data.  Experience in building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders.  Knowledge of current trends in AI, data information, machine learning and data quality is a plus. 

Skills And Attributes

 Skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.  Communication and interpersonal skills.  Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.  Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.  Able to build collaborative and inclusive working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.  High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership.  Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organisation’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honourable dealings. 

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact nick.newell@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit: https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies – We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

rows.title: Data Quality Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Title - Data Quality Specialist

Location - London

Salary -£32,157 - £40,197

About CDP:  

CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.

Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. We helped more than 24,800 companies and almost 1,000 cities, states and regions disclose their environmental impacts in 2024. Financial institutions with more than a quarter of the world’s institutional assets use CDP data to help inform investment and lending decisions.

Our team is truly global, united by our shared desire to build a world where people, planet and profit are balanced. Visit cdp.net or follow us @CDP to find out more.

About the Team:

The Data Governance and Quality team is responsible for developing and implementing policies, standards, and guidance to measure and improve the quality of CDP’s data. We establish clear standards and definitions, embed governance and quality principles into system design, and provide training and support to staff. This ensures CDP’s data is fit for purpose, accurate and trusted to support high-quality products and deliver its mission with greater impact.

About this role:

The Data Quality Specialist will help improve CDP’s data by supporting the development and implementation of data quality processes and reporting. This role focuses on promoting good data practices and helping teams improve data quality. Key tasks include contributing to data quality priorities, supporting improvement plans, and helping to create Power BI dashboards to visualise and report data quality improvements. The role also involves performing data analysis and supporting stakeholders in identifying and resolving data quality issues.

What you will do:

Support the development of methodologies and best practices to measure data quality across the CDPSupport and develop data cleansing solutions to address quality issues.Help develop and operationalise dashboards to monitor data improvement.Work with colleagues to define data quality metrics and reporting to resolve issues.Help develop and maintain data quality reports to support improvements in specific data domains.Along with the team, promote a data-first attitude toward data quality and governance across CDP.

Actively contributes to an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:

Ensuring you know what is expected of you, through regular 1:1s, having clear objectives in place, and participating in open and honest performance and development conversations.Ensuring a respectful and inclusive workplace, where team members communicate openly, share knowledge so it can be used, and respect difference.Living the CDP Values and demonstrating the behaviours appropriate to your position.

Internal stakeholders include CDP Data Owners, Stewards, Custodians and Users

External stakeholders include CDP Disclosers, Requesters, Data Users, and other customers

We're looking for:

Previous experience working in Data Science or Data Analytics, ideally with a focus on data quality improvementHigh coding capabilities in SQLAbility to present technical content to a variety of technical and non-technical audiencesKnowledge of applying data quality approaches to resolve issuesExposure to Power BI or similar tools, used to communicate findingsAnalytical mindset with strong problem-solving and attention to detailConfident communicator with strong English language skills, including good reading comprehension skillsA proactive team-player

Desirable:

Second language skillExperience of working within global organisationsExperience with PythonExperience working according to agile project/product management.

Salary and benefits: The salary banding for this role is £32,157 - £40,197/year, 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, generous non-contributory pension provision, Employee Assistance Programme, life assurance, training and development, flexible working opportunities and other benefits.

Final offer amount depends on multiple factors such as candidates experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data.

This is a permanent contract based at CDP’s London office. Interested applicants must be eligible to work legally in the UK and live within a commutable distance of the London office and be comfortable with 2 days in the office per week. We cannot sponsor this role.

Before you apply :

We’ll only use the information you provide to process your application. For more details on how we use your information, see our applicant’s privacy notice. By uploading your CV and covering letter, you are permitting CDP to use the information you have provided for recruitment purposes.  

How to apply: 

Please upload your CV in English via the application form. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis so early applications are encouraged.

Ekimetrics is a leader in data science and AI, specialising in marketing effectiveness and business optimisation since 2006. We help companies across various industries, including retail, automotive, banking, luxury fashion, and more, unlock the value of their data to drive sustainable business performance.

rows.title: CRM Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Location: headquarters in Marylebone, LondonWorking pattern: Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday)Reports to: Senior CRM Manager
About Pockit and MonesePockit and Monese are all-in-one money apps that make it easier for people to access and manage the financial tools they need to take control of their money.We provide vital financial services, from accounts and cards to income advance solutions. In October 2024, Pockit acquired Monese, bringing together two complementary businesses and creating a leading fintech company focused on serving people who are underserved by traditional banks.
Together, we serve more than three million customers across the UK and Europe.We're a diverse, international and energetic team, with colleagues based across London, Newcastle, Tallinn and remote teams across Central Europe. We value curiosity, ambition, accountability and resilience, and we want everyone to feel at home, have a voice and know that their contribution matters. We give people the trust and space to take ownership, share ideas, influence decisions, and make a real impact on our customers and our business.
About the RoleAs a CRM Specialist, you'll play an important role in shaping how we engage with and retain our customers.
Reporting to the Senior CRM Manager, you'll help execute and continuously improve our CRM lifecycle roadmap, using customer data and insights to create relevant and effective communications.
You'll be hands-on, building and optimising campaigns across multiple channels while working closely with Marketing, Product, Data and BI teams to deliver joined-up customer experiences.This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys combining creativity, data and execution, and who wants to make a tangible impact in a fast-moving fintech environment.
Your Typical DayAs a CRM Specialist, you can expect to:Build, launch and iterate campaigns across email, push, SMS, in-app and on-platform messaging using Braze.Manage campaigns from audience selection and setup through to QA, launch and performance analysis.Monitor campaign performance and prepare post-campaign reports with clear, actionable insights.Analyse qualitative and quantitative customer data to identify opportunities and challenges.Use segmentation and customer insights to deliver the right message to the right customer at the right time and through the right channel.Contribute to and implement A/B tests as part of structured testing and experimentation plans.Work closely with Marketing, Product, Data and BI teams to align on strategy, priorities and execution.Continuously learn from campaign results and use those insights to improve future activity.
Key ResponsibilitiesSupport the CRM lifecycle roadmap, ensuring activity is continuously monitored, evaluated and optimised.Analyse customer data to identify opportunities, challenges and areas for improvement.Create and optimise customer engagement campaigns across email, SMS, push and in-app channels.Own campaign delivery, QA and audience segmentation to ensure communications are accurate, relevant and delivered on time.Track key performance indicators and turn campaign results into clear recommendations for continuous improvement.Partner with Data and BI teams to support data-driven decision-making.
About YouWe're looking for someone who is proactive, curious and enjoys getting things done. You'll be comfortable taking ownership while working collaboratively with people across the business.You'll bring:A proactive, self-starting approach, with a bias for action and strong attention to detail.Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.A collaborative mindset and the ability to work confidently across different teams and functions.Strong communication and presentation skills, with a naturally personable approach.A growth mindset and a practical, problem-solving approach to challenges.Genuine interest in Pockit, Monese and what we're building for our customers.The ability to thrive in a fast-moving, agile environment and adapt as priorities change.A willingness to take feedback, learn and continuously improve.
Experience & Skills2-3+ years of relevant CRM experience, ideally in a consumer-facing environment.Hands-on experience with Braze or a comparable CRM/marketing automation platform, including building and executing campaigns.Good understanding of customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing and campaign optimisation.Comfortable with technical terminology such as SDKs and APIs, and able to learn new tools quickly.Ability to analyse customer and campaign data and translate insights into clear, actionable strategy.Experience managing multiple workstreams and prioritising effectively.Fluent English, both written and spoken.Experience working in a multinational or multilingual environment is a plus.Knowledge of HTML and CMS platforms is desirable.Experience in banking, fintech or another regulated industry is a bonus.
Why Join Us?Make a real difference: Work at the intersection of technology and financial inclusion, helping people take greater control of their money.Have a voice: Your ideas and perspective matter. You'll have the opportunity to influence decisions, take ownership and shape how we work.Make an impact: Work on initiatives that reach millions of customers across the UK and Europe.Work with great people: Join a diverse, international and ambitious team where collaboration and curiosity are encouraged.Grow with us: Be part of a fast-moving fintech where you'll have plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and make your mark.
What benefits we offerWe want you to feel supported, valued and able to do your best work - both in and outside the office.25 days annual leave + public holidays, with an extra day for every year workedBupa private healthcare10 paid sick days per yearHybrid working + up to 30 days working abroad each yearL&D budget + 10 paid learning days per yearAnnual eyecare allowanceEnhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leaveVIP Pockit & Monese accountsExtra paid days off for your birthday and weddingRegular social events and team activitiesMonthly recognition awards and Team of the QuarterShare options, depending on role and levelEmployee referral bonusFree office parking
If you're passionate about customer engagement, enjoy working with data and want to create communications that genuinely make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

rows.title: Entrepreneur in Residence
rows.descriptionText:
About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.  Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things
About the RoleWe are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence to help achieve our mission.
You will work directly with founders and senior leaders on high-priority initiatives across hiring, market expansion, partnerships, operations, and growth.
This role is for highly capable generalists who enjoy solving problems, moving quickly, and taking ownership. We are looking for people who can turn ideas into execution and create meaningful impact from day one.
What You Will Be DoingDrive high-priority projects across hiring, operations, growth, and market expansion.Build relationships with candidates, recruiters, universities, communities, and external partners.Support new market launches and expansion initiatives.Help identify opportunities and solve operational challenges.Represent ActAI at events, communities, and external engagements.Work closely with founders on strategic initiatives.Take ownership of projects from concept through execution.
What You Will NeedStrong problem-solving and analytical abilities.Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.Ability to operate independently with limited structure.Strong execution skills and bias toward action.High ownership and willingness to take on unfamiliar challenges.Comfortable working across multiple functions and disciplines.Strong alignment with ActAI's mission and ambition.
How We WorkThe best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.
We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.
This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.
Interview ProcessIf there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.
Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.
We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

rows.title: CRM Executive FTC 12 months
rows.descriptionText:
This role offers a competitive salary, hybrid working in London with regular office day being Tuesday, 28 days holiday a year plus Bank Holidays and a fantastic pension scheme offering 6% in year one and 11% after this.

Salary 31,000 – £33,660 per annum

Please note: Although we acknowledge that the use of AI tools can be helpful, we want your application to represent you. Please ensure your CV and statement of suitability (if asked to send in this advert) reflect your own voice and experiences.

Are you ready to help our members get more value from their membership? Which? is the UK's consumer champion, making life simpler, fairer and safer for everyone. We're looking for a CRM Executive to join our member engagement team and support better ways to connect with our members.

About The Role

In this role, you'll work with your team to keep members engaged and help them find their next best action. You'll look after our CRM activity across email, app and direct mail, making sure everything is on brand and reaches people at the right time. Does testing, learning and improving how we talk to members sound like something you'd enjoy?

Key responsibilities include:

Looking after assigned CRM programmes and making sure they work well from start to finishSetting up campaigns, building landing pages and working with Member Services to keep them informedTesting send times and content to find what works best for our membersChecking results and sharing what you learn with the teamSupporting our new Customer Data Platform and helping create better targeted campaigns

About You

You'll have experience sending email campaigns using an established platform. You're organised, pay close attention to detail, and enjoy working with data to spot what could work better. Would you like to be part of a team that values your ideas and encourages you to try new things?

Background in email marketing and a strong interest in best practiceAble to use data to understand what's working and whySkilled at working with others and sharing updates clearlyComfortable using spreadsheets and presentation toolsFor a full list of essential requirements, please refer to the role profile, which can be downloaded as a PDF at the bottom of this advert. 

The Interview Process

Stage 1 -10 minute TEAMS call with the Senior Retention Manager

Stage 2 - 45 minute TEAMS call Jon Ballantyne, Senior Retention Manager and Cameron Burrage Senior CRM Manager

Benefits

We also have these benefits for you to consider:

35 hour working weekGenerous 28 days holiday a year plus bank holidays and the option to buy additional holiday daysExcellent pension scheme – when you pay in 3%, Which? pays in 6% (rising to 11% after one year of service)Annual Award (depending on employee and company performance)Healthcare insurance & Private medical insurance and opportunity to participate in Vitality rewards programme (at 6 months)A discretionary death in service benefit provision equivalent to six times your annual salaryFree access to Which? member content and free access to Which? money & legal helplinesFree wills for all Which? employees, plus, partners of employees can make their will at cost priceDiscount site Pluxee which offers large %% off every day shopping and holidaysWork from (almost) anywhere" for 4 weeks of the year policyA great work-life balance (all our roles are now hybrid), offering flexible working options e.g. part time or job shares where possible. If you wish to discuss any of these options, please contact the Resourcing team at recruitment@which.co.uk. 

About Which?

Which? is the UK's consumer champion, here to make life simpler, fairer and safer for everyone. You can find out more about what we do, our people and culture as well as hints and tips on how to complete your application on our Careers site.

We're proud to be ranked 3rd in the 'Top 25 Inclusive Employers' List 2024. We welcome applications from everyone, because we value diversity, and are committed to maintaining an inclusive culture where all can thrive and reach their full potential—because diverse perspectives help us better understand and positively impact consumers.

As a Disability Confident Leader, we ensure that everyone can apply and be part of our recruitment processes and so we'll make reasonable adjustments if you need them. For this or any other assistance you need with applying (i.e., would like to apply by phone or post), email recruitment@which.co.uk. Find out more about the Disability Confident Interview Scheme here.

Please note:

You must meet the essential criteria listed within the Role Profile, to have your application reviewed. Applications should be submitted via our online careers site, we are unable to accept applications by email. However, if you require an alternative application method as a reasonable adjustment, please contact us using the details above. We reserve the right to withdraw this advert at any given time due to the number of applications received. Role profile_ CRM Executive Sept 26.pdf

rows.title: Marketing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
The Role

We are seeking a proactive Trade Marketing Analyst to drive our strategic objectives by implementing and communicating core trade policies across daily operations. In this pivotal role, you will take ownership of the marketing activities (space coordination and/or pricing management) on export vessels, ensuring all logistical and pricing strategies align seamlessly with our overarching commercial goals.

The Key Areas Of Responsibilities Will Be

Act as the Marketing (Space and/or Pricing) Focal Point for designated regions whilst demonstrating a sound awareness of the regional commodities, markets and operational infrastructure.Perform regular structural review of region performance against target levels & follow-up on any performance deviations.Respond to the marketing action requests in a timely fashion whilst analysing & judging business contribution in the context of current / prospected market conditions as well as Trade/ region performance.Produce regular KPI reports and follow up on performance variances.Represent the Marketing team at internal and external meetings as required.Maintain proficiency in ONE’s in-house operating systems, performing timely and accurate reviews and maintenance.Ensure the trade and regions in charge achieves 100% slot utilization, working closely with relevant stakeholders.Coordinate the implementation and performance management of country-wise customer allocation processes.

The Requirements

Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Google AI (GEMINI).Previous liner shipping marketing (pricing and/or space control) experience is desirable, though not essential.Proven ability to work under tight deadlines and prioritize workloads effectively.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.Excellent communication, organizational, and teamwork abilities.Proactive mindset with a systematic approach to work.Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships

The Benefits

Paid annual leave of 25 days per annum plus UK bank and public holidays.Hybrid working arrangement. Membership of the Company’s Group Personal Pension Plan.Performance Related Pay a pay award and discretionary annual bonus linked directly to their performance in addition to annual review.Permanent Health Insurance.Death in Service.Private Medical Cover (BUPA) after two years’ service.Employee Assistance Programme, with free independent confidential support and virtual GP services.An interest free annual travel season ticket loan.Family leave policies enhanced above statutory.Enhanced company sick pay policy.Medical health check.Annual eye test and contribution towards glasses for VDU prescriptions.Online employee discount platform.

Application

The closing date for this vacancy is 29th September 2026 but if a significant number of applications are received, it will close earlier.

Applicants must have an existing right to live and work in the UK.

rows.title: Analyst - Marketing Science
rows.descriptionText:
Agency

Omnicom Media

Job Function

Data and Analytics

Job Subfunction

Data Science and AI

Job Description

About the Role:

The role is a rare opportunity to be right at the forefront of media and brand analytics, leveraging a leading global platform and Data Science team to aid the biggest marketers with game changing solutions around the measurement, optimisation and planning of media. Through cutting edge solutions in Analytics and Marketing Science that will be at your disposal, you will help the biggest brands in the industry with understanding the value of their media, define their optimal media plan, and feed insights straight into their media buying strategies.

About Annalect EMEA

Omnicom Media Group Europe (OMG EMEA) is the media division of Omnicom Group Inc., headquartered in London with offices in Manchester and Newcastle.

The Annalect EMEA team at OMG EMEA is the data, technology, and analytics division. We help CMOs and their teams harness data, technology, and advanced analytics to grow their brands.

We have built a variety of innovative product and specialist service solutions for clients and agency partners.

We build and maintain the Omni platform which gives agency and client teams access to these capabilities as well as the ability to integrate and combine their own data and technology with Omni. Omni has over 30,000 active users and is recognized in the industry as a leading marketing platform. We continuously innovate the platform to ensure our clients stay ahead of their competitors in data driven marketing.

Our team of Annalectuals is growing rapidly and are based in over 80 countries around the globe, supported by global and regional team hubs in NY, London, Singapore, Gurgaon, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.

The EMEA team is responsible for global and regional client relationships led from London, as well as the development of new data-driven marketing capabilities. They form part of our global team and collaborate closely with local market Annalect teams across EMEA as well as regional Omnicom agency partners.

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice/

rows.title: Commercial Operations Analyst - 12 month Maternity Cover
rows.descriptionText:
Location: London / Hybrid (2 days in office per week)12 month maternity cover contract
Job Description:
As a Commercial Operations Analyst within our Sales Operations function, you’ll play a key role in supporting the Commercial Team and ensuring our sales processes run efficiently and effectively. You’ll work across a broad range of areas, including commercial reporting, deal desk support, contract processing, Salesforce and DocuSign administration, sales enablement, process improvements and territory allocations.
This is a highly collaborative role, offering great exposure across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success. You’ll join a busy, adaptable Sales Operations team that values innovation, creativity and finding smarter ways of working, within a wider team with a strong and supportive culture.
We’re looking for someone who is detail-oriented, curious and eager to learn, with strong Salesforce and Excel skills. Salesforce Administrator certification is highly desirable. You’ll also need excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain processes and deal complexities clearly, alongside a creative mindset and a genuine interest in improving efficiencies.
Main duties and responsibilities:
Commercial Operations Analyst within the Sales Operations function, responsible for supporting the Commercial Team. Main responsibilities include:Commercial ReportingDeal desk supportContract processingDocuSign AdministrationSalesforce AdministrationSales EnablementSales Process ImprovementsSales Territory Allocations
Why you should apply:
The Commercial Operations Analyst sits within the wider Sales Ops and Customer Success team, who have a great working culture. The role works closely with the entire Commercial Team, with great exposure to different aspects of the business, including sales, marketing & customer success. You will sit within the Sales Operations function which is a busy and ever-adapting team, which applauds innovation and efficiencies.
Skills and Experience:
The candidate should have Salesforce experience (Salesforce ADM certification very desirable)Excel proficientConsiderable attention to detail is a mustThey should be curious and ready to learnA spark of creativity to improve existing processes and improve efficiencies across the commercial team processesGreat verbal and written communication with the ability to explain processes/deal intricacies
About us:
Chambers is the leading legal data and intelligence partner for lawyer, firms, and in-house teams.
We conduct over 350,000 research interviews and surveys with in-house counsel every year, and receive 62,000 submissions from 9,000 firms worldwide, giving us unrivalled insight into the legal sector.
This research powers Chambers Rankings - the definitive guide to the best legal talent - and our Intelligence, which delivers the insights helping firms and in-house teams to succeed.
Our independent, rigorous research identifies the exceptional and charts the path to success, enabling legal professionals to see with clarity, decide with confidence, and plan with ambition.
Equal Opportunity Statement:We are committed to fostering and promoting an inclusive professional environment for all of our employees, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and inclusion are integral values of Chambers and Partners and are key in our culture. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, disability, race, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity. This commitment applies across all of our employment policies and practices, from recruiting and hiring to training and career development. We support our employees through our internal INSPIRE committee with Executive Sponsors, Chairs and Ambassadors throughout the business promoting knowledge and effecting change.
Applicants who identify as Disabled and/or Neurodiverse will be entitled to an interview if they meet the minimum criteria as specified in the Job Description, additionally we will offer reasonable adjustments to those who require them. Some examples of reasonable adjustments are extra time in assessments, video interviews to combat travel-based issues and advice on expected interview topics/questions.

rows.title: Junior Commercial Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Our Company

At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

About Us

Founded in 2018, Carbon’s mission is to transform delegated underwriting and raise the standard for the industry. Our open underwriting model connects data, insight and people to enable stronger decisions and more dynamic portfolio management, bringing greater transparency, clarity and confidence to our partners and to the way the whole market works.

We’re proud to have been recognised by The Sunday Times as a Best Place to Work in 2024, 2025 and 2026, reflecting our warm, inclusive culture and our energetic, entrepreneurial spirit. Our friendly, modern offices foster creativity and connection, while our partnership with Google Cloud, where we are celebrated as a success story, demonstrates our commitment to innovation and technology at the highest level.

At Carbon, our values shape who we are every day: Win as one, Keep spirits high, Blaze a trail, Speak up, listen up.

If you’re looking to join a modern team with bold ambitions and real momentum, we’d love to meet you.

The Opportunity

At Carbon, we’re delegating differently by combining our strong insurance expertise with cutting-edge technology. If you want to join an exciting business powered by the latest technology and are energised by collaboration, big ideas and making a meaningful impact with our partners, then this role is for you.

We are looking for a motivated Catastrophe Modelling Analyst to join our Exposure Management team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with 2–3 years of catastrophe modelling experience who wants to develop their technical expertise, work closely with underwriting teams, and help shape how data and analytics support delegated underwriting decisions.

You will play a key role in catastrophe modelling, wider exposure management, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, and the ongoing development of our modelling capabilities through integration with Graphene and vendor model APIs.

Responsibilities

 Support the Exposure Management and Underwriting teams by delivering catastrophe modelling, portfolio analytics and regulatory reporting activities within deadlines. Work extensively with Verisk AIR Touchstone and Carbon's proprietary technology platform, Graphene, to analyse portfolio exposures and assess the impact of new business. Provide insight to support underwriting decisions across natural catastrophe, non-natural catastrophe and non-catastrophe exposures. Support underwriters with regular modelling and exposure reports to help them optimise portfolios and make informed underwriting decisions. Support the evaluation of new opportunities by assessing portfolio impacts and catastrophe risk accumulation. Contribute to the development, testing and optimisation of catastrophe modelling workflows, working closely with the technology team to enhance portfolio analytics, reporting and risk insight within Graphene. Maintain clear documentation of methodologies, assumptions, processes and model settings. Assist with data validation, quality assurance and exposure management controls. Support the wider Exposure Management team with ad hoc analysis, reporting and project work, including model validation and development of view of risk.

Required Training & Experience

 2–3 years' experience in catastrophe modelling Practical experience using AIR Touchstone. Experience working with portfolio aggregation and accumulation analysis. Experience within the London Insurance Market. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to detail and organisational skills. Experience working with large datasets and portfolio-level analysis. Basic coding knowledge (Python, SQL, or similar). Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Desirable Training & Experience

 Exposure to delegated authority underwriting. Familiarity with Lloyd's reporting requirements and exposure management practices. Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Geography, Statistics, Atmospheric Science, Geophysics, Computer Science or a related discipline.

Role details

 Location: 5th Floor, 9A Devonshire Square, London, EC2M 4YN Start date: Immediate Role type: Permanent, full-time, 3 days per week in office

rows.title: Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
London/Hybrid

£40,000 - £60,000 + share options up to £14,500 + Benefits

💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

The team

We have a massive vision and even more ideas, but right now, our ambitions are outstripping our capacity. That’s where you come in. We aren't looking for someone to just "run the reports" we’re looking for a foundational member of a growing function who is excited to help us redefine how data influences product.

At Accurx, we don't just wait for a roadmap to be handed down; we expect everyone to help shape it. While you'll be part of a team of expert data and product leaders, you'll be the one in the driver's seat for your domain. You won't be watching from the sidelines - you'll be proactively hunting for insights, challenging our current assumptions, and taking ownership of how data can save clinician time from day one. This is a role for a critical thinker who is energised by the "blank canvas" of a growing function and has the drive to turn raw data into a better reality for millions of patients.

Challenges you’ll solve...

You will steer product strategy by partnering with Product Managers to define what success looks like and by monitoring the KPIs that prove our impact on the frontline of healthcare.You will interrogate user behaviour by performing deep-dive analyses that look past the surface to find the "why," ensuring we’re solving the right problems for the right people.You will lead rigorous experiments by helping design and run A/B tests, owning the process from the initial hypothesis through to the final, data-backed recommendation.You will build the engine for self-service insights by creating the dashboards and visualisations that ensure your pod has high-quality data at their fingertips to move fast.

You should apply if...

You've worked within a product team environment (not just as a standalone data or BI function), partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and Designers on live product decisions, not just reporting on outcomes after the fact.You are a proactive investigator who doesn't need a ticket to start digging; when things are quiet, you’re already looking for the next trend or bottleneck that we’ve missed.You have a "get stuck in" mindset - you’re excited by a lean environment where you can build your own processes and take on challenges that push you outside your comfort zone.You bring strong Product Thinking with an understanding of user funnels and a hunger to master metrics like activation, retention, and cohort behaviour.You are sharpening a strong technical toolkit, with a solid command of SQL and the ambition to use Python.You are a delivery-focused collaborator who thrives in agile environments and knows how to communicate technical findings clearly to engineers and designers.You’ve used tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude and are ready to become a power user who empowers the whole team through effective data storytelling.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Fix Healthcare Communication

£40,000 - £60,000 salary + share options up to £14,500Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in lifeFlexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pmTime off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per yearFamily matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss supportWe have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

Role Mission

The Data Analyst role within the Customer Data Operations team is pivotal in driving the value and effectiveness of the CUBE Platform. This role involves leveraging advanced analytical skills to connect and optimise customer risk and control data within the CUBE Network. The position also focuses on improving data processes and ensuring that CUBE’s Network data reflects a consensus view of customers' risk and control data with the highest standards of quality and consistency.

Key Responsibilities

 Support Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in the process of connecting customer data to the CUBE Network using advanced data matching protocols, tools, and Python-based solutions. Collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver high-quality, accurate data insights for customers while continuously improving your own expertise in risk and control frameworks. Work closely with the Product and Engineering teams to design and implement improved data processing workflows and tools, leveraging Python for automation and analysis. Assist in defining and refining CUBE’s consensus-based risk and control indices and business rules to maintain Network consistency. Ensure the ongoing quality, consistency, and accuracy of CUBE’s data, applying technical standards and quality control rigorously across all core content. In addition to the duties and responsibilities listed above, the postholder may also be reasonably expected to perform duties of a similar or related nature to those outlined in the job description, and/or to undertake ad hoc or special responsibilities, in line with all other employees of the company. However, such tasks or projects will not be expected to form a dominant part of the individual’s role.

Skills & Competencies

 Data Management & Quality: Executes data cleansing, validation, and enhancement tasks. Ensure data accuracy and consistency under supervision. Risk & Governance: Understands basic data governance and control principles. Supports compliance and data integrity checks. Tools, Automation & AI: Demonstrates proficiency in Python, SQL, Excel, and visualisation tools. Begins exploring AI and ML automation techniques. Problem-Solving & Innovation: Applies structured problem-solving to resolve data issues and suggest small process enhancements. Communication & Collaboration: Communicates clearly with team members and contributes accurate data outputs to shared projects. Operational Execution: Completes assigned data tasks efficiently and on time, following defined workflows. Mentoring & Leadership: Seeks guidance from peers and shares knowledge with the team. Build confidence through learning and feedback.

Required Experience & Qualifications

 Some experience in a data-focused role. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Familiarity with working in a fast-paced, scale-up environment, preferably within the FinTech or RegTech sectors. Self-starter with a pragmatic and proactive approach. A collaborative and flexible team player who can contribute positively to the company’s culture. Proven self-starter with a pragmatic and proactive approach to problem-solving and innovation. Proficiency in at least one of the following data analysis tools and languages, such as Python, SQL, MS/Azure Foundry and data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

rows.title: People Data & Reward Analyst

You will also support reward and benefits activities, including benchmarking and annual reward processes, while helping to identify and develop opportunities to use AI to improve HR processes and efficiencies.

 Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, Workday reports and people analytics to provide meaningful insights to HR, senior leaders and the wider business. Producing regular and ad hoc reporting across key HR activities including headcount, talent and succession, performance management and remuneration reviews. Managing headcount forecasting and reporting through Workday Adaptive, including monitoring actual versus budgeted headcount. Supporting the production of Gender and Ethnicity Pay Gap reporting and other people-related regulatory and management information.  Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with the ability to identify trends and provide actionable insights. An interest in HR technology and AI, with a proactive approach to continuous improvement and innovation.
