rows.title: Quant Research Executive | Strategic Insight Agency
rows.descriptionText:
Insight Analyst | £36,000 | London - 4 days per week onsite
Most research roles at this level ask you to stay in your lane. This one asks you to grow out of it.
🏢 About the Client
Our client is a small, high-performance insight and strategy agency in London. The kind of place where quant doesn't sit in a silo. The team is tight, smart, and moving fast. The work is genuinely interesting. Roughly 80% of what they do is strategic. The other 20% still feeds something bigger. It includes brand architecture, strategic positioning, concept development. And their clients include some of the world's most recognisable brands across food, finance, media, and energy.They need an Insight Analyst who's ready to do real work from day one.
📋 The Day-to-Day
You'll support the Head of Quant and senior team across a portfolio of about three projects at a time. All ad hoc, all different. No two projects are the same. There are no templates. That means:
Running and checking data in Q/SPSSManaging supplier relationships and fieldwork quotasSupporting analysis, charting, and topline reportingHelping coordinate timelines, stakeholders, and client commsContributing to brainstorms and attending client meetings
✅ The Ideal Candidate
You've got around 2 years of quant consumer research experience, ideally from a rigorous agency background. You know your way around fieldwork, data checking, and DP specs. You're not waiting to be told what to do, but you're also honest about where you still have room to grow.
You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment where the expectation is high and the support is real. You want variety over repetition, and you'd rather work on something strategic than process the same tracker every quarter.
You're not the right fit if you're looking for a highly structured environment, or if your quant experience is mostly light-touch or education-sector.

rows.title: Marketing Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why Arup?

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world.  Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We solve the world's most complex problems and deliver what seems impossible, with curiosity and creativity. We’re a thriving and growing organisation which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, our Marketing, Communications, and Business Development (MCBD) team enables Arup to build and protect our reputation, deepen client relationships, win quality work, and attract top talent. This role will be key in achieving our strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to hire a Marketing Data Analyst to strengthen our MCBD function.

The Opportunity

This role is within the evolving global business development team. You will be working with business development personnel across the firm, including those responsible for the development of client systems and those running business development programmes such as the client programme, the contractor programme and initiatives identified by the Business and Markets Executive / Business Growth and Client Systems leadership. The winning of work and associated activities are key to the success of Arup, more than ever before. This is an opportunity to be part of the team enabling firm growth.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop and assist in the development of all forms of Power BI reporting utilizing CRM, finance and other data for use by the marketing, communications, business development and Business and Markets communities across Arup.  Work with leadership, MCBD and other members of the Client Systems team to define requirements for reporting, to sketch out possible solutions, and to elicit feedback once reporting has been created.  Support the coordination of the Marketing Data Warehouse. Work with our digital marketing experts on our data warehouse that stores data from our digital marketing platform, Marketo, and its evolution to encompass website and social media data. Its aim is to give a complete picture of the operation of our digital marketing channels.  Bring your expertise in reporting to support the development of CRM and other tools so that our data is best configured to produce the reporting we need.  Explore the use of AI to support development of reporting solutions as well as generate insights into our business growth department.  Collaborate with the wider ARUP’s analytics community in predictive modeling and statistical analysis projects that would help surface insights around improving our work-winning processes. 

Is this role right for me?

Requirements

 Experience in the use of Power BI plus high-level Excel skills.  Desire to grow these skills. Potential interest in languages such as Python and tools such as Databricks and SQL querying.  Experience working with CRM and/or finance data. Knowledge of how to clean data prior to processing.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to think laterally to suggest potential solutions.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. 

Qualifications And Accreditations

 Degree, postgraduate qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Knowledge Management or a related field. 

Knowledge And Experience

 Experience in data management, knowledge management and analytics.  Knowledge of client systems and software development.  Proficiency in marketing and communications related technologies, and knowledge of marketing data including bidding and clients data.  Experience in building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders.  Knowledge of current trends in AI, data information, machine learning and data quality is a plus. 

Skills And Attributes

 Skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.  Communication and interpersonal skills.  Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.  Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.  Able to build collaborative and inclusive working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.  High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership.  Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organisation’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honourable dealings. 

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact nick.newell@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit: https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies – We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

rows.title: Insights Analyst, Mobile for Development
rows.descriptionText:
Team: Emerging Tech programme

Location: London, candidates must have right to work in the UK

Position type: 1 year contract (inside IR35)

What The Hiring Manager Says

‘Artificial intelligence is reshaping economies around the world but unlocking its potential in low- and middle-income countries requires robust evidence, practical insights and strong collaboration across the ecosystem. As an Insights Analyst in the EmergingTech programme, you'll join a collaborative team exploring how AI and emerging technologies can drive sustainable development. You'll contribute to research that informs industry, policymakers and donors, while developing your expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of technology and international development. This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys solving complex problems and wants to contribute to research with real-world impact.’

Eugénie Humeau, Senior Insights Manager - EmergingTech

About The Team

GSMA Mobile for Development (M4D) is a dedicated global team within the GSMA, which brings together our mobile operator members, tech innovators, the development community and governments, to prove the power of mobile in emerging markets.

The GSMA EmergingTech programme accelerates sustainable development and climate action by fostering the adoption of AI and emerging technologies in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We work with innovators across the public, private and third sectors to support the development and scaling of inclusive and responsible AI solutions.

About The Role

As an Insights Analyst, you will contribute to the delivery of high-quality research on AI and emerging technologies, helping generate evidence and insights that help address real-world challenges in LMICs. Working alongside a team of researchers and specialists, you'll contribute to every stage of the research process, from evidence gathering and analysis through to stakeholder engagement, publication and dissemination.

You'll help produce research that is rigorous, practical and influential, working with innovators, mobile operators, governments, researchers and development partners. Whether contributing to reports, analysing emerging trends, interviewing ecosystem stakeholders or developing presentations, you'll help translate complex technological developments into insights that inform decision-making.

Key Responsibilities For This Role Include

Support qualitative and quantitative research on AI and emerging technologies, including literature reviews, desk research and interviews, while working closely with Insights Managers and Senior Insights Managers.Analyse and synthesise research findings, contributing to reports, blogs, presentations, briefing papers and other knowledge products for industry, policymakers and development partners.Support the delivery of research projects by coordinating project activities, managing timelines and documentation, and liaising with external research partners and suppliers to help deliver high-quality outputs on time.Contribute to the dissemination of research findings by identifying relevant events and engagement opportunities, supporting webinars, workshops and conference activities, and developing presentations and other communication materialsMonitor developments in AI and emerging technologies, identifying relevant evidence, case studies and emerging trends that strengthen the programme's research and thought leadership.Work collaboratively across the EmergingTech programme and the wider M4D team, contributing to cross-programme research, events, thought leadership and knowledge sharing.

About You

We're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, digital innovation and international development. You'll bring strong research skills, excellent written communication and experience in (or a desire to learn about) emerging technologies and their application in low- and middle-income countries. While prior experience in every aspect of our work isn't expected, you'll be motivated to learn quickly and develop expertise in a collaborative environment.

We welcome applications from individuals with the following demonstrated qualifications and skills:

Demonstrable experience conducting or supporting qualitative and/or quantitative research, using appropriate research methodologies and synthesising evidence into clear, evidence-based insights.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyse complex evidence, apply structured approaches to research questions and extract meaningful insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing reports, presentations or other research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts in clear and accessible language.Understanding of, or strong interest in, AI, emerging technologies and their application in international development. Familiarity with the mobile ecosystem or broader digital development landscape would be advantageous.Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and contributing to multiple research projects.Comfortable engaging with stakeholders from different sectors and cultural contextsA proactive and intellectually curious approach, with a willingness to learn, take initiative and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

About Your Skills

This role is based on the following core capabilities:

Analysis – Analysis is central to this role, enabling the interpretation of evidence, identification of trends and translation of complex information into clear, actionable insights that underpin high-quality research.

Communication – Essential for producing high-quality research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to audiences across industry, government and the development ecosystem.

Delivery – Strong delivery skills ensure research activities are effectively managed, priorities are balanced and outputs are delivered to a high standard.

Agility – Agility is essential in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, enabling continuous learning, adaptability and responsiveness to emerging developments.

Teamwork – Teamwork is fundamental to the way we work, supporting effective collaboration with colleagues and partners across GSMA and the wider ecosystem.

Contract type

Short term Contractor

Worker type

Contingent Worker

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.

Being You at the GSMA

We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.

GSMA Values

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

rows.title: Insights Analyst, FOW
rows.descriptionText:

rows.title: Marketing Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why Arup?

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world.  Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We solve the world's most complex problems and deliver what seems impossible, with curiosity and creativity. We’re a thriving and growing organisation which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, our Marketing, Communications, and Business Development (MCBD) team enables Arup to build and protect our reputation, deepen client relationships, win quality work, and attract top talent. This role will be key in achieving our strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to hire a Marketing Data Analyst to strengthen our MCBD function.

The Opportunity

This role is within the evolving global business development team. You will be working with business development personnel across the firm, including those responsible for the development of client systems and those running business development programmes such as the client programme, the contractor programme and initiatives identified by the Business and Markets Executive / Business Growth and Client Systems leadership. The winning of work and associated activities are key to the success of Arup, more than ever before. This is an opportunity to be part of the team enabling firm growth.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop and assist in the development of all forms of Power BI reporting utilizing CRM, finance and other data for use by the marketing, communications, business development and Business and Markets communities across Arup.  Work with leadership, MCBD and other members of the Client Systems team to define requirements for reporting, to sketch out possible solutions, and to elicit feedback once reporting has been created.  Support the coordination of the Marketing Data Warehouse. Work with our digital marketing experts on our data warehouse that stores data from our digital marketing platform, Marketo, and its evolution to encompass website and social media data. Its aim is to give a complete picture of the operation of our digital marketing channels.  Bring your expertise in reporting to support the development of CRM and other tools so that our data is best configured to produce the reporting we need.  Explore the use of AI to support development of reporting solutions as well as generate insights into our business growth department.  Collaborate with the wider ARUP’s analytics community in predictive modeling and statistical analysis projects that would help surface insights around improving our work-winning processes. 

Is this role right for me?

Requirements

 Experience in the use of Power BI plus high-level Excel skills.  Desire to grow these skills. Potential interest in languages such as Python and tools such as Databricks and SQL querying.  Experience working with CRM and/or finance data. Knowledge of how to clean data prior to processing.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to think laterally to suggest potential solutions.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. 

Qualifications And Accreditations

 Degree, postgraduate qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Knowledge Management or a related field. 

Knowledge And Experience

 Experience in data management, knowledge management and analytics.  Knowledge of client systems and software development.  Proficiency in marketing and communications related technologies, and knowledge of marketing data including bidding and clients data.  Experience in building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders.  Knowledge of current trends in AI, data information, machine learning and data quality is a plus. 

Skills And Attributes

 Skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.  Communication and interpersonal skills.  Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.  Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.  Able to build collaborative and inclusive working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.  High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership.  Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organisation’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honourable dealings. 

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact nick.newell@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit: https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies – We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

rows.title: Insights Analyst, Mobile for Development
rows.descriptionText:
Team: Emerging Tech programme

Location: London, candidates must have right to work in the UK

Position type: 1 year contract (inside IR35)

What The Hiring Manager Says

‘Artificial intelligence is reshaping economies around the world but unlocking its potential in low- and middle-income countries requires robust evidence, practical insights and strong collaboration across the ecosystem. As an Insights Analyst in the EmergingTech programme, you'll join a collaborative team exploring how AI and emerging technologies can drive sustainable development. You'll contribute to research that informs industry, policymakers and donors, while developing your expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of technology and international development. This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys solving complex problems and wants to contribute to research with real-world impact.’

Eugénie Humeau, Senior Insights Manager - EmergingTech

About The Team

GSMA Mobile for Development (M4D) is a dedicated global team within the GSMA, which brings together our mobile operator members, tech innovators, the development community and governments, to prove the power of mobile in emerging markets.

The GSMA EmergingTech programme accelerates sustainable development and climate action by fostering the adoption of AI and emerging technologies in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We work with innovators across the public, private and third sectors to support the development and scaling of inclusive and responsible AI solutions.

About The Role

As an Insights Analyst, you will contribute to the delivery of high-quality research on AI and emerging technologies, helping generate evidence and insights that help address real-world challenges in LMICs. Working alongside a team of researchers and specialists, you'll contribute to every stage of the research process, from evidence gathering and analysis through to stakeholder engagement, publication and dissemination.

You'll help produce research that is rigorous, practical and influential, working with innovators, mobile operators, governments, researchers and development partners. Whether contributing to reports, analysing emerging trends, interviewing ecosystem stakeholders or developing presentations, you'll help translate complex technological developments into insights that inform decision-making.

Key Responsibilities For This Role Include

Support qualitative and quantitative research on AI and emerging technologies, including literature reviews, desk research and interviews, while working closely with Insights Managers and Senior Insights Managers.Analyse and synthesise research findings, contributing to reports, blogs, presentations, briefing papers and other knowledge products for industry, policymakers and development partners.Support the delivery of research projects by coordinating project activities, managing timelines and documentation, and liaising with external research partners and suppliers to help deliver high-quality outputs on time.Contribute to the dissemination of research findings by identifying relevant events and engagement opportunities, supporting webinars, workshops and conference activities, and developing presentations and other communication materialsMonitor developments in AI and emerging technologies, identifying relevant evidence, case studies and emerging trends that strengthen the programme's research and thought leadership.Work collaboratively across the EmergingTech programme and the wider M4D team, contributing to cross-programme research, events, thought leadership and knowledge sharing.

About You

We're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, digital innovation and international development. You'll bring strong research skills, excellent written communication and experience in (or a desire to learn about) emerging technologies and their application in low- and middle-income countries. While prior experience in every aspect of our work isn't expected, you'll be motivated to learn quickly and develop expertise in a collaborative environment.

We welcome applications from individuals with the following demonstrated qualifications and skills:

Demonstrable experience conducting or supporting qualitative and/or quantitative research, using appropriate research methodologies and synthesising evidence into clear, evidence-based insights.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyse complex evidence, apply structured approaches to research questions and extract meaningful insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing reports, presentations or other research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts in clear and accessible language.Understanding of, or strong interest in, AI, emerging technologies and their application in international development. Familiarity with the mobile ecosystem or broader digital development landscape would be advantageous.Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and contributing to multiple research projects.Comfortable engaging with stakeholders from different sectors and cultural contextsA proactive and intellectually curious approach, with a willingness to learn, take initiative and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

About Your Skills

This role is based on the following core capabilities:

Analysis – Analysis is central to this role, enabling the interpretation of evidence, identification of trends and translation of complex information into clear, actionable insights that underpin high-quality research.

Communication – Essential for producing high-quality research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to audiences across industry, government and the development ecosystem.

Delivery – Strong delivery skills ensure research activities are effectively managed, priorities are balanced and outputs are delivered to a high standard.

Agility – Agility is essential in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, enabling continuous learning, adaptability and responsiveness to emerging developments.

Teamwork – Teamwork is fundamental to the way we work, supporting effective collaboration with colleagues and partners across GSMA and the wider ecosystem.

Contract type

Short term Contractor

Worker type

Contingent Worker

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.

Being You at the GSMA

We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.

GSMA Values

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

rows.title: (2027 PhD/ABD graduates) Senior Associate (Antitrust & Competition Economics) - United Kingdom
rows.descriptionText:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. Since 1965, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.

Learn more about our work by reviewing our Services and Industries on our website.

Position Overview

Senior Associates are hired into our London, United Kingdom office and work closely with senior consultants on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in shaping the economic analysis and thinking of these cases. Successful candidates have a strong knowledge of economic concepts and a range of research and quantitative skills. A typical Senior Associate would:

Identify and conceptualise issues, specifying rigorous economic models to analyse market issues and data, undertaking statistical and econometric estimation, and managing the work of research associate staff and colleagues;Supervise, train and mentor research associate staff;Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using market, industry or client-proprietary data;Act as a primary point of contact for lawyers and other industry or government clients on a variety of practice-relevant issues;Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R, SAS, Matlab, and Mathematica), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; andContribute to practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).

Explore how CRA can help you launch your career and learn why PhDs choose CRA.

Desired Qualifications

PhD degree in economics with a completion date of December 2026/Summer 2027 and an academic focus on Applied Microeconomics or Applied Microeconometrics, with specializations like industrial organization, labor, health, behavioural and public economics, or other quantitative areas;Experience in Excel, Stata, Python, R, SQL, SAS, ArcGIS/ArcPy, or Cloud computing (Databricks/Spark, Google Cloud, Azure, AWS);Demonstrated understanding of, and ability to explain, economic, financial and/or accounting concepts, and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;Effective written and oral communication skills;Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;Excellent time management and task prioritization skills; andClear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.

As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.

To Apply

To be considered for a position in London, United Kingdom, submit through this posting: 

Resume/CV – please include current address, email and telephone number;Covering letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals. Research/Job market paper – please submit your original research or dissertation;Letters of Recommendation – please have three (3) LORs submitted directly to LORSubmission@crai.com.


To apply for one of our other global locations, please visit our Careers Site to view available jobs.

Interviews will begin following application close, with first round interviews occurring virtually. Candidates focusing their search on industry and consulting who need to be considered early should indicate that in the CRA online application and submit all materials as early as possible.

Career Growth And Benefits

CRA’s robust skills development programs, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with project management skills, training continues with team management/development, client presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a competitive salary and superior benefits package (plus a sizeable performance bonus), wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

rows.title: Finance Associate
rows.descriptionText:
Location: London (2 days a week in office)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer, healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

A Day in the Life

The Finance Associate will be responsible for all receivable and payable data entries across multiple geographies and currencies, managing employee expenses and ensuring all transactions are correctly coded. Act as the main point of contact for all finance platform queries - including accounting system, employee expenses and banking.

The Finance Associate will also play an important part in supporting the team on collating data for our R&D tax credit calculations, financial audits, the preparation of schedules during month-end close (accruals, prepayments, leasing, inventory, capex, loan note, fx, etc.) and assisting with the preparation of monthly management reports. Assist with maintaining compliance with US and UK requirements, such as HMRC and IRS.

We are in a new commercial phase in the business and expanding our functions outside of the UK so we are looking for someone who wants to grow and develop in this role and become familiar with finance across different geographies. A drive for continual efficiency, quality, and process improvements across all Finance team processes is necessary, as well as excellent attention to detail

Key Accountabilities

Maintain the financial accounting system with up to date and accurate data; maintain company travel platform; Maintain and update company wide approval systemEnsure expense claims are in line with policy and reviewed, approved and paid in a timely mannerEnsure customer invoices are raised promptly and customers are supported in delivering payment when dueEnsure suppliers are paid in line with contracted payment termsPreparation of month-end schedules and journalsCompletion of balance sheet reconciliations on a quarterly basisBanking platform management including transfers, investments, payments and refunds; tracking and management of banking reconciliationsCompliance requirements such as ONS Surveys, and assistance with US tax mattersContinued process improvement identification

Who You Are

Core competencies, knowledge and experience:

rows.title: Collections Assistant (DiSSCo UK)
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

We are a world-class visitor attraction and leading science research centre. We use the Museum's unique collections and our unrivalled expertise to tackle the biggest challenges facing the world today. We care for more than 80 million objects spanning billions of years and welcome more than five million visitors annually and 16 million visits to our website.  

Today the Museum is more relevant and influential than ever. By attracting people from a range of backgrounds to work for us, we can continue to look at the world with fresh eyes and find new ways of doing things.

We employ 1100 staff in a variety of roles, all united by our vision of a future where people and planet thrive. We need everyone to have the passion and drive to help us with our mission to create advocates for our planet and inspire millions to care about the natural world.

This role is specifically working as part of the Distributed System of Scientific Collections UK programme (DiSSCo UK, https://www.disscouk.org/).

UK natural science collections hold more than 140 million items. These are an unrivalled source of data about how the Earth and its natural systems formed over 4.56 billion years, with the potential to support research that addresses some of the critical issues facing the world, including biodiversity and climate change. They contain evidence of the changes in the natural world including the impact of human life on our planet over the past few thousand years. The scientific, commercial, and societal benefits of these collections are currently constrained by the limits of physical access, and by highly fragmented digitisation efforts with less than 10% digitally available.

DiSSCo UK is a consortium of UK natural science collections, led by the Natural History Museum in partnership with the Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC) and UK Research and Innovation (UKRI), who are developing a national infrastructure to support the digitisation and use of the UK’s natural science collections to support this critical research.

This will take the form of a 10-year programme focused on digitisation of critical mass of collections as FAIR data, made available through a well-supported backbone of technology infrastructure, with continued development and application of innovative approaches such as greater use of Artificial Intelligence and robotics. Investment of the order of £155m over ten years from 2026-27 is expected to unlock at least a four-fold economic return on investment, as well as efficiency savings for UK and global researchers, and the potential for research innovation and studies that have not previously been possible – underpinning a future in which both people and planet thrive.

Diversity and inclusion matter to us.

Our vision is of a future where both people and the planet thrive. Diversity is one of our core values and we strive to build a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging. All new staff who join us learn about the importance of diversity and inclusion to the Museum and how to contribute to creating an inclusive environment.

We know we have more to do, but we are committed to ensuring that everyone who works at the Museum feels they can thrive and feel valued and respected.

About The Role

The Collection Assistant plays a vital role in ensuring collections are accessible, well-organised, and prepared in advance of digitisation activities. Working closely with digitisation teams, curators, and collection managers, you will help scale up operations for the accessibility and transparency of important scientific collections.

This position is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a nationally significant programme of work during a key phase of DiSSCo UK’s rollout. We encourage applications from candidates (both internal and external) who fulfil most of the key competencies and are willing to support training and personal development opportunities to fill any knowledge gaps.

This role is based within the Museum’s Digital, Data and Informatics (DDI) Department and reports to the relevant Unit Lead (Entomology or Botany).

This is a fixed term role until 31 March 2028.

About You

Are you passionate about making natural science collections accessible to researchers, policymakers, and the public worldwide? DiSSCo UK is seeking enthusiastic and detail-oriented Collection Assistant to help transform the Natural History Museum’s physical collections into high-quality digital records.

We are looking for a proactive and organised Collection Assistant to support the preparation, care, and movement of natural science collections for digitisation.

We are looking for strong communicators with excellent attention to detail, who can team up with both DiSSCo UK and NHM curatorial teams. You will have a pragmatic approach to problem solving and escalating issues in a timely manner. Above all, you thrive in a team environment, are enthusiastic about collections data and their organisation and place collaboration at the heart of your work.

Thriving at the Museum: the way we work

We are proud to work at the Museum and have identified the qualities we all need to embody to reach our shared ambition. This sits alongside the Museum’s values and forms the framework for the way we work.

Find out more here

What We Offer

27.5 days holiday plus 8 bank holidays (full time equivalent)Generous defined contribution Natural History Museum Pension Scheme (employer contribution 4 - 10%)Season ticket, bicycle and rental loanLife insuranceFree admission to our exhibitions and many other paid exhibitions at museums, galleries and institutions across London and the UK.Staff discount at our Museum shops and cafesWe offer a wide variety of training initiatives and opportunities to build skills. Investing in staff development is important to us, and we are ambitious about helping staff to grow and fulfil their potential.Affordable membership to the Civil Service Sports Council which offers a range of benefits including an extensive list of special offers and reduced entry fees at a selection of cinema chains, theme parks, theatres, retailers and supermarkets. It also provides entry to up to 300 English Heritage sites and other national treasures. For more details, visit https://www.cssc.co.ukMembership to our Sports and Social Association (for a small fee), which includes access to our in-house gym and clubs such as football, softball, table tennis and tennis and classes in Middle Eastern dance, yoga and Tai Chi


Hybrid working

We are working towards a vision where both people and planet thrive, and nothing gives a greater connection with this, than seeing first-hand, the visitors, scientific research and collections that all of our work is inspired by and working side by side with the teams delivering the visitor experience and events.  We also recognise the benefits and flexibility that hybrid working brings. We operate a hybrid working model that requires regular, weekly attendance for this role, with the precise pattern of days on site and worked from home to be agreed with your manager.

Due to the nature of this role the work pattern will be 100% on site.

How To Apply

If this sounds like you, please apply below by clicking on Apply for job.

Please note that as part of our commitment to anonymised shortlisting, panels do not view CVs during the recruitment process. If you choose to upload your CV, our system will automatically pull information from your CV into our application form. We advise you to double-check your application form data before submitting as the tool may interpret CVs differently.

Please note that this role does not qualify for Museum sponsorship so the successful postholder will need to have a valid right to work in the UK at the point of offer.

rows.title: AI & Quantitative Analyst, London
rows.descriptionText:
The Opportunity

If you enjoy applying your quantitative and ML skills to real-world problems, coding production-quality analysis and tools, and working in a fast-paced environment with immediate and tangible feedback, our Summer Internship Program is ideal for you.

At Brevan Howard, we build systematic and discretionary investment processes that rely on rigorous analysis of a vast universe of data, such as asset prices, macroeconomic indicators, news, sell-side research, and trading signals. 

Transforming this data into actionable insights is central to how we win, and we’re looking to find the next generation of portfolio managers and quants through our internship program—people who are eager to push the frontier of research and engineering in global macro investing.

Overview & Responsibilities

You will work directly with senior professionals to provide immediate impact on a range of projects:

Our Internship Program starts with one-week in-depth training to prepare interns for the desk. This covers a range of topics relating to Financial Markets including Macroeconomics, FX, Digital Assets, Interest Rate Derivatives, Equity Rates, Bonds, Credit and Fixed Income, Trading Strategies, Risk Management, Excel and Python, and the latest AI tools and LLMs. During the program, working in a fast-paced environment, interns will work within the Quant or Applied AI team, applying frontier AI techniques to research and trading problems, and contributing to the central analytics platform. Projects can include developing the core analytics library (Fixed Income, FX, Credit, Equity etc), integrating AI into trading tools, working with PMs to develop trading strategies, signals and back testing, and building agentic AI systems and LLM-based tools for research and trade workflows. Additionally, interns will benefit from key talks, a mentor program, social events and interactions with some of the most respected and talented individuals in their field. This internship is devised to provide candidates with an invaluable education on the workings of a macro hedge fund and the regulatory environment through a two-way process to determine if Brevan Howard and the intern are a compatible fit. The goal of our summer internship program is to convert top performing interns to our 2028 Graduate Program. 

Qualifications & Requirements

A penultimate year undergraduate/junior or 1st year master's or PhD student at a recognized University — completed and awarded before July 2028.Strong mathematical, quantitative, problem-solving capabilities, and technical skills (Excel, VBA, R, AI, and ML techniques).  Programming experience in Python. Demonstrated interest in AI with ability to explain fundamental concepts. Demonstrated interest and passion for financial markets. Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team. Entrepreneurial spirit; strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to prioritize, manage, and deliver on multiple projects. Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English. 

Why take this opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to gain insight into one of the world’s leading firms operating at the forefront of macro trading. At Brevan Howard, we believe the future of investing lies at the intersection of deep domain expertise and cutting-edge technology. As our industry is being reshaped by AI and automation, you’ll see first-hand how LLMs, retrieval, and agent-like systems are being used in the front-office environment at one of the world’s premier macro hedge funds – where correctness, robustness and speed matter.

Top-performing interns are considered for our Graduate Program the following year and longer-term paths include roles as analyst, quant, and portfolio manager. 

Please note that you may only submit one application to the Summer Internship Program globally. We encourage you to apply to the role and region that best align with your skills, experience, and interests.

rows.title: Marketing Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why Arup?

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world.  Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We solve the world's most complex problems and deliver what seems impossible, with curiosity and creativity. We’re a thriving and growing organisation which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

This role will be key in achieving our strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to hire a Marketing Data Analyst to strengthen our MCBD function.

You will be working with business development personnel across the firm, including those responsible for the development of client systems and those running business development programmes such as the client programme, the contractor programme and initiatives identified by the Business and Markets Executive / Business Growth and Client Systems leadership. The winning of work and associated activities are key to the success of Arup, more than ever before. This is an opportunity to be part of the team enabling firm growth.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop and assist in the development of all forms of Power BI reporting utilizing CRM, finance and other data for use by the marketing, communications, business development and Business and Markets communities across Arup.  Work with leadership, MCBD and other members of the Client Systems team to define requirements for reporting, to sketch out possible solutions, and to elicit feedback once reporting has been created.  Support the coordination of the Marketing Data Warehouse. Work with our digital marketing experts on our data warehouse that stores data from our digital marketing platform, Marketo, and its evolution to encompass website and social media data. Its aim is to give a complete picture of the operation of our digital marketing channels.  Bring your expertise in reporting to support the development of CRM and other tools so that our data is best configured to produce the reporting we need.  Explore the use of AI to support development of reporting solutions as well as generate insights into our business growth department.  Collaborate with the wider ARUP’s analytics community in predictive modeling and statistical analysis projects that would help surface insights around improving our work-winning processes. 

Is this role right for me?

Requirements

 Experience in the use of Power BI plus high-level Excel skills.  Desire to grow these skills. Potential interest in languages such as Python and tools such as Databricks and SQL querying.  Experience working with CRM and/or finance data. Knowledge of how to clean data prior to processing.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to think laterally to suggest potential solutions.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. 

Qualifications And Accreditations

 Degree, postgraduate qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Knowledge Management or a related field. 

Knowledge And Experience

 Experience in data management, knowledge management and analytics.  Knowledge of client systems and software development.  Proficiency in marketing and communications related technologies, and knowledge of marketing data including bidding and clients data.  Experience in building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders.  Knowledge of current trends in AI, data information, machine learning and data quality is a plus. 

Skills And Attributes

 Skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.  Communication and interpersonal skills.  Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.  Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.  Able to build collaborative and inclusive working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.  High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership.  Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organisation’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honourable dealings. 

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact nick.newell@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit: https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Role Title: Graduate Geo-Environmental Consultant

Start Date: September 2027

Location: London

Joining Tetra Tech as a graduate is more than starting a new job – you’ll become part of our Next Gen Talent development programme, designed to support you as you build your career with us. Alongside hands-on experience and exposure to real projects, you’ll benefit from a structured programme of regular learning, training and development opportunities, helping you grow your technical and professional skills as you progress.

You’ll be supported throughout your development by experienced colleagues, giving you the opportunity to learn, build your network and develop the skills and experience needed for a successful long-term career with Tetra Tech.

Launch your career on projects that help transform brownfield land, protect communities and support a more sustainable future. At Tetra Tech, you’ll work alongside experienced specialists, develop practical consultancy skills and contribute to projects that form part of our ambition to improve the lives of 1 billion people.

Purpose & Scope of the Role

As a Graduate Geo-Environmental Consultant, you will join our Geo team, delivering geo-environmental consultancy services supported by in-house ground investigation expertise. You will work across contaminated land, site investigation, brownfield redevelopment and geotechnical engineering projects for clients in sectors including property and regeneration, defence estates and transport.

Your Impact in this position

You will support the design, procurement, supervision and management of geotechnical and geo-environmental ground investigations. Your work will include desk studies, accurate collection and interpretation of site data, ground gas and groundwater monitoring, assessment of findings and production of detailed technical reports. This is an excellent opportunity to gain varied project experience and build a long-term career within a growing team.

5 Core Capabilities

 Ground investigation: Support the planning, procurement, supervision and management of geotechnical and geo-environmental investigations across a range of sites and sectors.  Geo-environmental assessment: Undertake desk-based studies and develop your understanding of contaminated land, brownfield redevelopment, site investigation and geotechnical engineering.  Site data and monitoring: Collect, analyse and interpret site information accurately, including ground gas and groundwater monitoring data.  Technical reporting: Produce clear, detailed and well-structured reports that communicate findings and support sound project decisions.  Professional development and collaboration: Work effectively both independently and as part of a team, use initiative, build strong communication skills and work towards professional qualification with support from mentors and colleagues. 

Training, Qualifications & Experience

You will have, or expect to achieve, at least a 2:1 degree in geology, engineering geology, environmental science or a related subject. Enthusiasm, analytical ability, strong written, communication and presentation skills, and a commitment to professional development are essential. Relevant work experience, such as a placement, is desirable. A full driving licence is required.

Working Environment

Based in London, you will work across office, project and site environments, with travel required to client and investigation sites. Hybrid working is available; however, as this is a graduate role, you will be expected to spend more time in the office initially to support training, mentoring and your transition into the team. CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.

Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. Actively contributes to an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:

Second language skillExperience of working within global organisationsExperience with PythonExperience working according to agile project/product management.

We are looking for an Sustainability Regional Analyst (P1)

About JLL

We are JLL. We are a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying, and investing in real estate.

If you are looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. At JLL, you will have a chance to innovate with the world’s leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game-changing real estate initiatives. You will also make long-lasting professional connections through sharing different perspectives and be inspired by the best. We are focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions – join us at JLL!

What This Job Involves  

Core Function:

The EMEA Sustainability Analyst (P1) is the regional analytical backbone for the EMEA sustainability programme. Sitting within the Sustainability Operations Team (SOT) function, this role provides dedicated data analytics, quality assurance, and reporting support to both the Regional Operations Lead (Mark) and the IFM Programme Lead (Danielle). It replaces the current dependency on an underperforming global UDM team and frees senior team members from data work well below their grade. This is an execution-focused, data-driven, non-managerial role.

Key responsibilities include: 

Regional Dashboard & Automated Reporting 

Build and maintain the centralised EMEA SOT 2026 dashboard in QuickSight (modelled on AMER approach) Design semi-automated recurring reports (weekly/monthly) with scheduled data refresh workflows Create templated narrative frameworks aligned to support client ESG compliance reporting requirements Develop success metric calculation logic for carbon KPIs, water reduction, EPP targets, OTP% Map EMEA data pipelines and build dashboard framework adapted for EMEA/APAC scope 

Utility Data Quality Assurance (QA/QC) 

Conduct regional utility data quality assurance – target: reduce error rates from 30–40% to below 5% Audit EMEA data sources and assess data quality gaps Chase data submissions and troubleshoot gaps with FM/IFM teams Establish proactive data quality management with feedback loops to global UDM team Validate data against source systems – identify and resolve discrepancies before they reach governance reporting 

Carbon, Energy & Water Analytics 

Apply ILFI formula for EUI benchmarking across 41 strategic EMEA sites Support site-level energy benchmarking and utility data oversight Process HVAC/IAQ sensor data and quantify energy savings across 8 EMEA sites (9Foundations programme) Monthly HVAC screening and annual benchmarking cycles Carbon project pipeline data support – M&V data preparation and tracking

Waste & Soft Services Data Analytics 

Waste data analytics and interpretation to support programme progress reporting Track and report on waste diversion, landfill reduction, and recycling rate KPIs Support Bin It Right programme with data collection, analysis, and reporting Coordinate with FM teams on waste data completeness and quality Produce waste/soft services data outputs for client-facing governance updates 

Building Performance & Energy (BPE) Data Management 

Manage BPE data collection and automation EUI gap analysis for top 41 EMEA sites BPE automation implementation and ongoing maintenance Support decarbonisation audit data preparation and scheduling Compliance & Governance Reporting Support Support corporate reporting objectives – management information on utilities and environmental impact 

ESG compliance reporting data preparation 

Produce monthly and quarterly reports tailored to client-specific requirements Ensure data accuracy and audit-readiness for all governance submissions Track and communicate success stories with supporting data/evidence 

Systems & Process Improvement 

Develop and enhance systems and processes for delivering best practice sustainability performance Leverage client tools and in-house JLL tools for data management and reporting Identify process improvements and automation opportunities to reduce manual effort Work closely with Performance Optimisation Manager to adjust processes where data insights indicate needed focus or calibration Support SOPs for dashboard and reporting maintenance 

Expected Outcomes and Critical Deliverables (first 6-months) 

EMEA SOT 2026 Dashboard – built, tested, and launched in QuickSight Utility data error rate reduced from 30–40% to below 5% Semi-automated reporting workflows operational (weekly/monthly) EUI benchmarking complete across 41 strategic EMEA sites HVAC/IAQ sensor data processed and energy savings quantified (8 sites) BPE data collection automation process flow mapped Waste data analytics framework established 

Every day is different, and in all these activities, we would encourage you to show your ingenuity. 

Sound like you. To apply you need to be / have:

Requirements – Essential

University degree in environmental science, data analytics, engineering, or related 1–2 years in sustainability/energy data analysis or environmental data management Strong analytical skills – Excel (advanced), data manipulation, statistical analysis Dashboard tool proficiency – QuickSight, Power BI, or Tableau Meticulous attention to detail – zero tolerance for data errors Proactive self-starter – comfortable chasing data, troubleshooting gaps, working independently Clear communicator – able to present data insights to non-technical stakeholders 

Requirements – Desirable

Experience with utility data management platforms Knowledge of sustainability compliance frameworks SQL or Python for data manipulation Experience working within FM/IFM or corporate real estate environments Understanding of energy benchmarking methodologies (EUI, ILFI) M&V data or energy audit support experience 

Behavioural Competencies

Think Big - Thinks strategically, simplifies the complex, solves complex problems, sees the big picture. Drive Change - Thrives on change, learning agility, intellectually curious, appetite for risks, digital drive. Helps others - Builds relationships, actively collaborates, helps others succeed. Get it done - Acts decisively, drives results, passion to win, takes ownership, accountable, resilient. Business first - Focuses on customers and clients, business/financial acumen, JLL first Inspire - Inspire others, creates vision and strategy, energizes others. 

What You Can Expect From Us

You will join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sight and imagine where JLL can take you...
