rows.title: [2027 Bachelor's graduates] Analyst (European Competition practice)
rows.descriptionText:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. For nearly 60 years, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.

We have played a key role in many cases that have shaped European competition policy in recent years: from aerospace to software, and manufacturing to transportation. More recently, we have been at the forefront of economic thinking in antitrust investigations and regulation in the tech sector.

We seek candidates for our London, UK location.

Position Overview

The Analyst position is the entry-level position for applicants with an undergraduate qualification in economics. Analysts work closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practice input to projects. A typical Analyst would:

Identify potential issues and conduct analyses that can be used to illustrate economic arguments;Assemble compelling evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations;Program, build models, and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using financial, market, industry or client-proprietary data;Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner;Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; andParticipate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).

Desired Qualifications

An undergraduate qualification (BSc/BA) in economics from well-regarded institutions, graduating between December 2026 and August 2027. The position is ideally suited to candidates considering post-graduate study who would appreciate 1-2 year's employment experience and an insight into the world of economic consulting before returning to university for a postgraduate qualification;Strong foundation in microeconomics, with a specialism in industrial economics preferred;High degree of numeracy and comfort with data manipulation are essential, familiarity with econometric techniques desirable;Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;Effective oral and written communication skills;Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills; andClear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.

As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit the following:

CV/Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;Covering letter – please describe your interest in the European Competition practice and how this role matches your goals.Academic Results - please provide all university transcript(s) available to date, including any current or incomplete results.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Career Growth And Benefits

Charles River Associate’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering 100 hours of training annually through formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

Charles River Associates creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 days a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another Charles River Associates office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team. At certain times of the year (e.g. holiday periods), additional remote work options are offered to those whose work commitments permit it, although our offices remain open for those who choose or need to be there.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an Equality Act 2010 employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

The Team

The European Real Estate Specialist Distribution team is part of the Global Client Group and is responsible for all client relationships and capital raising relating to Nuveen Real Estate’s products. The team consists of 4 professionals across Europe but is part of a larger global team.

Overview Of The Role

Our European Real Estate Distribution team is seeking a Sales Analyst to assist and support the European real estate distribution function. As the Real Estate business grows globally, sales support is required to ensure the team continues to keep sales as their key focus. The successful candidate will support the European Real Estate Specialist team and work with team members within the wider Global Client Group and the Real Estate investment teams in order to assist them in developing and maintaining relationships with Nuveen Real Estate’s European institutional clients.

The role would offer an opportunity to work with the largest institutional investors in the region in Real Estate. The successful candidate will also have an opportunity to work closely with experienced Real Estate sales specialists to develop their Real Estate and investment knowledge, as well as receiving guidance and training on the day to day operational aspects of the industry. The firm supports the successful candidate with training in product knowledge, process & systems, and relationship management skills.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Help drive Real Estate sales across Europe together with the wider Real Estate specialist team.Keep track of the real estate specialists’ activity and pipeline. Monitoring Salesforce data completeness e.g. ongoing client and prospect relationshipsComplete compliance training to stay abreast of regulatory requirements and learn to manage the compliance process of marketing to clients on behalf of the wider Real Estate Specialist team. Assist the Real Estate Specialist team to manage client queries on portfolio related matters. Technical Skills & Qualifications Required

Degree qualified with a strong academic track recordExcellent literacy (both written and spoken), numeracy skills and strong attention to detail.Fully proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, ExcelPrevious work experience gained within Investment Management and/or Real Estate Investment preferred but not requiredUnderstanding of Investment Products/Real Estate/Real Assets preferred but not required, if you demonstrate a willingness to develop knowledge through learning independently and from colleagues/peersExperience of working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) advantageousAdditional European language skills advantageous

Competencies Required

Eager to learn, highly motivated, proactive, and willing to use initiativeDelivering results and meeting client expectationsPlanning and organizingFollowing instructions and proceduresAdapting and responding to change in a dynamic environmentPresenting and communicating information (writing and reporting)Team player – will contribute to the success of Nuveen Real Estate and the broader Nuveen business, which will require close collaboration with colleagues and shared service partners at all levels

Related Skills

Business Development, Client Relationship Management, Collaboration, Drives for Results, Executive Presence, Influence, Market Research Competitive Analysis, Nuveen Products/Services Acumen, Practice Management Strategy, Sales

Company Overview

Nuveen is a global investment leader, managing public and private assets for clients around the world and on behalf of TIAA, our parent company and one of the world’s largest institutional investors. Our prevailing perspective on the future drives our ambition to innovate and adapt our business to the changing needs of investors - all to pursue lasting performance for our clients, our communities and our global economy. Visit www.nuveen.com to learn more about us.

ABOUT CFTE
CFTE is one of the world’s leading education platforms in finance, technology and artificial intelligence. We work with tier-one banks, central banks, regulators, technology companies and governments around the world to help individuals, organisations and countries build the capabilities they need for the future.
Our mission is simple: In a tech world, we bet on people. Previous interns and early-career team members at CFTE have gone on to organisations including Goldman Sachs, Jane Street, McKinsey and Amazon, while others have continued their journey with CFTE.
We are now looking for two Research & Content Analysts to join the UK team.
ABOUT THE JOB
This is a junior role suited to a student, recent graduate or early-career candidate who is intellectually curious, comfortable using AI and excited by the challenge of making sense of fast-moving topics. You will help develop workshops, professional programmes and online learning content across AI, fintech, finance and emerging technologies.
The work often starts with an early concept, a question or a session brief. Your job is to take that ambiguity and turn it into something credible and useful: Research → assess → challenge → structure → refine → build You will use AI extensively to accelerate your work, but AI does not replace thinking. You will be expected to question information, validate sources, identify what matters and turn complex topics into clear learning experiences for professional audiences.

rows.title: Senior Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Operations Analyst
About the RoleWe're hiring a Senior Operations Analyst to join the Operations team at Zima Dental. This is a high-responsibility role for someone who has already built a foundation in operations and wants real ownership and broad exposure to how a fast-growing, high-volume physical product business actually runs day to day.
The role sits within Operations and spans the full breadth of what that means at Zima: supply chain (production, freight and logistics, warehousing and fulfilment, forecasting and planning), as well as quality and regulatory support, customer experience operations, and cross-functional projects with Product, Commercial, and Growth. Core supply chain operations will be a significant focus of the day-to-day work, but the role is not limited to it, you'll get exposure across the operational engine of the business rather than sitting in one lane.
This is not a role limited to executing a narrow, well-defined supply chain function. We're looking for someone who has previously helped build, shape, or support an operations department, not just operated within one. You'll be expected to contribute immediately, solve problems independently, and take ownership early. You'll work closely with senior leadership and gain exposure to how decisions are made across every part of the business. The expectation is not just that you support projects, but that you actively help drive them forward.
This is a fast-paced environment with high standards and high expectations. In return, high performers are given rapid progression, significant ownership, and the opportunity to grow into leadership roles quickly.
If you want responsibility early, genuine breadth across how a business operates, plenty of analytical challenges to dig into, and the opportunity to accelerate your career far faster than in a traditional corporate environment, this role is for you.
Key ResponsibilitiesSupply ChainWork across the end-to-end supply chain, from production through to final delivery, without owning any one stage outright.Work directly with suppliers on production and order coordination, helping ensure orders are placed, tracked, and delivered on time and to spec.Oversee freight management rather than managing it directly, making sure processes run efficiently and freight is coordinated in a timely manner in line with stock requirements.Track and monitor the performance of key 3PL accounts to keep fulfilment operations running efficiently.
Forecasting, Planning & InventorySupport demand forecasting and replenishment planning across products and markets.Help maintain healthy inventory levels, balancing availability against working capital and avoiding both stockouts and overstock.Contribute to launch and sale-event planning so the chain is ready for demand spikes.
Data & Business AnalysisBuild reporting and track performance against key operational metrics across supply chain and other functions.Build models and run scenario analysis to pressure-test plans and support better decisions.Turn messy operational data into clear insight that drives action.
ERP Process Improvement & ScalingWork within Zima Dental's ERP, ensuring data and records are accurate, well maintained, and run smoothly across the team.Go beyond day-to-day upkeep to develop SOPs that improve consistency and execution quality across the platform.Use the ERP, alongside reporting tools and AI, to build new reporting capabilities that give the business better visibility over operational performance.
Cross-Functional CollaborationWork closely with Product, Marketing, and Quality teams to support business-critical initiatives.Coordinate across internal teams and external partners (suppliers, freight forwarders, 3PLs) to keep product moving.
Ownership & GrowthTake increasing ownership of operational verticals and projects as you develop in the role.Operate with a problem-solving mindset and strong attention to detail.Contribute ideas proactively and take initiative rather than waiting for direction.Develop a broad understanding of how a high-growth, high-volume physical product business scales operationally, across every function it touches.
What We're Looking ForEducation & Experience1-3 years of experience in an operations role.Degree in Science, Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field preferred.Startup or fast-scaling company experience is a strong plus, given the pace of this role.Experience working within an ERP system, ideally having gone beyond basic use to help improve processes, reporting, or data quality within one.
SkillsStrong analytical and quantitative ability, and genuine enjoyment of solving complex, data-heavy problems.Excellent organisation and attention to detail.Commercially aware, with the ability to think beyond individual tasks and understand cost and service trade-offs.Strong communication skills and the ability to work across teams and with external partners.Ability to prioritise effectively in a fast-moving, high-volume environment.
MindsetHighly ambitious and motivated by responsibility.Ownership-driven with a bias toward action.Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.Genuinely analytically minded, and energised by digging into data and tackling analytical challenges.Excited by solving difficult problems and learning quickly.Resilient, adaptable, and execution-focused.Wants to grow quickly into a future leadership role.
Why Join UsZima Dental is a fast-growing premium consumer brand operating globally and scaling quickly. We move high volumes of physical product across multiple markets, which makes supply chain central to how we grow. We give talented people responsibility early and expect them to perform at a high level.
In this role, you'll gain genuine breadth and depth across the entire supply chain, from production and freight through to warehousing, fulfilment, and planning. You'll work on projects that genuinely matter, collaborate closely with senior leadership, and build a strong foundation across every stage of how the product reaches the customer.
Benefits28 days holiday (excluding bank holidays).Company pension.Cycle to Work scheme.Ongoing learning and development support.Weekly team and company social activities.Direct collaboration with senior leadership.Fast career progression opportunities and significant ownership from an early stage.

Required Training & Experience

 2–3 years' experience in catastrophe modelling Practical experience using AIR Touchstone. Experience working with portfolio aggregation and accumulation analysis. Experience within the London Insurance Market. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to detail and organisational skills. Experience working with large datasets and portfolio-level analysis. Basic coding knowledge (Python, SQL, or similar). Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Desirable Training & Experience

 Exposure to delegated authority underwriting. Familiarity with Lloyd's reporting requirements and exposure management practices. Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Geography, Statistics, Atmospheric Science, Geophysics, Computer Science or a related discipline.

 Location: 5th Floor, 9A Devonshire Square, London, EC2M 4YN Start date: Immediate Role type: Permanent, full-time, 3 days per week in office

rows.title: Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
London/Hybrid

£40,000 - £60,000 + share options up to £14,500 + Benefits

💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

The team

We have a massive vision and even more ideas, but right now, our ambitions are outstripping our capacity. That’s where you come in. We aren't looking for someone to just "run the reports" we’re looking for a foundational member of a growing function who is excited to help us redefine how data influences product.

At Accurx, we don't just wait for a roadmap to be handed down; we expect everyone to help shape it. While you'll be part of a team of expert data and product leaders, you'll be the one in the driver's seat for your domain. You won't be watching from the sidelines - you'll be proactively hunting for insights, challenging our current assumptions, and taking ownership of how data can save clinician time from day one. This is a role for a critical thinker who is energised by the "blank canvas" of a growing function and has the drive to turn raw data into a better reality for millions of patients.

Challenges you’ll solve...

You will steer product strategy by partnering with Product Managers to define what success looks like and by monitoring the KPIs that prove our impact on the frontline of healthcare.You will interrogate user behaviour by performing deep-dive analyses that look past the surface to find the "why," ensuring we’re solving the right problems for the right people.You will lead rigorous experiments by helping design and run A/B tests, owning the process from the initial hypothesis through to the final, data-backed recommendation.You will build the engine for self-service insights by creating the dashboards and visualisations that ensure your pod has high-quality data at their fingertips to move fast.

You should apply if...

You've worked within a product team environment (not just as a standalone data or BI function), partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and Designers on live product decisions, not just reporting on outcomes after the fact.You are a proactive investigator who doesn't need a ticket to start digging; when things are quiet, you’re already looking for the next trend or bottleneck that we’ve missed.You have a "get stuck in" mindset - you’re excited by a lean environment where you can build your own processes and take on challenges that push you outside your comfort zone.You bring strong Product Thinking with an understanding of user funnels and a hunger to master metrics like activation, retention, and cohort behaviour.You are sharpening a strong technical toolkit, with a solid command of SQL and the ambition to use Python.You are a delivery-focused collaborator who thrives in agile environments and knows how to communicate technical findings clearly to engineers and designers.You’ve used tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude and are ready to become a power user who empowers the whole team through effective data storytelling.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Fix Healthcare Communication

£40,000 - £60,000 salary + share options up to £14,500Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in lifeFlexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pmTime off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per yearFamily matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss supportWe have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

Role Mission

The Data Analyst role within the Customer Data Operations team is pivotal in driving the value and effectiveness of the CUBE Platform. This role involves leveraging advanced analytical skills to connect and optimise customer risk and control data within the CUBE Network. The position also focuses on improving data processes and ensuring that CUBE’s Network data reflects a consensus view of customers' risk and control data with the highest standards of quality and consistency.

Key Responsibilities

 Support Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in the process of connecting customer data to the CUBE Network using advanced data matching protocols, tools, and Python-based solutions. Collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver high-quality, accurate data insights for customers while continuously improving your own expertise in risk and control frameworks. Work closely with the Product and Engineering teams to design and implement improved data processing workflows and tools, leveraging Python for automation and analysis. Assist in defining and refining CUBE’s consensus-based risk and control indices and business rules to maintain Network consistency. Ensure the ongoing quality, consistency, and accuracy of CUBE’s data, applying technical standards and quality control rigorously across all core content. In addition to the duties and responsibilities listed above, the postholder may also be reasonably expected to perform duties of a similar or related nature to those outlined in the job description, and/or to undertake ad hoc or special responsibilities, in line with all other employees of the company. However, such tasks or projects will not be expected to form a dominant part of the individual’s role.

Skills & Competencies

 Data Management & Quality: Executes data cleansing, validation, and enhancement tasks. Ensure data accuracy and consistency under supervision. Risk & Governance: Understands basic data governance and control principles. Supports compliance and data integrity checks. Tools, Automation & AI: Demonstrates proficiency in Python, SQL, Excel, and visualisation tools. Begins exploring AI and ML automation techniques. Problem-Solving & Innovation: Applies structured problem-solving to resolve data issues and suggest small process enhancements. Communication & Collaboration: Communicates clearly with team members and contributes accurate data outputs to shared projects. Operational Execution: Completes assigned data tasks efficiently and on time, following defined workflows. Mentoring & Leadership: Seeks guidance from peers and shares knowledge with the team. Build confidence through learning and feedback.

Required Experience & Qualifications

 Some experience in a data-focused role. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Familiarity with working in a fast-paced, scale-up environment, preferably within the FinTech or RegTech sectors. Self-starter with a pragmatic and proactive approach. A collaborative and flexible team player who can contribute positively to the company’s culture. Proven self-starter with a pragmatic and proactive approach to problem-solving and innovation. Proficiency in at least one of the following data analysis tools and languages, such as Python, SQL, MS/Azure Foundry and data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

rows.title: EMEA Sustainability Regional Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We are looking for an Sustainability Regional Analyst (P1)

About JLL

We are JLL. We are a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying, and investing in real estate.

If you are looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. At JLL, you will have a chance to innovate with the world’s leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game-changing real estate initiatives. You will also make long-lasting professional connections through sharing different perspectives and be inspired by the best. We are focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions – join us at JLL!

What This Job Involves  

Core Function:

The EMEA Sustainability Analyst (P1) is the regional analytical backbone for the EMEA sustainability programme. Sitting within the Sustainability Operations Team (SOT) function, this role provides dedicated data analytics, quality assurance, and reporting support to both the Regional Operations Lead (Mark) and the IFM Programme Lead (Danielle). It replaces the current dependency on an underperforming global UDM team and frees senior team members from data work well below their grade. This is an execution-focused, data-driven, non-managerial role.

Key responsibilities include: 

Regional Dashboard & Automated Reporting 

Build and maintain the centralised EMEA SOT 2026 dashboard in QuickSight (modelled on AMER approach) Design semi-automated recurring reports (weekly/monthly) with scheduled data refresh workflows Create templated narrative frameworks aligned to support client ESG compliance reporting requirements Develop success metric calculation logic for carbon KPIs, water reduction, EPP targets, OTP% Map EMEA data pipelines and build dashboard framework adapted for EMEA/APAC scope 

Utility Data Quality Assurance (QA/QC) 

Conduct regional utility data quality assurance – target: reduce error rates from 30–40% to below 5% Audit EMEA data sources and assess data quality gaps Chase data submissions and troubleshoot gaps with FM/IFM teams Establish proactive data quality management with feedback loops to global UDM team Validate data against source systems – identify and resolve discrepancies before they reach governance reporting 

Carbon, Energy & Water Analytics 

Apply ILFI formula for EUI benchmarking across 41 strategic EMEA sites Support site-level energy benchmarking and utility data oversight Process HVAC/IAQ sensor data and quantify energy savings across 8 EMEA sites (9Foundations programme) Monthly HVAC screening and annual benchmarking cycles Carbon project pipeline data support – M&V data preparation and tracking

Waste & Soft Services Data Analytics 

Waste data analytics and interpretation to support programme progress reporting Track and report on waste diversion, landfill reduction, and recycling rate KPIs Support Bin It Right programme with data collection, analysis, and reporting Coordinate with FM teams on waste data completeness and quality Produce waste/soft services data outputs for client-facing governance updates

Manage BPE data collection and automation EUI gap analysis for top 41 EMEA sites BPE automation implementation and ongoing maintenance Support decarbonisation audit data preparation and scheduling Compliance & Governance Reporting Support Support corporate reporting objectives – management information on utilities and environmental impact 

ESG compliance reporting data preparation 

Produce monthly and quarterly reports tailored to client-specific requirements Ensure data accuracy and audit-readiness for all governance submissions Track and communicate success stories with supporting data/evidence 

Systems & Process Improvement 

Develop and enhance systems and processes for delivering best practice sustainability performance Leverage client tools and in-house JLL tools for data management and reporting Identify process improvements and automation opportunities to reduce manual effort Work closely with Performance Optimisation Manager to adjust processes where data insights indicate needed focus or calibration Support SOPs for dashboard and reporting maintenance 

Expected Outcomes and Critical Deliverables (first 6-months) 

EMEA SOT 2026 Dashboard – built, tested, and launched in QuickSight Utility data error rate reduced from 30–40% to below 5% Semi-automated reporting workflows operational (weekly/monthly) EUI benchmarking complete across 41 strategic EMEA sites HVAC/IAQ sensor data processed and energy savings quantified (8 sites) BPE data collection automation process flow mapped Waste data analytics framework established 

Every day is different, and in all these activities, we would encourage you to show your ingenuity. 

Sound like you. To apply you need to be / have:

Requirements – Essential

University degree in environmental science, data analytics, engineering, or related 1–2 years in sustainability/energy data analysis or environmental data management Strong analytical skills – Excel (advanced), data manipulation, statistical analysis Dashboard tool proficiency – QuickSight, Power BI, or Tableau Meticulous attention to detail – zero tolerance for data errors Proactive self-starter – comfortable chasing data, troubleshooting gaps, working independently Clear communicator – able to present data insights to non-technical stakeholders 

Requirements – Desirable

Experience with utility data management platforms Knowledge of sustainability compliance frameworks SQL or Python for data manipulation Experience working within FM/IFM or corporate real estate environments Understanding of energy benchmarking methodologies (EUI, ILFI) M&V data or energy audit support experience 

Behavioural Competencies

Think Big - Thinks strategically, simplifies the complex, solves complex problems, sees the big picture. Drive Change - Thrives on change, learning agility, intellectually curious, appetite for risks, digital drive. Helps others - Builds relationships, actively collaborates, helps others succeed. Get it done - Acts decisively, drives results, passion to win, takes ownership, accountable, resilient. Business first - Focuses on customers and clients, business/financial acumen, JLL first Inspire - Inspire others, creates vision and strategy, energizes others. 

What You Can Expect From Us

You will join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sight and imagine where JLL can take you...

Working Environment 

Location: London, UK Travel: Nominal Working pattern: 5-days on-site and/or flexible remote working options available Duration: Permanent Commitment: Full time (40hrs/week) Reports to: Regional Operations Lead (Mark Bottriell) Works With: SOT Regional Operations Lead & Manager, IFM & Engineering teams, GCS BB Leads

What We Offer You

As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact nick.newell@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

rows.title: Business Intelligence Summer Internship 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Howden Re Business Intelligence Summer Internship 
 
Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one summer internship programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in them not being considered. 
 
Location: London 
Start date: June 2027 
Salary: £32,500 pro-rata for 10 weeks 
Duration: 10-week programme 
 
Business Intelligence Summer Internship Programme  
Turn data into insight. Help shape decisions across a global industry. 
 
Looking for more than just work experience? If you're curious about trends and financial markets and interested in how this data can influence business decisions, then this could be the perfect way to spend your summer. Join Howden Re's Business Intelligence team and discover how data is transformed into insights that help businesses navigate the global reinsurance market. 
 
You'll gain hands-on experience analysing real market data, exploring global industry trends, and contributing to reports and tools used by colleagues and clients around the world. Apply if you're naturally curious, analytical, and enjoy solving problems 
 
The 10-week programme is designed to give you meaningful exposure to the world of reinsurance, while helping you develop the knowledge, professional skills and confidence to kick start your career. 
 
Better still, our programme offers a direct pathway into our Autumn 2028 graduate roles, subject to business needs and individual performance. 
 
What you'll be doing?  
You will begin with a structured induction before joining the Business Intelligence team to work alongside experienced specialists on real client projects.  During the programme, you'll:
Learn how to analyse financial and market data to identify trends shaping the global insurance and reinsurance market. 
Research annual reports and other trusted sources to support business analysis. 
Help maintain and update Nova, our market insights platform. 
Validate outputs from automation and AI tools by checking accuracy and identifying anomalies. 
Create charts, visualisations and supporting evidence for market reports. 
Contribute to analytical projects that help colleagues and clients make informed decisions. 
 
 
Who are we looking for?   
No insurance experience is needed; we'll teach you everything you need to know!  
You'll be: 
In your penultimate year of study from any degree background and interested in a career involving data, research and commercial analysis. 
Comfortable working with numbers and using data to solve problems. 
Able to communicate complex data into interesting insights. 
Able to manage detailed work accurately and consistently. 
Curious about financial markets and the wider economic trends that shape them. 

Keen to learn, take initiative and contribute to team projects. 
 
To be eligible for our programme, you must have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK. 
 
Application process  
Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know! 
Online application form - no CV required: We believe you're more than just a document, so we won't ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form. 
Online gamified assessment: We've created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best! 
Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting. 
Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn't hold back your future! 
 
Why should you apply?  
At Howden, people are at the heart of everything we do. As an employee-owned business, we believe success is built through collaboration, learning and supporting one another. You'll gain exposure to an exciting global industry, receive structured development throughout the summer and build relationships that could shape your future career.  
You'll also benefit from: 
£32,500 pro-rata over the 10-weeks. 
Relocation support may be available for interns who need to relocate to take part in the programme. Support is assessed on a case-by-case basis and subject to eligibility criteria. 
Opportunity to receive a deferred graduate offer for Autumn 2028. 
Excellent training and development schemes and accelerated career progression. 
Access to a buddy to support you throughout your internship. 
6 days of leave, fully paid, plus bank holidays. 

Access to discounted personal health policies as well as a range of insurance products. 
 
Ready to apply?  
Follow our TikTok pages: @earlycareersjo and @millieinsurancecareers, and explore our Connectr hub to discover more about Howden, our culture, and the insurance industry. You'll find resources to help you prepare for our recruitment process and understand which career path could be the best fit for you.  
Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one summer internship programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in additional applications not being considered.  #RESI2027

rows.title: Quant Research Executive | Strategic Insight Agency
rows.descriptionText:
Insight Analyst | £36,000 | London - 4 days per week onsite
Most research roles at this level ask you to stay in your lane. This one asks you to grow out of it.
🏢 About the Client
Our client is a small, high-performance insight and strategy agency in London. The kind of place where quant doesn't sit in a silo. The team is tight, smart, and moving fast. The work is genuinely interesting. Roughly 80% of what they do is strategic. The other 20% still feeds something bigger. It includes brand architecture, strategic positioning, concept development. And their clients include some of the world's most recognisable brands across food, finance, media, and energy.They need an Insight Analyst who's ready to do real work from day one.
📋 The Day-to-Day
You'll support the Head of Quant and senior team across a portfolio of about three projects at a time. All ad hoc, all different. No two projects are the same. There are no templates. That means:
Running and checking data in Q/SPSSManaging supplier relationships and fieldwork quotasSupporting analysis, charting, and topline reportingHelping coordinate timelines, stakeholders, and client commsContributing to brainstorms and attending client meetings
✅ The Ideal Candidate
You've got around 2 years of quant consumer research experience, ideally from a rigorous agency background. You know your way around fieldwork, data checking, and DP specs. You're not waiting to be told what to do, but you're also honest about where you still have room to grow.
You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment where the expectation is high and the support is real. You want variety over repetition, and you'd rather work on something strategic than process the same tracker every quarter.
You're not the right fit if you're looking for a highly structured environment, or if your quant experience is mostly light-touch or education-sector.

rows.title: People Data & Reward Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Tokio Marine Kiln (TMK) is recruiting for a permanent People Data & Reward Analyst to join our Human Resources team in London. Reporting to the Head of HR, you will be responsible for delivering people data, reporting, analytics and insights that support decision-making across the business. You will also support reward and benefits activities, including benchmarking and annual reward processes, while helping to identify and develop opportunities to use AI to improve HR processes and efficiencies.

Key responsibilities include:

 Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, Workday reports and people analytics to provide meaningful insights to HR, senior leaders and the wider business. Producing regular and ad hoc reporting across key HR activities including headcount, talent and succession, performance management and remuneration reviews. Managing headcount forecasting and reporting through Workday Adaptive, including monitoring actual versus budgeted headcount. Supporting the production of Gender and Ethnicity Pay Gap reporting and other people-related regulatory and management information. Supporting salary and bonus benchmarking activities, reward analysis and the annual pay and bonus review cycle. Assisting with reward research, incentive design and benefits analysis to support effective reward decision-making. Identifying opportunities to enhance HR processes through AI tools and supporting the development and adoption of AI capabilities across the HR function. Contributing to a range of HR projects aligned to TMK's people and culture strategy.

What we're looking for:

 Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with the ability to identify trends and provide actionable insights. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proven Power BI expertise, including DAX, Power Query and data modelling. Experience presenting data and recommendations in a clear and compelling way to a range of stakeholders. A good understanding of business performance metrics and data-driven decision making. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organisation. Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively. Experience of Workday would be advantageous but is not essential. An interest in HR technology and AI, with a proactive approach to continuous improvement and innovation.

Why apply?

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of people data, reward and emerging technology. You'll play a key role in providing insights that influence business decisions, support reward strategy and help shape the future use of AI within HR. Working closely with colleagues across HR, Finance and the wider business, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives while developing your expertise in a collaborative and supportive environment.

The successful candidate will be welcomed into the TMK family to help us further our purpose of enabling our clients to fulfil their ambitions whilst benefiting society and our people. We are committed to ensuring a safe, open, inclusive and empowering environment in which all of our people can thrive. All employees have the opportunity to join one or a number of inclusion network groups or take part in CSR and charitable activities. TMK is signed up to the Disability Confident Employer Scheme and we also accommodate flexible working, subject to the TMK flexible working policy.

As an underwriting firm with over 140 years’ experience of protecting clients from changing risks we put our confidence in the ability and talent of our people. We aim to be a ‘Good Company’ and this means being a great and inclusive company to do business with and being a great place to work. Our culture is founded on our core values of empowerment, inclusion, excellence, integrity, teamwork and innovation. We seek to recruit the best talent by endeavouring to reach diverse talent pools, offering dynamic working arrangements and investing in development.

To make your experience as comfortable as possible, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments or additional assistance during your application process. At Tokio Marine Kiln we are here to support you, please be reassured that we will do all that we can to ensure that your specific needs are met. Please reach out to jay.lewis@tokiomarinekiln.com in confidence, to discuss any specific assistance or requirements that you have.

If you encounter difficulties submitting your application, please email recruitment@tokiomarinekiln.com.

If you are interested in this vacancy and would like to apply or find out more, please follow the links to apply. You can also share this vacancy with your network using a number of social media platforms.

rows.title: Insights Analyst, Mobile for Development
rows.descriptionText:
Team: Emerging Tech programme

Location: London, candidates must have right to work in the UK

Position type: 1 year contract (inside IR35)

What The Hiring Manager Says

‘Artificial intelligence is reshaping economies around the world but unlocking its potential in low- and middle-income countries requires robust evidence, practical insights and strong collaboration across the ecosystem. As an Insights Analyst in the EmergingTech programme, you'll join a collaborative team exploring how AI and emerging technologies can drive sustainable development. You'll contribute to research that informs industry, policymakers and donors, while developing your expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of technology and international development. This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys solving complex problems and wants to contribute to research with real-world impact.’

Eugénie Humeau, Senior Insights Manager - EmergingTech

About The Team

GSMA Mobile for Development (M4D) is a dedicated global team within the GSMA, which brings together our mobile operator members, tech innovators, the development community and governments, to prove the power of mobile in emerging markets.

The GSMA EmergingTech programme accelerates sustainable development and climate action by fostering the adoption of AI and emerging technologies in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We work with innovators across the public, private and third sectors to support the development and scaling of inclusive and responsible AI solutions.

About The Role

As an Insights Analyst, you will contribute to the delivery of high-quality research on AI and emerging technologies, helping generate evidence and insights that help address real-world challenges in LMICs. Working alongside a team of researchers and specialists, you'll contribute to every stage of the research process, from evidence gathering and analysis through to stakeholder engagement, publication and dissemination.

You'll help produce research that is rigorous, practical and influential, working with innovators, mobile operators, governments, researchers and development partners. Whether contributing to reports, analysing emerging trends, interviewing ecosystem stakeholders or developing presentations, you'll help translate complex technological developments into insights that inform decision-making.

Key Responsibilities For This Role Include

Support qualitative and quantitative research on AI and emerging technologies, including literature reviews, desk research and interviews, while working closely with Insights Managers and Senior Insights Managers.Analyse and synthesise research findings, contributing to reports, blogs, presentations, briefing papers and other knowledge products for industry, policymakers and development partners.Support the delivery of research projects by coordinating project activities, managing timelines and documentation, and liaising with external research partners and suppliers to help deliver high-quality outputs on time.Contribute to the dissemination of research findings by identifying relevant events and engagement opportunities, supporting webinars, workshops and conference activities, and developing presentations and other communication materialsMonitor developments in AI and emerging technologies, identifying relevant evidence, case studies and emerging trends that strengthen the programme's research and thought leadership.Work collaboratively across the EmergingTech programme and the wider M4D team, contributing to cross-programme research, events, thought leadership and knowledge sharing.

About You

We're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, digital innovation and international development. You'll bring strong research skills, excellent written communication and experience in (or a desire to learn about) emerging technologies and their application in low- and middle-income countries. While prior experience in every aspect of our work isn't expected, you'll be motivated to learn quickly and develop expertise in a collaborative environment.

We welcome applications from individuals with the following demonstrated qualifications and skills:

Demonstrable experience conducting or supporting qualitative and/or quantitative research, using appropriate research methodologies and synthesising evidence into clear, evidence-based insights.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyse complex evidence, apply structured approaches to research questions and extract meaningful insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing reports, presentations or other research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts in clear and accessible language.Understanding of, or strong interest in, AI, emerging technologies and their application in international development. Familiarity with the mobile ecosystem or broader digital development landscape would be advantageous.Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and contributing to multiple research projects.Comfortable engaging with stakeholders from different sectors and cultural contextsA proactive and intellectually curious approach, with a willingness to learn, take initiative and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

About Your Skills

This role is based on the following core capabilities:

Analysis – Analysis is central to this role, enabling the interpretation of evidence, identification of trends and translation of complex information into clear, actionable insights that underpin high-quality research.

Communication – Essential for producing high-quality research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to audiences across industry, government and the development ecosystem.

Delivery – Strong delivery skills ensure research activities are effectively managed, priorities are balanced and outputs are delivered to a high standard.

Agility – Agility is essential in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, enabling continuous learning, adaptability and responsiveness to emerging developments.

Teamwork – Teamwork is fundamental to the way we work, supporting effective collaboration with colleagues and partners across GSMA and the wider ecosystem.

Contract type

Short term Contractor

Worker type

Contingent Worker

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.

Being You at the GSMA

We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.

GSMA Values

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Ocean Infinity, we're on a bold mission to subsea data using innovative technology.

Using cutting-edge robotics, autonomous technology and world-class software, we're transforming how complex operations are carried out at sea. Our uncrewed systems are making ocean exploration and operations safer, smarter and more sustainable, helping unlock the vast potential of our oceans while reducing environmental impact. 🌍

This isn't a vision for the future. It's happening right now.

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and redefine what's possible in the maritime industry, we're looking for exceptional talent to join our fast-growing team.

Ocean Infinity is looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing AI team, applying cutting-edge AI to underwater sensor data including sonar, magnetometer and acoustic systems. You'll tackle high-impact challenges across ocean survey, maritime operations, asset monitoring and autonomous vessels, building production-ready AI solutions that deliver real-world impact. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role offering the opportunity to shape the future of AI in a rapidly evolving and largely untapped field

Requirements

What you will do! 🤖

 Contribute to the design and delivery of AI solutions, taking projects from exploratory research through to production-ready inference pipelines. Define the technical approach for complex AI projects, making decisions on model architectures, data strategies, evaluation frameworks, and deployment paths. Design and implement models for detection, classification, prediction, and feature extraction. Work with large-scale, often unlabelled datasets and apply self-supervised and semi-supervised learning techniques to build robust models. Adapt and fine-tune foundation models, with techniques such as active learning for domain specific challenges in maritime AI. Review code, define best practices, and champion high engineering standards across the AI team. Communicate technical progress, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.

What we look for!🔍

 You have a degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. A PhD or research background in Machine Learning or underwater sensor processing algorithms is a strong plus. You have evidence of hands-on experience in AI and Machine Learning. You are a solid Python developer with strong experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar deep learning frameworks. You have experience working with non-standard imagery data. Writing custom data loaders and curating custom datasets. You write clean, maintainable code and hold software engineering quality to the same standard as model performance. You are comfortable operating with high autonomy in ambiguous, evolving environments and can break large problems into deliverable increments. You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can explain complex AI concepts clearly

Nice to have! ✨

 Experience with self-supervised learning approaches such as DINO-style training, or joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPA). Familiarity with foundation models and their adaptation for domain-specific tasks via fine-tuning or few-shot methods. Experience working with sonar, magnetometer, acoustic or other remote-sensing data types. Knowledge of MLOps practices including experiment tracking, model versioning, containerisation, and CI/CD pipelines. Publications or contributions to the research community through journals, conferences, Kaggle competitions, or open-source projects.

Benefits

Salary £85,000 - £90,000 Per Annum*

rows.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Software engineering has moved up the stack. AI now writes a growing share of the code; the harder, more valuable work is specifying what to build, judging whether it's right, and getting it trusted into production. This programme is built for that shift.
You will join our Agentic Engineering and Build Capability CoE as part of a client squad, working alongside senior engineers and Forward Deployed Consultants on real problems: agentic systems, AI-enabled products, and the evaluation and governance that make them safe to ship. We are not training you to write code AI can already write; we are training you to do what AI cannot: understand the problem, specify it precisely, evaluate the output, and defend your reasoning to engineers and the business alike.
We are looking for graduates who can already show us this in practice. If you have built something with AI (a side project, a hackathon entry, an automation that actually runs), bring it: we will spend more time on what you built and why than on your degree.
Key Responsibilities Work inside a client squad, contributing to agentic and software engineering builds under the direction of a Forward Deployed Consultant or senior engineer.Translate business problems into clear, testable specifications: the discipline that increasingly separates good engineers from AI that writes syntactically correct but wrong code.Build and integrate AI-powered features using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic workflows.Evaluate AI-generated and AI-assisted output against defined success criteria, using evaluation harnesses and golden datasets rather than judgement alone.Apply security, governance and cost-awareness principles, including AI FinOps thinking, so what you build is reliable, scalable and safe to run.Work directly with product owners and business stakeholders to understand what "done" actually means, not just what was asked for.
About You
Skills & Knowledge A demonstrable AI engineering portfolio: personal projects, hackathons, open-source contributions or coursework where you have actually built something with AI, not just studied it.Confidence to make and defend a technical judgement call, curiosity to keep exploring how the tools are changing, and enough security in your own reasoning to say when you think an AI-generated answer is wrong.Understanding of programming fundamentals and object-oriented concepts, strong enough to read and critique AI-generated code, not just write your own.An informed view on how the software engineer's role is shifting: less time producing code, more time specifying, evaluating and taking accountability for it.Strong communication skills: able to explain a technical decision to an engineer and a business outcome to a product owner, in the same week.Comfortable working in a squad, taking direction from a Forward Deployed Consultant or technical lead, and contributing across build, evaluation and delivery.
Desirable Experience with Python or another modern language, including using AI coding assistants (such as Copilot, Claude Code or Cursor) as part of your workflow.Exposure to agentic frameworks, specification-driven development, or evaluation and testing tooling.Understanding of software development lifecycles and Agile delivery.Familiarity with version control (Git), cloud platforms or APIs.Awareness of AI governance, safety or risk concepts.Experience gained from academic projects, internships, bootcamps or personal builds, particularly anything you can show us running.
What Success Looks Like We grade AI fluency separately from technical seniority, using FDM's AI fluency framework: AI Aware, AI Productive, AI Operational, AI Orchestrating. Within your first year, successful graduates will:Progress from AI Aware to AI Productive, and be working towards AI Operational.Deliver clean, tested, production-ready code as part of a live client squad.Specify, build and evaluate agentic and RAG-based solutions that others can trust without re-checking your work.Apply governed, auditable engineering practice by default, not as an afterthought.Present technical decisions clearly and confidently to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including product owners.Build the track record that opens the door to specialist tracks such as Agentic AI Engineer (AI Orchestration), FDM's most senior technical capability.
You are: Confident enough to make a technical call and stand behind it, without needing to be told you're right.Curious about how AI is changing the craft of engineering, and genuinely interested in finding out rather than assuming you already know.Secure enough to say "I don't know" or "I think this AI output is wrong", and explain why.Collaborative, and comfortable taking direction inside a squad while still bringing your own point of view.Committed to building a portfolio of real, working things, not just credentials.Interested in the business problem behind the code: what it's actually for, and who it serves.
About Us
FDM is an award-winning global leader in tech and business talent solutions, backed by more than 35 years of industry experience. We have centres across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, and a global workforce of over 2500 employees. FDM has shown exponential growth throughout the years, firmly establishing itself as an award-winning employer, currently listed on the FTSE4Good Index and as a 2026 Financial Times UK ‘Best Employer’.
Diversity and InclusionFDM Group is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by federal, provincial or local laws.

rows.descriptionText:

In this role, you will stay on top of the latest LLM trends, build evaluation frameworks for AI features, and apply your knowledge with a product-oriented focus. You will be an integral part of the founding team, interacting directly with users to understand their needs and rapidly developing features that deliver significant value. Your work will be pivotal in scaling Granola to its next 100x growth milestone.

In This Role, You Will

Own the development and application of LLM-based features end-to-endBuild and maintain evaluation frameworks for prompt iteration and semantic retrievalOptimize embeddings and vector stores for performance and scalabilityInteract with users to understand their problems and design solutionsStay up-to-date with the latest trends in LLMs and applied AI practicesCollaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, product managers, designers, and other members to create a cutting-edge product

Your Background Looks Something Like

Engineering experience at tech and product-driven companiesShipping multi-provider LLM-based solutions to production (using e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.)Proficiency with LLM infra platforms (prompt management, logging/tracing, evals)Experience designing large-context LLM systems (RAG, knowledge graphs, hybrid search, memory)Building features end-to-end with TypeScript, React.js, and Node.js

Are first and foremost a builder.Are excited to work in-person from our office in London (most of the time)Love working in a startup environment (you either have experience working in a startup or are really drawn to the zero-to-one phase)Want to be at the cutting edge of building world-class products on top of language modelsAre fascinated by LLMs. You love to play with them, figure out what makes them tick and get them to do what you want. rows.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
At Barings, we are as invested in our associates as we are in our clients. We recognize those who work diligently for us and reward them for personal and professional integrity, communication skills, distinct competencies and expertise in specific strategies, ability to collaborate as a team member and true dedication to the interests of our clients.

We thank you for your interest in joining the Barings team, and invite you to explore our current employment opportunities.

Job Title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer

Business Title: Senior Associate

Department: Global Technology – Innovation & Data Insights

Location: London, UK

Role Summary

Barings is scaling the safe, governed adoption of AI across the firm, and the Innovation & Data Insights team within the Global Technology Division sits at the centre of that effort — pairing deep asset-management business domain knowledge with hands-on engineering to turn emerging AI capability into working solutions. We are seeking a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to embed directly with our Investment, Client & Support teams, to understand their workflows first-hand, and build AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable and tangible value.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role. You will scope and prototype rapidly, validate with the business, and ship production-grade solutions spanning automation, workflow orchestration, and client-facing tooling — using AI-native tooling across the entire lifecycle, from design and testing through to documentation. You will build on platforms such as Microsoft (Copilot, Cowork, Studio, Foundry) then work with engineering and the broader AI platform team to generalize what you learn into reusable platform capabilities.

The successful candidate combines strong business understanding across asset management with genuine software-engineering depth and daily fluency in AI-native development tools. You will be equally comfortable distilling an ambiguous business problem, writing production code, and teaching a team to use AI effectively and responsibly.

The Opportunity

Apply cutting-edge AI to complex professional settings and real investment workflows, developing deep expertise with leading LLMs.Build intimate domain expertise in how our users work — from credit agreements to lease documents — so that solutions fit the real workflow.Become a core, trusted AI advisor to our stakeholders, driving adoption, value, and growth.Optimise processes for scale by defining and continually enhancing the internal workflows that shape and improve how we work.Own problems in ambiguity, operating with autonomy in fast-moving, unstructured environments — quickly distilling complex problems, learning on the fly, and driving to actionable solutions across customer and product needs.


Key Responsibilities

Solution design & delivery

Understand the business problem first, then leverage AI tools to accelerate solution design, building analytics and modelling solutions grounded in domain expertise.Partner with Business stakeholders, and architects to design, prototype, and deliver AI-powered solutions spanning automation, workflow orchestration, and client-facing tooling.Run tasks end-to-end, from scoping and prototyping through to deployment, using AI-native tooling throughout — not just for coding, but across design, testing, and documentation.Write production code that deploys through our pipelines and meets our engineering standards.Build custom integrations, workflow automations, and domain-specific solutions on top of Barings AI platform, including connectors to business data sources and document management systems.Prototype fast, validate with the business, iterate, and ship.


Forward-deployed engagement

Own the technical relationship with the business team throughout each engagement.Support the delivery of investment, client & operational workflows, identify high-value AI use cases, and build proofs of concept that demonstrate measurable impact.Return from engagements and work with engineering and product to generalise reusable patterns into platform capabilities.Participate in architecture discussions alongside core engineering.


Enablement & training

Deliver hands-on training, office hours, demos, and documentation that teach effective and responsible use of AI tooling — including prompting practices, workflow integration, and limitations.


Platform contribution & feedback loop

Build and contribute to AI platform architecture standards, including prompt-engineering patterns, agentic workflow design, and LLM integration guidelines.Collaborate with the wider technology and AI Platform teams to specify the dependencies analytical solutions require, such as data, development environments, and tooling.Collect, structure, and synthesise user feedback, pain points, and feature requests, translating them into clear requirements and prioritised recommendations for the AI Platform team.Identify patterns across teams to surface high-impact opportunities, quantify potential impact, and highlight use cases with broader applicability across the wider AI organisation.


Responsible AI, risk & control

Champion responsible AI usage, ensuring deployments adhere to firm policies on data security, model governance, and compliance.Demonstrate conformance to all Barings Enterprise Risk Management policies.Ensure all development activities are undertaken within the defined control environment.


Required Skills & Experience

Software engineering experience with demonstrable, recent use of AI-native development tools as a core part of your daily workflow.Daily proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot.Hands-on LLM integration experience.Working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol), REST APIs, and microservices architecture.Cloud platform experience.Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar.Strong analytical skills — the ability to understand a business problem first, then apply AI tools to accelerate solution design.Strong business understanding across asset management, with relevant domain expertise across investments, operations, data, and workflows.Initiative and ownership, with a track record of running tasks end-to-end with autonomy.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience with external market providers such as Hebbia or comparable enterprise AI intelligence and agentic research platforms.Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, and Copilot Studio.Familiarity with prompt-engineering patterns and agentic workflow design.Experience building connectors to document management systems and enterprise data sources.Experience delivering enablement — training, office hours, and documentation — to non-technical audiences.


Industry Experience (Preferred)

Experience within asset management, financial services, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred. Familiarity with investment, operations, and data workflows — and with the documents that underpin them, such as credit agreements and lease documents — will help you build credibility and deliver value quickly.

Requisite Skills

Additional Skills
