rows.descriptionText:
Why Arup?

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world.  Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We solve the world's most complex problems and deliver what seems impossible, with curiosity and creativity. We’re a thriving and growing organisation which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, our Marketing, Communications, and Business Development (MCBD) team enables Arup to build and protect our reputation, deepen client relationships, win quality work, and attract top talent. This role will be key in achieving our strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to hire a Marketing Data Analyst to strengthen our MCBD function.

The Opportunity

This role is within the evolving global business development team. You will be working with business development personnel across the firm, including those responsible for the development of client systems and those running business development programmes such as the client programme, the contractor programme and initiatives identified by the Business and Markets Executive / Business Growth and Client Systems leadership. The winning of work and associated activities are key to the success of Arup, more than ever before. This is an opportunity to be part of the team enabling firm growth.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop and assist in the development of all forms of Power BI reporting utilizing CRM, finance and other data for use by the marketing, communications, business development and Business and Markets communities across Arup.  Work with leadership, MCBD and other members of the Client Systems team to define requirements for reporting, to sketch out possible solutions, and to elicit feedback once reporting has been created.  Support the coordination of the Marketing Data Warehouse. Work with our digital marketing experts on our data warehouse that stores data from our digital marketing platform, Marketo, and its evolution to encompass website and social media data. Its aim is to give a complete picture of the operation of our digital marketing channels.  Bring your expertise in reporting to support the development of CRM and other tools so that our data is best configured to produce the reporting we need.  Explore the use of AI to support development of reporting solutions as well as generate insights into our business growth department.  Collaborate with the wider ARUP’s analytics community in predictive modeling and statistical analysis projects that would help surface insights around improving our work-winning processes. 

Is this role right for me?

Requirements

 Experience in the use of Power BI plus high-level Excel skills.  Desire to grow these skills. Potential interest in languages such as Python and tools such as Databricks and SQL querying.  Experience working with CRM and/or finance data. Knowledge of how to clean data prior to processing.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to think laterally to suggest potential solutions.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. 

Qualifications And Accreditations

 Degree, postgraduate qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Knowledge Management or a related field. 

Knowledge And Experience

 Experience in data management, knowledge management and analytics.  Knowledge of client systems and software development.  Proficiency in marketing and communications related technologies, and knowledge of marketing data including bidding and clients data.  Experience in building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders.  Knowledge of current trends in AI, data information, machine learning and data quality is a plus. 

Skills And Attributes

 Skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.  Communication and interpersonal skills.  Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.  Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.  Able to build collaborative and inclusive working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.  High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership.  Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organisation’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honourable dealings. 

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact nick.newell@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit: https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

rows.title: Software Engineering Co-op

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Ambrook helps American family-run businesses become more profitable and resilient.

From volatile markets to climate shifts, independent operators face mounting pressure. While sustainable investments often yield the best long-term returns, they require financial clarity and capital that fragmented legacy systems can’t provide.

We are rebuilding the financial infrastructure that real economy operators rely on. By replacing paperwork with modern tools for accounting, banking, and spending, Ambrook gives owners the data they need to prove viability to lenders and the next generation. We empower the stewards of land and labor to make confident investments in their future.

We’re a Series B startup backed by Lachy Groom, Thrive Capital, Dylan Field, Thomson Reuters Ventures, Cameron Ventures, and leaders at Notion, Gusto, and Vercel. We’re looking for team members to help us untangle the intersection of American industry, climate, and the economy.

The Opportunity

This posting is for the spring co-op cycle, for at least 6 months from January through June 2027.

As part of our engineering co-op program, you'll work as a valued member of our team building features that directly impact farmers across America. This is an exciting opportunity to gain real-world development experience while contributing to sustainable agriculture, with mentorship from experienced engineers who are invested in your growth.

You'll also get real reps with modern AI dev tooling and with building AI products themselves. We've used AI dev tools since the earliest days of the company and stay close to the bleeding edge. Through Ambrook Labs, we're exploring AI-native features like natural language invoice drafting, voice-driven bookkeeping entry, and Desk, a task inbox that turns unstructured voice and text into organized workflows. We also speak regularly about the impact AI is having on us as people and developers, and balance marvel & enthusiasm about these tools with a respect for our craft.

We’re looking for someone who we can count on to…

Own: Build and ship real product features that customers use, while helping improve our infrastructure alongside experienced engineers. Learn: Gain experience in engineering best practices, agile development, and working across teams while discovering how agtech and climate solutions help farmers succeed. Grow: Understand the basics of agricultural finance, farm operations, and sustainability practices through hands-on project work, including how real-world financial data actually looks and how AI can help make sense of it. Contribute: Help identify ways to improve our development process and codebase while learning full-stack development. 

Within the first few weeks you’ll

Learn how to use Ambrook’s tech stack to deliver a standalone feature to our customersContribute to Engineering team meetings and review code from peers. Analyze Ambrook’s use of best practices and share a technical note with our team about where we have opportunities to improve. 

By the end of your co-op you’ll…

Collaborate with the team on core product work. Own a project from start to finish - from a technical design document through implementation. As the engineering owner, you’ll break down your project into granular pieces and practice good project management hygiene, triaging and prioritizing new issues that come in. Collaborate with our Product team to influence prioritization of feature ideas and requests with insights from our audience. Embed yourself deeply in understanding the state of farm finance, building a strong intuition about customer needs and audience segmentation. 

About You

Currently pursuing B.S. (or higher) in Computer Science or a related field. Expected graduation: Spring 2028. Available to work full-time in our NYC office for the spring co-op cycle, for at least 6 months from January through June 2027. Excited to build software that makes natural resource industries like agriculture more sustainable and profitable. Comfortable taking on ambiguous problems and creating elegant technical solutions. Exhibit strong computer science fundamentals and an eagerness to learn. Know when AI coding tools can expedite your workflows, and also when you need to dive into the code yourself. Experience with TypeScript, React, React Native, and/or Next.js. Bonus: Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or basic ML tooling. Bonus: Experience in agriculture. 

Our tech stack

Next.js / React application written in TypeScriptHosted on Google CloudFirestore & Postgres & Google Cloud Storage for data storageBigQuery & Data Studio for data insights

What Makes This Co-op Special

Make a real difference: Build features that help farmers adopt sustainable practices and grow their businesses. Experience life at a high-growth startup: See the complete product development cycle from design to deployment in a fast-paced environment. Get personalized mentorship: Work directly with senior engineers who are invested in your growth. Join a mission-driven team: Experience startup culture while helping build the future of sustainable agriculture. Work closely with customers: Your work will help real farms and agribusinesses across America succeed - and you'll get to meet some of them. 

Values

Real Talk – We create space for ourselves and others to be straightforward, vulnerable, and accountable. Reach Understanding – We are driven by curiosity and empathy to learn about our customers, team, and world. Be Proactively Resourceful – We are internally motivated and externally empowered to identify opportunities and solve problems. Derisk Thoughtfully – We lean into the biggest risks we face as a company and put in the work to address them systematically. Find the Positive-Sum – We believe in creating incentive structures that align the needs of our company, our customers, and our planet. 

Ambrook is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building diversity and inclusion into our core company culture.

Ambrook can support visa sponsorship (OPT/CPT, TN, J-1) for eligible candidates.

rows.title: Regional Campaign Manager

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Riders Alliance is a grassroots advocacy organization that builds the power of transit riders to win better public transportation. Since our founding in 2012, we’ve grown a small, collaborative staff and a membership base of more than 50,000 riders, winning major campaigns including Fair Fares and congestion pricing. The Regional Campaign Manager will lead the development of Riders Alliance’s first campaign focused on improving commuter rail and public transit in strategic communities beyond New York City’s five boroughs. Working as part of the fundraising and organizational development team and collaborating closely with colleagues across the organization, the Regional Campaign Manager will build relationships with regional riders and supporters, create meaningful opportunities for them to participate in advocacy; and develop a growing constituency for fast, frequent, affordable, and reliable regional transit.
Key Responsibilities
Build Riders Alliance’s first regional campaign, including driving campaign strategy and goals. Work with organizational leadership and colleagues across teams to develop and advance the campaign’s goals, strategy, priorities, and tactics.Manage campaign implementation. Maintain work plans, timelines, budgets, expenses, events and logistics for campaign activities.Develop a regional constituency for better transit. Identify and engage riders, civic leaders, and other prospective members and supporters who are motivated to improve commuter rail and regional transit service, affordability, reliability, and connections. Build strategic relationships and partnerships. Develop and facilitate connections with community organizations, civic institutions, labor unions, journalists, elected officials, and other potential allies that can expand the campaign’s reach and influence. Create accessible and varied pathways for participation. Design opportunities for new members and allies to contribute through 1:1 meetings, community and social events, canvassing, digital outreach, and campaign activities, maintaining data and tracking engagement against strategic goals. Cultivate donors and transit champions. Partner with colleagues on the fundraising team to identify and engage prospective donors, including individuals who may support Riders Alliance at the Conductors Council level and/or serve as grass tops voices to influence key elected officials.Connect regional and city transit priorities over time. Help regional members and leaders understand New York’s transit network as an interconnected system and, as relationships deepen, create opportunities for them to support shared priorities impacting riders across the region, including NYC’s bus and subway service. Collaborate across the organization. Coordinate closely with the organizing, policy, and communications teams to exchange knowledge, align strategies, and devise tactics, ensuring the regional campaign is aligned with Riders Alliance’s broader mission and priorities.
Salary: $75,000 - $80,000
Employment type: Full-time, 40-hours a week (with some schedule flexibility). We are currently a hybrid office.
Benefits: Riders Alliance offers employer premium support for medical and dental insurance, vision insurance, 403(b) retirement account with generous employer match, life insurance, access to commuter benefits, and more.
Expectations: Riders Alliance is entering an exciting new chapter. Alongside our continued work organizing bus and subway riders across New York City, we are expanding our organizing beyond the five boroughs to build a stronger regional constituency for public transit. We’re looking for a new team member who is excited to help shape this work from the ground up: building relationships in communities served by commuter rail, developing new rider leaders, and creating a shared sense of identity and power among riders whose trips and communities are connected by the same regional transit system. We aspire to a workplace culture characterized by effective communication, collaboration, creativity, and a shared commitment to ambitious, strategic goals and are excited to have a new member join us!
QualificationsValues making public transit more reliable, accessible, affordable, and truly world-classMeaningful experience as a volunteer or professional in a political campaign, community organizing, and or fundraising effortEntrepreneurial, self-motivated, and creative approach to projects and community building Ability to prioritize and juggle multiple assignmentsHighly organized and attentive to detail, especially names and numbersClear, concise, compelling communication skillsDemonstrated innovative thinking and problem-solving abilities Proficiency using a CRM for relationship and communication management Experience with online project management tools such as Asana, Trello, or Mondays a plus
How to apply:Please send a thoughtful cover letter and resume to hr@ridersalliance.org with the subject line: “Regional Campaign Manager.”Applications are considered on a rolling basis; early applications are encouraged.
Riders Alliance values variety in backgrounds and in experiences that are reflective of the city it serves. Applicants of all backgrounds are strongly encouraged and welcomed to apply.

rows.descriptionText:
About Pagaya

Shape the Future of Finance

Pagaya is building a leading artificial intelligence network to help our partners grow their businesses and better serve their customers.

Pagaya is a global technology company making life-changing financial products and services available to more people nationwide, as it reshapes the financial services ecosystem. By using machine learning, a vast data network and a sophisticated AI-driven approach, Pagaya provides comprehensive consumer credit and residential real estate solutions for its partners, their customers, and investors. Its proprietary API and capital solutions integrate into its network of partners to deliver seamless user experiences and greater access to the mainstream economy. Pagaya has offices in New York and Tel Aviv. For more information, visit pagaya.com.

Let's create better outcomes together!

As a Business Development Associate at Pagaya, you will be the engine driving our top-of-funnel growth. You will identify, map, and engage senior executives (C-Suite, VPs of Lending, and Heads of Risk) across financial institutions, personal loan originators, and fintech companies. Your primary goal is to book highly qualified introductory meetings for our Commercial and Partnerships Directors.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Prospecting: Research and identify high-value target financial institutions, automotive lenders, and fintech innovators matching Pagaya's ideal client profile. Multi-Channel Outreach: Execute structured outreach campaigns using cold calling, high-touch personalized emails, professional network sourcing, and other tools. Turn this outreach and data into client key decision-maker maps—identifying who we need to know and the ultimate person who needs to say yes. Consultative Value Selling: Articulate Pagaya's complex AI capabilities and credit ecosystem benefits clearly to executive decision-makers. Answer the problem we are solving for each of our prospects, why PGY has a right to win, and turn those insights into materials the sales leads can leverage. Lead Qualification: Conduct early discovery calls to evaluate a prospect's current credit challenges, originations volume, and technical capabilities. Pipeline Management: Maintain meticulous, up-to-date data quality in Salesforce to track account interactions, objections, and follow-up metrics. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with Growth, Partners, and Product Leads teams to convert inbound interest and optimize outbound sales playbooks. 

Qualifications

Experience: 1–3 years of sales experience, preferably in FinTech, B2B SaaS, or financial services. Communication Powerhouse: Flawless written and verbal communication skills. You must feel comfortable holding peer-to-peer conversations with corporate financial executives. Fintech Mindset: You are AI-fluent with consumer credit markets, banking systems, or financial models. Tech Stack Savvy: Experience using CRM and prospecting tools like Salesforce, ZoomInfo, or Salesloft is highly preferred. Resilience & Grit: A self-motivated builder who views "no" as data rather than failure, thriving in a high-activity, hyper-growth environment. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field preferred. 

The pay ranges for New York-based hires are commensurate with candidate experience. 

Pay ranges for candidates working in locations other than New York may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

Compensation Range for New York Based Hires

$130,000—$170,000 USD

Our Team

Pagaya was founded in 2016 by seasoned research, finance, and technology entrepreneurs with our head quarters located in NYC and Tel Aviv.

We move fast and smart, identifying new opportunities and building end-to-end solutions from AI models and unique data sources. Every Pagaya team member is solving new and exciting challenges every day in a culture based on partnership, collaboration, and community.

Join a team of builders who are working every day to enable better outcomes for our partners and their customers.

Our Values

Continuously Learn- We challenge ourselves for the sake of getting better as individuals, as teams, and as an organization to deliver for our partners.Debate and Commit- We respectfully and openly debate to strengthen our ideas and build shared conviction - once we decide, we go all in, together.Dream Big and Act- We boldly tackle complex problems, pressure-test solutions in real-time, and adapt with speed and energy.Advance Inclusion- We create a world where everyone can win, designing systems that better represent people and generate sustainable value for our employees, partners and investors.Be Accountable Together- We proudly own our actions and our results, taking initiative to ensure our work gets over the finish line as a team.

More than just a job

We believe health, happiness, and productivity go hand-in-hand. That's why we're continually looking to enhance the ways we support you with benefits programs and perks that allow every Pagayan to do the best work of their life.

How we work together

You will work closely with Client Leaders and colleagues across Aon’s local, regional, and global teams. Success in this role requires thoughtful analysis, clear communication, curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to delivering useful insights and positive client outcomes.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $85,000 - $100,000 annually. As a Product Operations Associate supporting Flights Fulfillment, you’ll help support the operational health, servicing quality, and post-booking performance of Capital One’s Flights platform across the post-booking customer journey. You’ll work closely with Senior Associates within Product Operations, Customer Service, Product, Engineering, Commercial teams, booking providers, and internal stakeholders to help ensure reliable servicing workflows, scalable automation performance, and seamless customer experiences across Capital One Travel products.

In this role, you’ll assist with day-to-day operational processes across the post-booking lifecycle, including schedule changes, cancellations, exchanges, refunds, seats, ticketing support, servicing escalations, and operational investigations. You’ll also contribute to initiatives focused on operational quality, automation improvements, servicing efficiency, and customer experience enhancements.

You’ll contribute to bug investigations, operational escalations, and servicing-related issues across booking environments while partnering with cross-functional teams to support issue resolution and continuous improvement efforts. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, technically curious, customer-focused, data-driven, has a strong bias for action, and excited to grow within a fast-paced travel technology environment.

As part of the team’s continued evolution, you’ll also gain exposure to modern automation and AI-powered operational tools used to improve monitoring, workflow efficiency, operational reporting, and issue investigation across the Flights platform.

Problem Solving. Approaches operational issues thoughtfully and works collaboratively to identify solutions, escalate risks, and improve processes. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and learning through hands-on experience. Technical Curiosity. Interested in learning modern travel technology platforms and operational systems. Comfortable working with technical teams and eager to build familiarity with APIs, servicing environments, monitoring tools, and booking systems. AI Fluency & Operational Innovation. Communicates clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Able to document findings, share updates, and support operational coordination across teams. Continuous Learning. Motivated to grow within product and travel operations. Open to feedback, eager to develop technical and operational expertise, and interested in learning emerging technologies and industry trends. 

Why Capital One Travel:

Capital One Travel is reimagining how cardholders discover, book, and experience travel. We operate at the intersection of fintech and travel tech, building products that leverage Capital One’s unique data and rewards ecosystem to deliver outsized value to customers. Our vacation rentals vertical is a high-growth area with significant strategic importance, and this role offers the opportunity to shape its trajectory from the ground up.

We are an AI-forward team. We don’t just talk about AI—we build with it every day. If you are excited about using cutting-edge tools to move faster and build better products, you’ll find a home here.

rows.title: Senior Analyst - Marketing Enablement

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As marketers at one of the most iconic brands in the world, we play a major role in building authentic relationships with customers who impact life and business around the world. Here, creativity and inspired storytelling combine with powerful data-based marketing and hyper-personalized digital communication to create a genuine human connection that drives business results. As a part of our diverse community of marketers, you can have a breadth of different marketing experiences and do virtually anything from connecting small businesses to new customers to uncovering insights that inspire the future of payments. Create a dynamic career while doing work that matters for people and businesses everywhere. Find your place in marketing on #TeamAmex.

How will you make an impact in this role?

The U.S. Consumer Services Team (USCS) is responsible for our suite of consumer products, services, and experiences in the U.S., including our premium, cobrand, cash back, and lending portfolios, Membership Rewards, Global Travel & Lifestyle Services, the Centurion Lounge network, our Global Dining and Resy businesses, U.S. Consumer Banking, and best-in-class marketing programs across customer, prospect, and partner channels. The USCS team is focused on making membership an indisputable competitive advantage and helping each other become better leaders every day.

The U.S. Consumer Marketing team (USCM) is part of the U.S. Consumer Services Group and is responsible for making membership essential by creating and delivering world class marketing for our differentiated products and services that drives demand and inspires engaged card members across the customer lifecycle.

The Senior Analyst of Marketing Enablement is responsible for overseeing and maintaining a portfolio of marketing campaigns across multiple channels – sometimes executed in partnership with external brands such as hospitality, travel, or financial industry partners. This role will drive compliant, high-quality and on-time end-to-end campaign execution delivery as a central source of expertise of our internal marketing capabilities and the channels/experiences they own. This individual will ensure marketing strategies are met by assessing nuances, scope, and feasibility to translate into launch milestones. This role will collaborate closely with various teams within US Consumer Marketing, Enterprise Communications & MarTech Experiences (ECMX), Governance and Compliance Partners, and various channel execution teams to support campaign setup. This role will also develop process efficiencies to deliver on the marketing plan with excellence and innovate core execution processes to improve efficiency, quality, and speed-to-market. This role will also support 6 contractors who implement the end-to-end marketing campaigns.

Responsibilities

Own a portfolio of marketing campaigns designed to drive incremental revenue and customer engagement, managing end-to-end campaign set up and deliveryManage end-to-end campaign execution for one or more channels on an ad hoc basisHelp support a team of contractors tasked with end-to-end marketing campaign set up and delivery in their respective channelsPartner with marketing, operations and external partner teams to understand campaign objectives, develop go to market execution and testing plans, and implement marketing campaigns (including offer constructs and execution strategy for new offers, product launches and refreshes) to engage customers across owned and partner channelsCollaborate with stakeholders on messaging and creative development process, owning reviews with internal stakeholders and approvals with brand, legal and complianceDevelop and maintain campaign execution calendars and track team capacityParticipate in campaign results analyses, understanding customer behavior and providing actionable recommendations on how to improve performance against goalsUphold our control management priorities by driving operational excellence across our risk management processAssist with hiring and training of new contractors and peers; mentoring on ways of working and best practicesMaintain expertise in Marketingforce and support new platform enhancements and integration

Qualifications

Project management experience and organization skills, with the ability to manage tight and evolving timelines across multiple priorities to deliver flawless executionStrong attention to detail, serving as a process-focused thinkerEffective written and verbal communication skills, building and leveraging relationships to create solutionsStrong mix of analytical and critical thinking skills to implement impactful solutions that drive resultsHigh curiosity with a desire to learn and be part of a fast-paced, dynamic teamDemonstrate collaborative approaches to drive a project/initiative to completion, contributing to a team culture that promotes teamwork and funMarketing campaign execution preferredExperience with onboarding, training, and/or people management is a plusBachelor's Degree Preferred

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

rows.title: Marketing Analytics - Data Analyst - July 2027 Start Date - ADP

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive patient and provider marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.

The Role

We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of data analysts through our Analytics Development Program.

The Marketing Data Analyst (MDA) is a member of the internal analytics team focused on product analytics. This team’s primary function is to produce the analytical reports that are incorporated into Veeva Crossix products and shared with customers.

What this role is (and isn’t):

What it IS: A data analytics role. You will be part of our internal analytics team, focusing on backend report generation, quality control, and pressure-testing results. Using SQL, Excel, and our proprietary coding language, you will link marketing data to health data, transforming large datasets into core analytical reports embedded in Veeva Crossix products. Your work will be used to generate the insights our customers use to make business decisions.What it IS NOT: This is not a client-facing consulting role. If you want to spend your days in external client meetings, presenting slide decks, and advising on marketing strategies, check out the Client Services Associate track. This is also not a software engineering role - your focus is on data logic, manipulation, and insights, not building software architecture.

This role is part of Generation Veeva, and as such you can expect:

A “learn by doing” environment with challenging and impactful work, where you will be expected to learn quickly and deliver earlyA collaborative work environment where you will work closely with many levels of our team, from other early-career professionals through senior leadersMentorship and continuous professional development opportunities, aiding in your immediate and long-term success at Veeva

The anticipated start date is July 2027. 

The Analytics Development Program offers two distinct paths. Please review our other track, the Client Services Associate role, to choose the best fit for your skills and interests.

We welcome you to apply to all roles that align with your skills and interests. See all open opportunities here: Generation Veeva Careers

What You'll Do

Produce Analytics Reports: Own the end-to-end execution, rigorous quality control, and timely delivery of high-value, recurring analytical reports across a large portfolio.Link Complex Datasets: Connect marketing exposure data to massive, transactional healthcare datasets. Your data manipulation will provide the analytical foundation that helps pharmaceutical and life sciences companies optimize their marketing efforts and ultimately improve patient outcomes.Formulate Analytical Hypotheses: Transform complex client questions into hypotheses that are testable using SQL, Excel, and Crossix’s proprietary analytical coding language.Partner Internally with Client Services: Communicate the technical results and methodology of marketing campaign analyses to our Client Services teams, acting as the subject-matter expert on the underlying data logic.Master Modern Data Tools: Leverage a robust toolkit including SQL, advanced Excel, data visualization suites, and internal platforms to clean, manipulate, and present data effectively.

REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for graduates who meet the following requirements:

Technical Foundation: Intermediate proficiency in SQL, Python, or a comparable coding language. You have a natural comfort with data structures and a knack for logical, step-by-step problem-solving.High Drive & Performance: A self-starter with a track record of excellence who thrives in a demanding and dynamic environment, and is hungry for rapid professional growth.Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision and a commitment to rigorous quality control. You take pride in catching small errors before they impact the final product.Effective Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively share technical insights and methodology with our internal client services teams.Academic Excellence: Bachelor’s degree (any major) with a 3.0 – 4.0 GPA, demonstrating the intellectual curiosity, time management, and work ethic necessary for a high-performance analytics career.Experience Level: This role is designed for upcoming or recent graduates with 0–2 years of post-grad full-time work experience. Location & Presence: You live within about a 45-60 minute commute of our NYC office (or plan to be by your start date) and look forward to collaborating with the team on-site 4 days a week.Unwavering Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company. We hold ourselves to high ethical standards and expect honesty and integrity from every team member.

THE PROCESS | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:

Application & Assessment: You submit your resume, responses to a few short application questions, and complete a brief online assessment.Application Response (Within 1 Week): We review every application thoroughly. Within about one week of submission, we will notify you via email whether we’d like to move you to the next stage.Initial Interview: You will participate in a 60-minute job interview with a senior member of our team.Case Interview: If we proceed following your initial interview, you will complete an analytics case exercise. This will be a live demonstration of your skills, with no prework required.Final Decision (Within 1 Week): Within about one week of completing your case exercise, we will either extend an official offer or let you know that we are not moving forward.Your Decision (2 Weeks): If extended an offer, you will have two weeks to make your final decision. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview for other roles would be an ethical violation in our view.

Perks & Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insuranceFlexible PTO and company paid holidaysRetirement programs1% charitable giving program

Compensation

Starting base pay: $82,500

Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT, or TN status) for this employment position.

#WU

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

Business Unit:

Financial And Valuation Advisory

Industry:

Portfolio Valuation

Overview

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.

Financial and Valuation Advisory

Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Fund Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.

Scope:

Within our Portfolio Valuation Complex Securities practice, our clients include many of the world’s largest hedge funds, private equity funds, direct lending funds, business development companies, among other asset managers, and we advise them on the valuations of illiquid debt, equity and complex securities in order to meet their investor and regulatory financial reporting requirements. Our market-leading practice has a strong reputation with regulators, auditors, and investors and we rapidly mobilize the right team for the job, drawing on our expertise in a wide variety of asset classes and industries, along with our firm’s real-world transaction experience and market knowledge.

Financial Analysts within our Portfolio Valuation & Advisory Services practice are fully integrated members of our engagement teams. You will work with a dedicated, highly talented staff of professionals who will give you broad exposure to many issues and concerns affecting businesses today. With a focus in Complex Securities, you will work closely with a smaller and specialized team dedicated in utilizing sophisticated models in valuating securities with complex structure.

We offer a unique opportunity to work on a wealth of projects that provide exposure to various financial and valuation advisory challenges, including the valuation of complex businesses, securities, and transaction structures. As a Financial Analyst, you will research and analyze financial markets data, financial statements, industry conditions and developments, acquisitions and divestitures, and various investment attributes of publicly traded and privately held securities. You will also have an opportunity to develop complex financial models, draft client deliverables, participate in presenting analyses and conclusions, interact with clients on active engagements, and participate in the firm’s marketing efforts.

Responsibilities:

Analyzing and valuing various derivatives, structured products, loans, private equity, and other illiquid securities.Determining relevant valuation assumptions based on historical performance, collateral type, and economic scenarios.Utilizing various accepted financial models, including guideline companies and guideline transactions, discounted cash flows, and Black-Scholes models and extensions, solved with lattice models or simulation analysis, and other such frameworks to derive value indications.Performing market research; calibrating proprietary valuation models to incorporate market-based assumptions, including home price appreciation, prepayment rates, and foreclosure timelines.Reviewing and compiling published financial information, such as industry research reports, remittance data, and Bloomberg data across a wide range of asset classes.Assisting in the preparation of client deliverables including pitch materials and information requests.Participating in due diligence meetings/discussions and assisting in responding to auditor questions regarding valuation analyses prepared by Houlihan Lokey.Participating in presenting valuation analyses and conclusions internally to review committees, externally to our clients’ senior management and boards of directors, and to fiduciaries.Performing financial-statement and other quantitative and qualitative assessments as required.Researching and providing initial draft on (a) general economic conditions, (b) industry-specific conditions and trends, and (c) various investment attributes of illiquid securities.Assisting with sales and marketing initiatives for prospective and existing clients.Performing other ad-hoc research, analytics, and support for the FVA project teams as required.

Basic Qualifications

Minimum of one year of work experience at an accounting or valuation firm in a valuation capacity.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or Applied EconomicsStrong analytical abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

Previous working experience in financial reporting valuation, especially complex securitiesMaster’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., finance, statistics, mathematics, economics, engineering).Strong knowledge of financial instruments, derivative valuation theory, and statistical methods.Experience in valuing financial instruments with non-linear payoffs—including convertible bonds, warrants, derivatives, earn-outs, and complex capital structures—using closed-form solutions, binomial lattices, and Monte Carlo simulations in Python, R, or MATLAB.Strong analytical abilities including demonstrated ability to build complex numerical models using coding technics to value varied derivatives. Demonstrated history of building and improving models and processes to automate routine calculations using Python and VBA.Proficiency in working with large data sets, performing statistical analyses in Python, and presenting results using data visualization tools.Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex financial models to determine the key assumptions, implicit caveats and limitations.Strong knowledge of Excel, Python and other related tools used to build valuation models.Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to prepare reports and presentations to team and clients, including graphic and written sections.Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with team members.Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.An exceptional work ethic and attention to detailAbility to manage multiple projects and interact with clients and internal management.Knowledge of and experience with statistical packages and data sources such as Python, R, VBA, Excel, Microsoft Office, Fincad, CapitalIQ, Refinitiv, and Bloomberg

Compensation And Benefits

Houlihan Lokey is committed to providing its employees with an exciting career opportunity and competitive total compensation package, which may include other components such as discretionary incentive compensation. The firm’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the possible salary range for this role at the time of posting is:

$75,000 - $120,000

rows.title: Finance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

Position Summary

The Finance Analyst provides financial reporting, analysis, and planning support across EPO Operations, Commercial, and Engineering. Working closely with the FP&A & Cost Manager, this role supports forecasting, budgeting, cost management, and commercial profitability analysis while monitoring key financial and operational performance metrics. The position provides timely, accurate, and actionable financial insights to support day-to-day business decisions and improve business performance.

Essential Functions

Financial Reporting & Analysis

 Prepare recurring financial reports and analysis supporting EPO Operations, Commercial, Engineering, and functional leadership Analyze actual financial performance against forecast, budget and prior year, identifying key variances and drivers Prepare monthly reporting packages, dashboards and management reports Monitor orders, sales, profitability, costs and other key financial and operational KPIs Perform ad hoc financial analysis to support business decisions and management requests Translate financial data into clear and actionable insights Maintain accurate and timely financial reporting and ensure consistency across reporting systems and tools

Financial Planning & Forecasting

 Support EPO’s annual budget/AOP and current-year forecasting processes, including data gathering, analysis, modeling, and consolidation of inputs Maintain financial models and schedules used in monthly forecasting and budgeting Prepare variance analysis and supporting schedules for forecast and budget reviews Track changes in revenue, volume, pricing, mix, material costs, labor, overhead, and other key financial assumptions Support scenario analysis and sensitivity analysis related to current-year business performance Assist with Orders, Backlog, Sales, and profitability forecasting Maintain forecast tracking and identify changes in business assumptions that may impact financial results

Commercial Finance & Profitability

 Support analysis of revenue, margins, and profitability across products, customers and markets Prepare pricing and margin analysis using current cost inputs and business assumptions Support Commercial teams with pricing analysis, bid/proposal analysis, and customer profitability analysis Analyze price, volume, mix and cost impacts on financial performance Track pricing and margin improvement performance and assist in identifying margin improvement opportunities Support annual price increase analysis Assist with analysis of customer contracts, rebates, incentives, and other commercial arrangements Analyze product mix and SKU-level margins and identify trends or areas requiring additional investigation Prepare customer and product profitability reporting as assigned

Cost Accounting & Operations Finance

 Support month-end close activities related to inventory, cost of goods sold, manufacturing variances, and journal entries Analyze manufacturing variances including material, burden, labor, purchase price and absorption Maintain and reconcile inventory and cost accounting data Support standard costing activities, including annual cost roll, labor and burden rates, and ad hoc cost rolls Support physical inventory activities and inventory valuation processes Analyze manufacturing KPIs and identify operational trends impacting financial performance Support analysis of productivity initiatives, sourcing savings, inventory optimization, and other cost improvement activities Assist with financial analysis supporting capital expenditures and operational investments Support internal and external audit requests and maintain compliance with applicable accounting policies and controls

Business Partnership

 Serve as a Finance resource to Operations, Commercial and Engineering for day-to-day financial questions and analysis Provide timely analysis to help business partners understand the financial impact of operational and commercial decisions Partner with cross-function teams to gather information, validate assumptions, and improve the accuracy of financial reporting and forecasts Develop strong understanding of site operations, products, customers, cost drivers and commercial activities

Reporting, Data & Process Improvement

 Develop and maintain financial reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using JDE, Excel, BI tools and other reporting systems Automate and improve recurring reporting and analysis processes to increase efficiency and accuracy Maintain data integrity across systems and reporting tools Identify opportunities to simplify financial processes and improve reporting accuracy and timeliness Document recurring processes and maintain appropriate supporting documentation Assist with implementation and improvement of Finance processes, systems and reporting tools

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Education

 Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required

Experience And Competencies

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail Demonstrates the highest standards of integrity and professionalism Strong knowledge of GAAP accounting and general accounting concepts Excellent communication skills and high confidence in stating professional opinions Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel Demonstrated ability to streamline and automate complex processes Continuous improvement mindset High degree of integrity and professionalism Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and SOX internal controls

Physical Environment and Environmental Factors

Office Environment

This position operates in a manufacturing office setting and involves regular use of standard office equipment. The role requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while performing computer-based tasks. The employee will occasionally move about the office or nearby production areas to access equipment, attend meetings, or communicate with team members. The individual must be able to communicate effectively with coworkers and external parties in person, over the phone, and through digital platforms.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. IDEX is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

Total Rewards

The compensation range for this position is $54,200.00 - $81,400.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.

Benefits Package

Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page: https://www.idexcorp.com/careers/our-benefits-and-rewards/

Business Unit:

Financial And Valuation Advisory

Industry:

Overview

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.

Financial and Valuation Advisory

Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Fund Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.

Scope:

Within our Portfolio Valuation Complex Securities practice, our clients include many of the world’s largest hedge funds, private equity funds, direct lending funds, business development companies, among other asset managers, and we advise them on the valuations of illiquid debt, equity and complex securities in order to meet their investor and regulatory financial reporting requirements. Our market-leading practice has a strong reputation with regulators, auditors, and investors and we rapidly mobilize the right team for the job, drawing on our expertise in a wide variety of asset classes and industries, along with our firm’s real-world transaction experience and market knowledge.

Financial Analysts within our Portfolio Valuation & Advisory Services practice are fully integrated members of our engagement teams. You will work with a dedicated, highly talented staff of professionals who will give you broad exposure to many issues and concerns affecting businesses today. With a focus in Complex Securities, you will work closely with a smaller and specialized team dedicated in utilizing sophisticated models in valuating securities with complex structure.

We offer a unique opportunity to work on a wealth of projects that provide exposure to various financial and valuation advisory challenges, including the valuation of complex businesses, securities, and transaction structures. As a Financial Analyst, you will research and analyze financial markets data, financial statements, industry conditions and developments, acquisitions and divestitures, and various investment attributes of publicly traded and privately held securities. You will also have an opportunity to develop complex financial models, draft client deliverables, participate in presenting analyses and conclusions, interact with clients on active engagements, and participate in the firm’s marketing efforts.

Responsibilities:

Analyzing and valuing various derivatives, structured products, loans, private equity, and other illiquid securities.Determining relevant valuation assumptions based on historical performance, collateral type, and economic scenarios.Utilizing various accepted financial models, including guideline companies and guideline transactions, discounted cash flows, and Black-Scholes models and extensions, solved with lattice models or simulation analysis, and other such frameworks to derive value indications.Performing market research; calibrating proprietary valuation models to incorporate market-based assumptions, including home price appreciation, prepayment rates, and foreclosure timelines.Reviewing and compiling published financial information, such as industry research reports, remittance data, and Bloomberg data across a wide range of asset classes.Assisting in the preparation of client deliverables including pitch materials and information requests.Participating in due diligence meetings/discussions and assisting in responding to auditor questions regarding valuation analyses prepared by Houlihan Lokey.Participating in presenting valuation analyses and conclusions internally to review committees, externally to our clients’ senior management and boards of directors, and to fiduciaries.Performing financial-statement and other quantitative and qualitative assessments as required.Researching and providing initial draft on (a) general economic conditions, (b) industry-specific conditions and trends, and (c) various investment attributes of illiquid securities.Assisting with sales and marketing initiatives for prospective and existing clients.Performing other ad-hoc research, analytics, and support for the FVA project teams as required.

Basic Qualifications

Minimum of one year of work experience at an accounting or valuation firm in a valuation capacity.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or Applied EconomicsStrong analytical abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

Previous working experience in financial reporting valuation, especially complex securitiesMaster’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., finance, statistics, mathematics, economics, engineering).Strong knowledge of financial instruments, derivative valuation theory, and statistical methods.Experience in valuing financial instruments with non-linear payoffs—including convertible bonds, warrants, derivatives, earn-outs, and complex capital structures—using closed-form solutions, binomial lattices, and Monte Carlo simulations in Python, R, or MATLAB.Strong analytical abilities including demonstrated ability to build complex numerical models using coding technics to value varied derivatives. Demonstrated history of building and improving models and processes to automate routine calculations using Python and VBA.Proficiency in working with large data sets, performing statistical analyses in Python, and presenting results using data visualization tools.Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex financial models to determine the key assumptions, implicit caveats and limitations.Strong knowledge of Excel, Python and other related tools used to build valuation models.Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to prepare reports and presentations to team and clients, including graphic and written sections.Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with team members.Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.An exceptional work ethic and attention to detailAbility to manage multiple projects and interact with clients and internal management.Knowledge of and experience with statistical packages and data sources such as Python, R, VBA, Excel, Microsoft Office, Fincad, CapitalIQ, Refinitiv, and Bloomberg

Compensation And Benefits

Houlihan Lokey is committed to providing its employees with an exciting career opportunity and competitive total compensation package, which may include other components such as discretionary incentive compensation. The firm’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the possible salary range for this role at the time of posting is:

$75,000 - $120,000

Actual salary at the time of hire may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant qualifications, skills, and experience, as well as the service line and location where this position may be filled.

Quantitative Data Analytics Program (QDAP) 

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference.

Quantitative Data Summer Analyst Program Overview

The Quantitative Data Summer Analytics Program is a 10-week Summer internship and precursor for the Global Quantitative Data Analytics Program designed to develop and coach quantitative and analytical talent.

As an intern, you will complete on-the-desk work with your assigned team and apply quantitative and analytical methods to specific financial challenges. Throughout the internship, you will engage in challenging projects and opportunities to advance your career and development in addition to engaging in learning and professional development opportunities, networking and volunteer events, mentorship, speaker series, and more.

The Quantitative Data Analyst Program extends across five lines of business. In your role, you will support the specific business you are hired into. The businesses include:

Global Risk ManagementChief Financial Officer GroupEnterprise CreditConsumer & Small Business BankingAnalytics, Modeling & Insights

What You’ll Do – Explore Potential Roles

Below you will find the job profiles/roles for QDAP. When completing the application, you will have the opportunity to stack rank the profile of interest.

Quantitative Analyst: Apply mathematical and statistical models to understand and solve financial and risk management problems; skills include but are not limited to financial and mathematical modeling, specifically proficiencies in programming languages including Python, C++, R, MATLAB and/or JAVAData Analyst: Broad responsibilities for collecting, cleaning, analyzing data, and extracting insights without necessarily specializing in complex model development; skills include but are not limited to data structures, data integration and data cleaning, specifically proficiencies in data visualization tools including Tableau, Hadoop and/or PowerBI and programming languages including Python, R, SQL and/or Java

Location

Extracting, processing, and interpreting data to support decision-making, including the potential for complex modelingConducting research and analysis, including assessing internal and public data, to provide a micro view of risk and/or financial management in a particular business line and a macro view for the organizationApplying quantitative and analytical knowledge to specific financial challenges and projects specific to your business alignment

Data management includes internal and regulatory reporting as well as partnering with the credit technology transformation team to ensure data and appropriate controls are built into credit systems to drive transparency and support digitization.


Consumer & Small Business

Consumer & Small Business Banking drives strategic growth initiatives across core business units to serve client and business needs. The group supports high priority strategic initiatives that span functions such as strategy, product management, digital, marketing, sales enablement, operations, payments and analytics. Description

 Duties Description 

The Research Scientist will work within the Bureau of Quality Measurement and Outcomes Research and will assist in a broad range of research, analysis, reporting, and evaluation activities. The Research Scientist will work under the direction of a senior level research scientist and will perform various activities to promote health care quality and patient safety related to the Nursing Home Quality Initiative and Home and Community Based Services Quality Measure Set Reporting. Responsibilities will include: contribute to the development, analysis, reporting, and evaluation of process, performance, and quality measures; write and/or update measurement methodologies and incorporate measure changes into SAS programs; run SAS and/or SQL programs to extract the required data elements, conduct necessary analysis, review output for accuracy, and report results to senior staff; prepare results for target audiences that are appropriate and accurate; develop a robust and high-quality analytic approach in response to questions, develop an understanding of various data sources, including but not limited to Minimum Data Set 3.0 (MDS), Statewide Planning and Research Cooperative System (SPARCS), Payroll Based Journal (PBJ), and Medicaid Data Warehouse (MDW); collaborate with other research scientists and contribute to publicly released reports; conduct literature reviews to inform research question development and appropriate analytical approaches; write or run SAS/SQL programs to extract, link, manipulate, and analyze data using descriptive and inferential statistical methods; review output for accuracy and report results to senior staff; assist in the preparation of reports, briefs, and peer-reviewed manuscripts, as well as other deliverables that are accurate, professional, and easy to understand.

If appointed as an Assistant Research Scientist, the incumbent will assist other research staff with these duties; if appointed as a Research Scientist 1 level, the incumbent will be expected to perform these duties under general supervision; if appointed as a Research Scientist 2, the incumbent will work with more independence.

Qualifications

 Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in analytics, bio-informatics, biostatistics, computer science, economics, engineering, engineering, epidemiology, finance, genetics, health economics, mathematics, physics, public administration and policy, public health, social sciences, statistics, or a related degree and one year of professional research experience* in an appropriate field.

Bachelor's degree or higher in analytics, bio-informatics, biostatistics, computer science, economics, engineering, engineering, epidemiology, finance, genetics, health economics, mathematics, physics, public administration and policy, public health, social sciences, statistics or a related field and two years of professional research experience* in an appropriate field.

Research Scientist 2 ((Biostatistics /Health Services Research), SG22

Position Summary/Overview:The Department of Population Health Science and Policy at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai is seeking a full-time Postdoctoral Fellow to work with Dr. Katharine McCarthy on the ASPIRE (Adolescent School Policy Interventions for caRdiovascular Equity) study. The project examines how school environments shape adolescent cardiovascular health and future maternal health outcomes.
Working with a multidisciplinary team—including systems science investigators, epidemiologists, qualitative researchers and community stakeholders—the fellow will conduct longitudinal analyses of school environmental features, adolescent cardiovascular health trajectories, and later maternal health outcomes. The fellow will integrate these findings with published evidence and participatory group model-building results to develop, implement, calibrate, validate, and apply empirically grounded agent-based models. These models will estimate the long-term population health and health equity effects of school-based interventions and help identify strategies to improve cardiovascular health across the life course. This position offers opportunities for manuscript publication, conference presentations, interdisciplinary collaboration, and mentorship in systems science, adolescent cardiovascular health, maternal health, implementation science.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:• Develop and implement agent-based models of adolescent cardiovascular health trajectories and later maternal health outcomes using NetLogo or a comparable simulation platform.• Translate findings from longitudinal epidemiologic analyses, qualitative research, participatory group model building, and the scientific literature into model structure, assumptions, decision rules, and policy scenarios.• Conduct model calibration, verification, validation, uncertainty analysis, and sensitivity analysis.• Develop reproducible workflows, maintain well-documented code.• Contribute to collaborative manuscripts, abstracts, conference presentations, and policy-facing products.• Participate in meetings with investigators, stakeholders, and community partners to refine model assumptions and interpret results.
Qualifications:• Doctoral degree in Epidemiology, Public Health, Biostatistics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Systems Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.• Demonstrated experience with quantitative analyses and developing agent-based models, system dynamics models, or other complex simulation models.• Strong programming skills in NetLogo and/or another relevant language or platform, such as R or SAS.• Strong quantitative, analytic, scientific writing, and oral communication skills.• Ability to work proactively and independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary research team.• Interest in adolescent health, cardiovascular disease prevention, maternal and child health, school policy or implementation science.Preferred Experience:• Experience working with longitudinal, multilevel, administrative, electronic health record, or other large population-based datasets.• Familiarity with causal inference, multilevel modeling, life-course epidemiology, or health policy evaluation.
Education and Experience:PhD, ScD, DrPH, or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant quantitative or population health discipline. Candidates who are completing their doctoral degree may be considered if all degree requirements will be completed before the start date.

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

Our vision: well... build the largest financial market on the planet.Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Kalshi is the first CFTC-regulated prediction market exchange and the fastest-growing company in finance. We recently became the first US exchange to offer perpetuals in a regulated manner and launched KPOW, the first political index of its kind. We're hiring a Quant Researcher who will help build what comes next: new indices, new models, and quant problems across the exchange as the business scales. There's no playbook here. You'll own problems end to end, ship models into production, and work directly with engineering, product, and trading.

Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to further discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big... but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.
