 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.  2 years/Internship of application programming in both front-end user interfaces, server-side application, and database queries with knowledge across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).  Understanding of Agile, Scrum and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery. Exposure to GIT/Gitlab, Terraform, and Jira is a plus.  2+ years of preferred experience or good understanding of software development using modern technologies , including AWS services (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB), microservices and containerized architectures, and open-source technologies such as Node.js, Python, Java, and React.  Working knowledge of integrating AI and LLM APIs into production applications, with some knowledge of RAG, vector databases, LLMs, and prompt engineering.  Experience with AI coding tools such as GitLab Duo, GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE, and similar tools to accelerate and improve software development workflows.  Ability to work with a group through an architectural development process and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.  Ability to discover and define functional requirements and to transform them into technical requirements and solution definition with minimal guidance.  Good communication skills (verbal and written) and ability to communicate with internal and external customers and all levels of management, including communicating technical information to non-technical audiences.  Intellectual curiosity to continually challenge what exists and explores what should be changed to best meet evolving business and market.  A strong passion for supporting peers to help meet timelines on larger projects.

rows.title: Junior Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Dark Wolf constructs and deploys data management and analytics solutions for the defense and intelligence communities. We’re proud to boast a world-class engineering team that thrives on rolling up their sleeves to solve your mission’s biggest challenges.

Dark Wolf is seeking a Junior / Entry-Level Data Engineer to support the development, maintenance, and monitoring of scalable data pipelines in secure, high-assurance environments. Assist with constructing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and SQL.Support data ingestion from structured and unstructured sources into relational and non-relational databases.Perform basic data profiling, quality checks, and schema validation.Build, run, and maintain application modules using Docker for deployment.Execute automated security scanning tools and perform unit tests to ensure code quality and compliance.Participate actively in daily Agile activities, code reviews, and backlog refinement sessions.

Qualifications

Clearance: Must be a US Citizen holding an active TS/SCI security clearance with an active Full-Scope Polygraph.Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (Master’s degree preferred).Experience: 0-4+ years of data engineering experience.

Experience writing automated SQL and Python unit tests.Basic certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Developer.

Position Clearance Requirement

US Citizenship with an active TS/SCI security clearance with Full-Scope Polygraph

Location: Chantilly/Herndon, VA.

Target Salary Range: $90,000.00 – $130,000.00 (Commensurate with specialized expertise and technical skillset).

We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity, confirm US Citizenship, and complete the required employment eligibility verification upon hire.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
BT-436 – Machine Learning Engineer

Location: McLean, VA (fully on-site, no remote option)

Please do NOT apply if you do not have an active Poly clearance. Those without a Poly will not be considered.**

Introduction

The Sponsor seeks to develop and adapt Large Language Models (LLM) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) methodologies using artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) frameworks and programming languages to create new capabilities to improve analytic workflows and address key intelligence questions. The Sponsor needs experienced AI/ML engineering skills to build tools and analytics that use the Sponsor’s structured and unstructured data to yield novel analytic insights, accelerate workflows, enable analysts to surface relevant information from massive data stores. The work will be performed within a team environment.

Work Requirements

Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Engineering – HRR: NO

The Candidate shall work closely with the Sponsor’s data scientists and technical team to implement requirements; however, the Sponsor’s GTM will manage the priorities.The Candidate shall leverage open source best-in-class models to create new models—through fine tuning, transfer learning, and more— and ensembles that can be re-purposed and reused, covering the following domains:ClassificationSupervised (CNN, Unet, YOLO, or similar)Unsupervised (DBSCAN, K-Nearest, Adaboost, or similar)PredictionPredictors (LSTM, UConv, or similar)Regressors (Bayesian, linear, or similar)Fusion (sensor level and entity level)Decision making (Task assignments, combinational and parametric optimizations, Reinforcement Learning, Path Planning, or similar)Generative (LLMs, Stackable LLMs, or similar)Machine Learning, AI, Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch), Text, (Classification, NLP, Topic and Language Modeling, Sentiment Analysis, Information Retrieval), Recommender Systems and Personalization, Threat Detection, Computer Vision, Data Mining, Statistics, or similar.The Candidate shall analyze large amounts of raw data, including text data, to determine utility for training or testing AI models.The Candidate shall preprocess or clean structured and unstructured Sponsor data, including text data.The Candidate shall design and implement advanced ETL code and table configurations for complex data sets.The Candidate shall use Structured Query Language (SQL) to develop and organize relevant information.The Candidate shall in cooperation with a team, author analytic publications and produce ad-hoc reports to include data visualizations using the Sponsor’s templates, and document methods in Github.The Candidate shall implement the Sponsor’s existing coordination process.The Candidate shall provide technical education to staff on an ad-hoc basis.The Candidate shall provide subject matter expertise in AI/ML to support Sponsor’s initiatives. 
Required Skills And Demonstrated Experience

Demonstrated experience tuning neural networks, such as LLMs, on custom data sets and applying results to specific use cases.Demonstrated professional or academic experience developing models and ensembles in the AI/ML space, including selecting the best Python libraries for a given task, choosing appropriate pre-processing actions, performing analysis, and assessing model performance.Demonstrated professional or academic experience using Python or R.Demonstrated professional or academic experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, Tensorflow, or Keras.Demonstrated professional or academic experience and proficiency with SQL to include using common table expressions, set operations, aggregated functions and nested subqueries.Demonstrated professional or academic experience with version control systems such as Github and Jenkins.Demonstrated experience leveraging GPUs for accelerated computing. 

Highly Desired Skills And Demonstrated Experience

Demonstrated professional or academic experience with the HuggingFace Transformers library and hub.Demonstrated experience with cloud computing development and architecture.Demonstrated experience with front-end web development frameworks such as Flask.Demonstrated experience creating machine learning models that conduct text classification and topic modeling in Python using standard machine learning (SciKit Learn-) or deep learning models.Demonstrated experience developing applications for semantic search.Demonstrated professional or academic experience and proficiency with Tableau to produce visualizations and dashboards.Demonstrated academic or professional experience communicating methodological choices and model results.Demonstrated experience with verification and validation test benches.Demonstrated experience with Explainable AI (XAI) techniques.Demonstrated experience with ONNX (Open Neural Net Exchange).

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist -  Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Have you ever seen the headline in the news “Banks Pass Federal Reserve Stress Tests” and wondered how Capital One determines how much savings (or “capital”) it needs? Or maybe how we analyze the potential impact of the next recession? At the heart of these questions are sophisticated econometric loss models that help us understand the ways in which the economy impacts our loan portfolios and guide strategic decision making at the highest levels of Capital One.

In the Consumer Credit Risk Management Models and Data Team, we blend cutting-edge quantitative methods, with a deep understanding of our business, data, and regulatory environment to build and deploy predictive models for losses, account volumes and outstanding balances. These models drive key strategic decisions for loss allowances, stress testing, and capital allocation as well as informing our earnings calls and recession preparedness.

If this sounds interesting to you, join us! As a Data Scientist on the deployment & platform side of the team, you’ll be at the forefront helping us to usher in the next wave of disruption by using the latest technology to deploy, optimize and modernize model pipelines and execution platforms that enable machine learning models to provide powerful insights about our portfolio and growth opportunities through new data sources. You will partner with best-in-class data scientists, analysts, and engineers to innovate solutions that directly impact the company’s bottom line in a meaningful way. You will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibilities, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications: 

Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)Experience working with AWSAt least 2 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or RAt least 2 years’ experience with machine learningAt least 2 years’ experience with SQL 

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $135,600 - $154,800 for Sr Assoc, Data Science

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist -  Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Have you ever seen the headline in the news “Banks Pass Federal Reserve Stress Tests” and wondered how Capital One determines how much savings (or “capital”) it needs? Or maybe how we analyze the potential impact of the next recession? At the heart of these questions are sophisticated econometric loss models that help us understand the ways in which the economy impacts our loan portfolios and guide strategic decision making at the highest levels of Capital One.

In the Consumer Credit Risk Management Models and Data Team, we blend cutting-edge quantitative methods, with a deep understanding of our business, data, and regulatory environment to build and deploy predictive models for losses, account volumes and outstanding balances. These models drive key strategic decisions for loss allowances, stress testing, and capital allocation as well as informing our earnings calls and recession preparedness.

If this sounds interesting to you, join us! As a Data Scientist on the deployment & platform side of the team, you’ll be at the forefront helping us to usher in the next wave of disruption by using the latest technology to deploy, optimize and modernize model pipelines and execution platforms that enable machine learning models to provide powerful insights about our portfolio and growth opportunities through new data sources. You will partner with best-in-class data scientists, analysts, and engineers to innovate solutions that directly impact the company’s bottom line in a meaningful way. You will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibilities, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications:

If this is how you see your career, Colgate is the place to be! Our trustworthy household brands, dedicated employees, and sustainability commitments make us a company passionate about building a future to smile about for our employees, consumers, and surrounding communities. As the brand with the highest household presence in the world, we transcend physical boundaries. We win as a global organization by continually learning and collaborating. The pride in our brand fuels a workplace that encourages creative thinking, fosters experimentation, and promotes authenticity which has contributed to our enduring success. If you are passionate about working for a company that lives by their values, then give your career a reason to smile...every single day.

The Experience

In an ever-changing retail environment, it is an exciting time to be a part of the Customer Development team at Colgate. Our internship is designed for students passionate about pursuing a career in sales with a global consumer goods company. Our sales teams are highly collaborative with a focus on cultivating strong customer relationships and using analytics, insights, innovative thinking to win with our Customers and deliver growth

What does Customer Development/Sales at Colgate look like?

Shopper MarketingAccount ManagementCategory ManagementCross-functional partnershipsBuilding superior customer (retailer) relationshipsBalancing sales in ecommerce, digital, and in store at major retailers

We want you to feel empowered to craft your own experience with us by providing opportunities for you to seek involvement cross functionally and for you to again exposure to the work of different groups.

What’s in it for you?

Exposure to Senior Leadership- Our leaders are open and accessible to learning about you and sharing insights to their career journeys. Mentors & Buddy Program- Developing connections with coworkers and mentors is imperative at Colgate. Once in the program, you'll be given a mentor and a buddy providing you with mentorship and advice to take your career to the next level. Dynamic, Fast Paced Environment- Consumers always need our products and there is a ton of work to be done. Your point of view and opinion is valued here as we are keen to learn and grow as a company. Your Opportunity for Full-Time Employment- When summer comes to an end and you love Colgate as much as we do every day, you will have the chance to apply for our rotational program or a full time analyst role, continuing to strengthen your personal brand and skills. Skills You'll Build- Throughout the summer you will strengthen your analytical skills, build financial acumen, work with retailer and market data to solve real world business needs, and learn the essentials of storytelling when building a narrative. Relocation stipend for transportation and housing- We know from experience that while exciting, it can be challenging to pick up and move. To help make the transition easy, we provide relocation support for housing, travel and transportation. 

Preferred Qualifications

Previous internship or co-op experience in sales, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or retail analytics. Proven adaptability in fast-paced environments with strong problem-solving skills. Familiarity with category management principles, e-commerce metrics, or financial acumen. 

Required Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program with an anticipated graduation of Spring 2028. Demonstrated ability to analyze datasets and translate data into actionable insights. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

rows.title: Strategy & Business Analytics Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

The Strategy & Business Analytics Manager is the analytical engine and storytelling architect behind Mars Snacking North America’s strategic choices. Sitting at the intersection of strategy and deployment, this role translates complex market dynamics, consumer trends, and competitive intelligence into compelling executive narratives that drive decision-making.

Acting as a critical connective tissue across the organization, this manager builds robust cross-functional partnerships to ensure Strategic Choices are deployed and shape execution. This includes partnering with the Manager of Strategy & Performance to tie strategic choices directly to financial outcomes, and collaborating with Global Strategy to ensure North American initiatives amplify broader enterprise goals. Success in this role requires a unique blend of analytical rigor, high-level strategic thinking, and the ability to influence without authority.

What are we looking for?

Experience: 3-5+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, or commercial analytics. Industry Experience: Prior experience in Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Food & Beverage, or Retail is highly preferred. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related quantitative field. An MBA or advanced degree is strongly preferred. Technical Skills: Strong financial acumen and P&L literacy, coupled with deep analytical expertise leveraging syndicated market data (e.g., Nielsen, Circana) and broader business analytics. Strategic Skills: Exceptional data storytelling capabilities, with proven experience using strategic frameworks to distill complex analyses into clear business choices, alongside a high comfort level navigating ambiguity. 

What will be your key responsibilities?

Strategic Storytelling: Architect compelling executive narratives and presentations that distill complex data and rigorous analysis into clear, actionable strategic choices. Market & Competitive Intelligence: Lead the curation of market insights, consumer behavior trends, macroeconomic trends, internal performance, and competitive intelligence to anticipate industry shifts and proactively evolve our North American strategy. Analytical Rigor & Financial Linkage: Structure complex strategy workstreams, partnering cross-functionally to ensure all strategic choices are firmly grounded in long-term financial models, ROI assessments, and resource prioritization. Cross-Functional Orchestration: Facilitate leadership workshops and strategic planning routines to create a feedback loop with business unit leaders, ensuring our strategies rapidly adapt to evolving market conditions. 

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

rows.title: Program Manager – Value Leadership
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

The Program Manager – Value Leadership serves as the operating hub for the Value Leadership portfolio, ensuring project data, governance routines, savings visibility, risks, escalations, and cross-functional actions are captured accurately and advanced with clear ownership. This role brings structure to ambiguity and enables leaders and project owners to make timely, informed decisions. 

You will work closely with VL Leadership Director, Portfolio Directors, Project Leads, Finance, R&D, Commercial, Supply, Procurement, Manufacturing, Packaging, Logistics, and other senior stakeholders to maintain a reliable single source of truth for project status, savings, timing, approvals, risks, and decisions. The role supports the recurring VL operating rhythm, including project reviews, prioritization discussions, action tracking, escalation follow-up, reporting, and continuous improvement of portfolio tools and knowledge repositories. 

What are we looking for?  

Ideal candidate profile: A highly organized, analytically strong portfolio/program manager who can bring structure to ambiguity, manage recurring governance routines, synthesize complex project information into clear recommendations, drive follow-through across a matrixed organization, and coordinate (and potentially manage) a small team supporting portfolio execution.  Business experience: 5-8 years of experience in portfolio management, program management, PMO operations, financial/savings tracking, strategic planning, change management, or similar roles in a complex, matrixed organization.  Governance and process discipline: Familiarity with Stage Gate, project intake, scoping, and other governance processes, including process discipline, required fields, documentation standards, and consistent application across teams.  Analytical capabilities: Experience using project data, savings assumptions, timing, risk, and resource inputs to support scenario modeling, prioritization, investment analysis, portfolio trade-off discussions, dashboards, summaries, and leadership-ready materials.  Communication and influence: Strong stakeholder engagement, change management, and communication skills, with the ability to influence across levels, simplify complex portfolio trade-offs, and reinforce follow-through through concise, data-driven storytelling.  Working style: Comfortable working in ambiguity and shifting priorities, with strong organization, ownership, attention to detail, bias for action, and a continuous improvement mindset.  Tools and systems: Experience with portfolio, savings, reporting, and collaboration tools such as Sopheon Accolade/PPM, Sievo, Excel, Power Query, Power BI, SharePoint, Teams, project trackers, and action logs.  

What will be your responsibilities? 

Portfolio analysis and prioritization: Lead and support scenario modeling, prioritization views, and portfolio analysis to evaluate Value Leadership pipeline options, including impact, feasibility, savings potential, timing, risk, and resource trade-offs.  Decision support and storytelling: Translate portfolio analytics, project updates, and reporting outputs into clear recommendations and senior leader communications on portfolio health, value delivery, escalation needs, and open decisions.  Governance and operating rhythm: Support recurring Value Leadership project reviews, action tracking, decision documentation, escalation follow-up, and consistent use of the portfolio single source of truth.  Process adoption: Act as a change agent for portfolio processes, including idea management, DVF/project intake, recurring review routines, standard reporting practices, and non-consumer-facing Stage Gate deployment.  Capability building and knowledge management: Strengthen portfolio management capability through playbooks, onboarding materials, process guidance, recurring routines, documentation standards, and shared knowledge repositories.  Tool and process improvement: Identify portfolio tool, reporting, and process gaps; map continuous-improvement opportunities; and partner with technology, data, finance, and functional teams to deliver practical improvements.  Team and stakeholder coordination: Lead or indirectly guide project managers, workstream owners, coordinating priorities, clarifying ownership, tracking actions, and reinforcing accountability.  

What can you expect from Mars? 

Work with over 130,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.  Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.  Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.  An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.  

The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an applicant receives an offer of employment.

The pay range shown is applicable to all US locations listed within the job posting:USD 134,400.00 - USD 184,800.00

rows.title: Digital Product Owner
rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES

Job Description

As adoption of centrally developed products and corporate-scale capabilities continues to grow across multiple business units, we are seeking Product Owners to lead adoption, onboarding, and value realization for these products. In this role, you will own priorities for internal data and digital products that drive measurable business impact. You will collaborate across functions to understand diverse perspectives and define clear opportunities. Through this work, you will translate stakeholder needs into valuable products by maintaining and delivering a prioritized backlog. You will communicate product status to stakeholders and create personas, user journeys, user flows, and other stimuli to support these efforts. This role requires you to embrace Agile principles—fall in love with the Minimally Viable Product (MVP), fail fast, learn, and iterate to bring digital products to life.

Key Business Areas include Brand Building, Digital Media, Creative Operations, Digital Commerce Execution, and Business Process Transformation. Product scope may range from enterprise data assets and analytics platforms to creative workflow tools, media measurement solutions, retailer-facing commerce capabilities, and marketing technology ecosystems.

Responsibilities:

As a Digital Product Owner, you will:

Set product vision and strategy across the relevant business units, service, product, program, technology domain, or IT process that creates clarity and structure in ambiguous environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. IT, Brand, R&D, Finance, Sales) that act as business owners of your products while fostering innovation, shared accountability, and continuous improvement. Translate cross-functional business needs into actionable user stories for the technical team. Communicate your product’s progress and KPIs via roadmaps, quantifiable metrics, leadership reviews, and monthly memos. Lead onboarding, communications, and adoption efforts for new features and releases, driving organizational change at scale. Define and prioritize the backlog based on business value, priorities, and technical feasibility. Develop and run experiments to validate or disprove concepts. Create user-centric materials (e.g. documentation, flows, mockups) to validate concepts through requirement gathering and support translation of ideas from diverse groups. Champion data quality and governance to ensure trusted insights. Ensure ongoing operational success through continuous improvement informed by product data, customer feedback, operational insights, and monitoring. 

Job Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Analytics, or

related field.

Familiarity with data platforms (Azure Databricks, Power BI) and governance principles. Strong communication skills to bridge ideas and requirements between non-technical and technical stakeholders. Ability to bring structure to ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred:

Growth Mindset, Agile MindsetExposure to data stewardship practicesHands-on experience with Agile/Scrum and backlog management tools (Azure Dev Ops, Jira). 

Compensation for roles at P&G varies depending on a wide array of non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, degree/credentials, relevant skill set, and level of relevant experience. At P&G compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Total rewards at P&G include salary + bonus (if applicable) + benefits. Your recruiter may be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the hiring process.

At P&G, we believe that diverse experiences help build strong leaders. Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. Candidates should be prepared to consider relocation opportunities throughout their career as business needs and development opportunities arise.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Immigration Sponsorship is not available for this role. For more information regarding who is eligible for hire at P&G along with other work authorization FAQ’s, please click HERE.

Procter & Gamble participates in E-Verify.

Qualified individuals will not be disadvantaged based on being unemployed.

If you have a disability that affects your ability to complete our online application process, please visit our Disability Accommodation Page.

Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

As a member of the Retail Technology team, this role is responsible for supporting and enhancing the global Workforce Management (WFM) platform (UKG), which powers critical retail functions including scheduling, time and attendance, labor forecasting, budgeting, and workforce analytics. The position partners with business stakeholders, vendors, and offshore support teams to deliver operational support, system improvements, and project initiatives, with a primary focus on the U.S. market.

The role also works closely with cross-functional IT teams to maintain system availability, resolve incidents, support critical integrations, and ensure technology solutions align with business needs. Over time, the position will expand responsibilities across adjacent retail technology platforms, developing broader expertise in areas such as Point of Sale (POS), traffic analytics, and in-store inventory management systems.

,

,

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.4+ years of experience in IT application support, systems operations, technology delivery, or related roles.Experience supporting enterprise applications and participating in system implementations, enhancements, integrations, or continuous improvement initiatives.Preferred experience with Workforce Management (WFM), HR systems, or retail technology platforms such as POS, traffic analytics, inventory management, or mobile applications.Basic understanding of SQL, scripting, or programming concepts is a plus.Experience working with third-party vendors and distributed teams in a global business environment.Proficiency with Microsoft 365, Jira, Zoom, and other collaboration and project management tools.Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences; bilingual Chinese and English preferred.Demonstrated ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and business partners.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in a fast-paced environment.Highly organized, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.Self-motivated team player with strong commercial awareness, stakeholder management skills, and a collaborative mindset.

rows.title: Vice President Strategic Revenue Management
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

As the Vice President of Strategic Revenue Management (SRM) you will be accountable for embedding SRM into how Pet Nutrition North America plans, invests, and grows. This role operates at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Category Leadership, Finance, Supply, Digital, and customer teams, translating insights into practical commercial choices. Success requires shifting the organization from reactive, event-based decisions to a disciplined, value-led model with clear priorities, stronger analytics, tighter governance, and better connection to customer and category growth plans.

This role is on site in our Franklin, TN office.

What are we looking for?

Bachelor's degree in Finance Analytics or related field.10–15+ years of progressive commercial experience in CPG, with depth in SRM, customer development, pricing, trade investment, category strategy, finance, analytics, or commercial transformation. Proven ability to lead SRM as an enterprise growth capability, not just a set of tools or workstreams. Deep expertise in pricing strategy, PPA, promotion effectiveness, trade ROI, customer planning, and value realization. Demonstrated ability to convert analytics into clear decisions, trade-offs, executive recommendations, and measurable business outcomes. Experience embedding new capabilities into S&OP+, annual planning, customer planning, demand reviews, scorecards, and governance forums. Strong cross-functional influence with senior Sales, Marketing, Category, Finance, Supply, Digital, and General Management leaders. Track record of building and developing high-performing teams in a complex, matrixed organization. 

What will be your key responsibilities?

Set the SRM agenda: Define and lead the North America SRM strategy across pricing, promotion, trade investment, price-pack architecture, mix, customer planning, and value realization. Embed SRM into Customer Pods: Partner with Walmart, eCommerce, Grocery, Club, Value, Pet Specialty, and other teams to build coherent plans that improve customer outcomes while protecting enterprise value. Build trade and promotion rigor: Own trade investment strategy, promotion effectiveness, ROI expectations, guardrails, and planned-versus-actual accountability. Strengthen governance and decision rights: Establish clear pricing, promotion, trade, and investment thresholds with escalation paths for plans that do not meet financial or strategic expectations. Scale analytics and digital adoption: Lead adoption of SRM analytics, TPM, ROI measurement, elasticity, price simulation, scenario modeling, and decision-support tools. Partner with PGTs to embed SRM ways of working: imbed capabilites, tools, data standards, and digital capabilities that can be translated into practical routines that improve pricing, trade, promotion, and customer planning decisions at PGT level. Build organizational capability: Develop SRM playbooks, routines, training, and coaching so Sales, Marketing, Category, Finance, and customer teams own SRM thinking. Lead and develop the SRM team: Build a high-performing team with strong category, customer, analytics, trade, pricing, and transformation capabilities. 

What To Expect From Mars

rows.title: E-Commerce Salsify Syndication Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

The E-Commerce Salsify Syndication Specialist is responsible for the end-to-end execution, governance, and optimization of product content syndication across Nestlé USA's digital commerce ecosystem. This role ensures accurate, timely, and retailer-compliant delivery of product information, digital assets, and enhanced content from Salsify to a broad network of retailers, marketplaces, and content service providers.

As a key member of the Digital Shelf Capabilities team, the Syndication Specialist serves as the subject matter expert for retailer syndication, channel onboarding, content readiness, issue resolution, and syndication performance monitoring. The role partners closely with Account Teams, Marketing, Product Information, Legal, Regulatory, IT, agency partners, and external vendors to drive best-in-class digital shelf execution and support Nestlé's digital-first operating model.

Key Responsibilities

Syndication Execution & Channel Management

Manage and execute product content syndication across 90+ retailer, marketplace, and content service provider channels.Configure, maintain, and optimize syndication connections within Salsify, including direct retailer integrations, Syndigo connections, open catalogs, exports, and custom delivery methods.Ensure product content, images, attributes, and enhanced content are delivered accurately and on schedule according to retailer-specific requirements.Support onboarding new retailer connections, including channel configuration, testing, validation, and go-live activities.Maintain retailer distribution and assortment mappings to ensure appropriate content delivery across channels. 
Content Readiness, Quality & Compliance

Validate item readiness prior to syndication by ensuring required attributes, assets, and content meet retailer and Nestlé standards.Conduct quality assurance reviews and ongoing audits to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance issues.Monitor retailer-specific requirements, content standards, taxonomy changes, and submission guidelines.Partner with Product Information and Content teams to resolve upstream data and content issues before syndication. 
Retailer Optimization & Digital Shelf Excellence

Optimize syndicated content to maximize product discoverability, conversion, and digital shelf performance.Apply retailer-specific rules related to titles, descriptions, attributes, images, A+ content, taxonomy, and content hierarchy.Monitor syndication of outcomes, retailer rejections, approval of workflows, and publication timelines.Partner with Account Teams to support retailer audits and content improvement initiatives.
Automation, Data Management & Process Improvement

Support data mapping, transformation, inheritance logic, retailer arrays, catalog management, and automated syndication workflows.Leverage Salsify automation, governance capabilities, and workflow tools to improve scalability, reduce manual effort, and enhance data quality.Identify and implement process improvements that accelerate speed-to-shelf and increase operational efficiency.Partner with IT, vendor partners, and Digital Shelf leadership to support new capabilities, integrations, and system enhancements.
Troubleshooting & Operational Support

Serve as the primary point of contact for syndication-related issues, including failed deliveries, retailer rejections, content discrepancies, and system integration challenges.Conduct root cause analysis and drive resolution through collaboration with internal stakeholders, retailer contacts, Salsify support, and vendor partners.Track, prioritize, and resolve syndication issues while ensuring minimal business disruption.Maintain operational reporting and communicate status updates to stakeholders.
Documentation, Governance & Training

Develop and maintain documentation for retailer requirements, onboarding procedures, syndication of workflows, troubleshooting processes, and best practices.Contribute to standard operating procedures, governance frameworks, and Digital Shelf ways of working.Provide guidance and training to internal stakeholders on syndication processes, retailer capabilities, and Salsify best practices.Stay current on Salsify platform enhancements, retailer capability changes, and industry trends related to Product Experience Management (PXM).
Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Information Systems, Supply Chain, eCommerce, or related field.3+ years of experience working with Salsify, Product Information Management (PIM), Product Experience Management (PXM), or digital content syndication platforms.Experience supporting eCommerce, Digital Shelf, Product Information, Content Operations, or Syndication programs within a CPG, retail, or manufacturing environment.Experience managing retailer-specific content requirements and syndication processes.Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced cross-functional environment.Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills. 
Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting major retailers such as Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Albertsons, Instacart, Costco, or Sam's Club.Experience with Syndigo, GDSN, Product Information Management systems, or master data governance processes.Familiarity with product master data, UPCs, packaging hierarchies, retailer taxonomies, and product content workflows.Knowledge of API integrations, automated content delivery, FTP processes, or data transformation logic.Experience with content quality scoring, readiness reporting, compliance audits, and digital shelf analytics.Project management or process improvement experience.
Salary: $82,402.56 to $115,846.40 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Are you ready to shape the future of digital supply chain planning for iconic global snacking brands? As the Director, Digital Technology Business Partner - E2E Planning, you will serve as the strategic digital leader and primary conduit between North American business leadership and Global Digital Technologies teams. In this critical, dedicated role, you will lead the digital transformation of our end-to-end Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and S&OP capabilities across North America—harmonizing processes, retiring legacy disparate systems, and deploying enterprise-grade global platforms.

You will co-own the multi-year digital capability roadmap with business executives, modernizing our technology ecosystem and embedding cutting-edge AI, cognitive planning, and digital twins into our supply network. If you thrive at the intersection of business strategy, enterprise architecture, and large-scale transformation, this role offers an unmatched platform to drive lasting impact across Mars Snacking.

What are we looking for?

Minimum Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Minimum Experience: 15+ years of progressive professional IT and business partnership experience, with a proven track record leading large-scale supply chain planning and digital transformation programs. Advanced Planning Systems (APS): Extensive hands-on experience implementing, or managing enterprise APS platforms (e.g., Kinaxis Maestro, SAP IBP, SAP APO). Core ERP & Planning Architecture: In-depth, solid understanding in SAP ERP systems and their architecture/integration with Advanced Planning Solutions (APS). Strategic Business Partnership: Demonstrated ability to partner with VP- and Senior Director-level executives, translating complex business strategies into actionable multi-year digital roadmaps. Process Harmonization & Change Leadership: Strong background in reimagining, harmonizing, and digitizing end-to-end IBP/S&OP processes within large multinational organizations. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications:

Direct implementation experience with Kinaxis Maestro. Deep understanding functional/technical knowledge of SAP IBP and/or SAP APO. Proven experience evaluating and integrating emerging supply chain technologies (e.g., AI/ML touchless planning, predictive analytics, digital twins). 

What will be your key responsibilities?

Strategic Co-Ownership: Partner with VP/Sr. Director-level business executives to define and execute multi-year digital capability roadmaps that directly support enterprise strategic objectives. Ecosystem Modernization: Guide the modernization and adoption of advanced planning technology stacks (APS) across the North America region, retiring legacy platforms and driving standard global deployments. Regional Voice & Global Alignment: Act as the strategic conduit between North American business stakeholders and global DT product teams, ensuring regional requirements are embedded into global roadmaps while championing global standards locally. E2E Process Digitization: Partner with business process owners to reimagine and harmonize end-to-end IBP/S&OP processes prior to deploying digital automation and advanced tools. Regional Solution Delivery: Lead the strategy and execution to bring regional-specific digital products to life when local market requirements fall outside the core global roadmap. AI & Innovation Leadership: Drive the AI and advanced analytics agenda across supply chain planning, actively evaluating tech startups, vendor roadmaps, touchless planning capabilities, and digital twins to deliver competitive advantage. Stakeholder Management & Adoption: Ensure flawless business readiness, adoption, and value realization for digital planning products deployed across North America. 

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and analytics and eager to drive significant business impact? Procter & Gamble is looking for interns interested in various roles within the data and analytics domain, including Data Engineers, Data Asset Managers, and AI Engineers. You will have the opportunity to apply innovative technologies to solve complex business problems and contribute to data-driven decision-making.

The work you will be doing could range from analyzing large datasets to providing actionable insights, managing data assets to ensure data quality and accessibility, to engineering robust data pipelines that feed analytical models and support business operations. Regardless of the specific role, as a Data, Analytics, & AI Engineering intern, you will be someone who leverages data to solve business problems.

Example Responsibilities by Role Type:

Data Engineer: Design, build, and maintain cloud-based data and analytics platforms and data pipelines that acquire, cleanse, transform, and publish data from a wide range of sources. Develop large, complex datasets that support both functional and non-functional business requirements, while partnering with data asset managers, architects, and development leads to deliver high-quality, fit-for-purpose data solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. Contribute to and apply coding standards and best practices to create efficient, scalable, and reusable services and components. Design and implement process improvements that enhance operational efficiency, data quality, and overall platform performance.AI Engineer: Drive proof-of-concept development and experimental initiatives to evaluate emerging technologies, advanced models, and innovative solutions. Engineer high-quality, standards-compliant, and rigorously tested software while contributing reusable code, frameworks, and tools to shared repositories, enterprise libraries, and open-source projects in alignment with P&G IT policies. Design, develop, and optimize data models, feature engineering capabilities, data quality assurance processes, ETL/ELT pipelines, and scalable distributed computing architectures. Deploy, monitor, and enhance algorithmic solutions across cloud platforms, leveraging cloud-native services to ensure reliability, scalability, efficiency, and business impact.Data Asset Manager: Leading data governance activities aligned with the organization’s data strategy within assigned areas of accountability. Serve as trusted advisors to business partners, influencing strategic decisions and driving the continuous improvement of data governance practices. Oversees critical data management functions such as data quality, data operations, storage, reference and master data, data standards, security, vendor governance, and metadata management to ensure data is accurate, secure, accessible, and fit for business use.

As an intern, you will experience a subset of the above responsibilities

You must be available during the summer of 2027 for a 12 week internship from mid/late May through early August. In the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math, Statistics, Analytics or like degrees. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in programming languages such as Python, SQL, R, or similar (Experience in a specific language is not required; you will be expected to learn new languages). Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and understanding of data management practices. Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical colleagues effectively. 

Preferred:

A history of solving complex problems with innovative solutions. Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform. Understanding of data governance and data quality best practices. Relevant experience or coursework in data analysis, data management, or related fields.

Job Title: Manager – Advocacy & Influence (Paid/Earned), Kiehl's US

Division: Luxe

Location: New York, NY (10 Hudson Yards)

Reports To: Head of Consumer Engagement

Who We Are For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. Our goal is to offer each and every person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity, and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity.

At L’Oréal, our Digital team is an opportunity to be at the center of L'Oréal's digital transformation. We are determined to be pioneers in the new beauty tech world, and by incorporating digital into everything that we do, we are creating a better relationship with our consumers. When beauty and tech collide, the impossible can happen! Come join our dynamic team!

The Role As the Manager of Advocacy & Influence (Paid/Earned) for Kiehl's US, you will drive end-to-end influencer marketing strategies, scaling always-on advocacy, paid partnerships, and experiential programming to breakthrough the skincare market.

Key Responsibilities

Influencer Campaign Management: Manage end-to-end execution of paid and earned influencer campaigns, including strategy development, influencer selection, content creation, and performance reporting.Relationship Management: Build and maintain relationships with all influencers. Negotiate contracts, oversee long-term partnerships, and bring new relationships into the Kiehl's fold.Advocacy & Mailer Program Management: Develop and manage always-on brand advocate seeding programs, overseeing seeding agencies, fulfillment, and creative execution.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Lead cross-functional teams to execute integrated influencer marketing campaigns. Collaborate with marketing, PR, legal, and other relevant departments.Content Strategy & Development: Oversee the development of influencer content, ensuring quality, brand consistency, and legal compliance. Provide strategic guidance to influencers on content creation and develop Kiehl’s expert and skincare authenticity programming.Creativity & Eventing: Bring innovation, creative, and best-in-class concepts to breakthrough the skincare market. rows.title: Head of Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Head of Analytics | Last Mile | Hybrid Working | Hatfield

Introduction

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About The Role

As the Head of Analytics for Last Mile, you will take full ownership of the insight agenda for one of the most operationally intensive domains at Ocado. Last Mile oversees the critical final stage of our operation - ensuring the right orders reach the right customers on time - and encompasses delivery routing, fleet operations, slot management, and performance tracking across our global partners.

This is a highly influential, cross-functional position sitting on the Data & Analytics leadership team. While our underlying AI capability is already advanced, this role is less about inventing the technology and heavily focused on the human and operational element: turning advanced capabilities into tangible business value, driving stakeholder adoption, and bringing together teams that do not normally work closely together.

You will drive delivery through influence rather than direct authority, collaborating closely with VP-level leaders across Product, Engineering, and Partner Success, as well as peer Heads of Analytics in Fulfilment and Ecommerce. Additionally, you will ensure solutions are built in a way that serves Ocado Retail today, with a view to potentially releasing successful solutions to external Ocado partners in the future.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Last-Mile Efficiency: Conceptualize opportunities, develop strategic approaches, and pull together the right cross-functional teams to optimize current operations.Deliver Operational Value: Drive initiatives focused on turning advanced analytical/AI capabilities into operational reality, including improving store operations, maximizing fulfillment efficiency, and optimizing the use of chiller totes and capacity.Enable Better Decision-Making: Enable a higher volume of orders to be successfully fulfilled through better operational and data-driven decisions.Lead and Develop the Team: Manage the Last Mile analytics team, establishing clear standards for work prioritization, scoping, and communication.Nurture Talent: Oversee the technical and communication development of analysts to ensure insights are actionable, highly impactful, and easily understood by the business.Foster an Experimentation Culture: Champion a culture of innovation and experimentation, negotiating decision rights, setting clear evidence standards, and encouraging testing over instinctual decision-making.Manage AI Foundations: Own the semantic and context layers for Last Mile, ensuring business definitions and metric logic remain accurate so AI-generated outputs align seamlessly with real-world operations.Optimise Feedback Loops: Work with the central AI enablement function to design and maintain tight feedback loops between AI outputs and ground truth, helping stakeholders adopt and use these tools confidently.

Essential

What We're Looking For:

Complex Stakeholder Management & Influence: A background in management consultancy or a similarly complex multi-stakeholder environment. Proven ability to operate in complex environments, structure ambiguous problems, create alignment around a shared vision, and comfortably challenge existing thinking at a senior/VP level.Influence Without Authority: Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of driving change and bringing together disparate teams through pure influence rather than direct reporting lines.High Energy & Change Leadership: Energetic, charismatic, and collaborative mindset with experience leading an analytics or change function through substantive operational methodology shifts.Tech & AI Landscape Literacy: A strong, grounded understanding of current AI tools and data platforms. The ability to distinguish genuinely useful solutions from noise and successfully translate complex AI/data capabilities into commercial, operational business value.Analytical Foundations: Solid analytical foundations necessary to set team standards for experimentation, metric architecture, and validating model efficacy alongside Data Science partners.

Nice to Haves

Domain Familiarity: Experience within operational, logistics, or last-mile environments, bringing strong real-world context to data analysis (highly valued, but a nice-to-have rather than essential).Data Science Exposure: History of working alongside data science or machine learning functions, understanding how to bridges analytics and operational modeling.Modern Data Tooling Experience: Exposure to semantic layer tooling, data cataloguing, or AI evaluation frameworks.

Benefits

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

Time To Recharge

25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

Health & Wellbeing

Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

Family-first Policies

22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave

Financial Support

Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.

Commuter Perks

Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

Exclusive Discounts

15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).

Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. rows.title: Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering
rows.descriptionText:
Requirements

 Description & Requirements 

 who we are 

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The Enterprise Data & AI team is a strategic and operational driver of growth for lululemon, owning and building the data and AI platforms and products that enable the enterprise to operate with intelligence at scale. The team leads the design and delivery of a trusted unified data foundation, advanced analytics capabilities, and AI solutions across lululemon’s vertically integrated retail ecosystem, embedding strong data governance and responsible AI practices from the very beginning. By applying AI to critical business challenges and creating new, transformative AI solutions, the team helps reshape how lululemon operates. Through deep partnership with product, technology, and business teams, Enterprise Data & AI accelerates product innovation, unlocks measurable value, elevates guest and educator experiences, and drives enterprise efficiency.

Core Responsibilities

As a Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering, you lead a team of AI/ML Engineers, setting technical direction, building delivery capability, and ensuring your team produces production-grade AI/ML systems that drive measurable business value. Your team sits at the intersection of software engineering and AI/ML — engineers who go beyond platform and MLOps work to apply existing AI models and algorithms to specific business problems, setting up training pipelines, transforming data for AI use, fine-tuning models for performance, and orchestrating multiple algorithm steps to build end-to-end AI solutions.

You establish AI/ML engineering best practices spanning model development, training infrastructure, MLOps, and GenAI systems, manage performance, coach team members on engineering craft and responsible AI, and create an environment that fosters innovation and engineering excellence. You maintain strong technical credibility, partner closely with applied science, data engineering, product, and business stakeholders, and ensure AI/ML engineering work is delivered reliably at the highest quality.

Own delivery across the team's AI/ML engineering work from problem framing through to production stability — sequencing workstreams that span both AI solution building (training, fine-tuning, algorithm orchestration) and deployment infrastructure (MLOps, serving, monitoring), managing dependencies, and making execution trade-offs that keep programs on trackSet technical direction for the AI/ML engineering capability area — translating business and applied science requirements into engineering programs that apply existing AI models and algorithms to specific use cases, and making platform, MLOps, and architectural choices that enable reliable delivery at scaleContribute hands-on to critical engineering work including AI solution design, model deployment, training infrastructure, model serving, and system design problems — demonstrating best practices, unblocking the team on hard problems, and maintaining technical credibilityEstablish AI/ML engineering standards — including how to set up and manage training pipelines, transform and prepare data for AI model use, fine-tune existing models for performance on specific use cases, and orchestrate multiple algorithm steps into cohesive AI solutionsBuild and maintain the operational foundation for how AI solutions are deployed and run in production — including CI/CD for ML, model drift alerting, rollback protocols, and serving reliability

Qualifications

 10-12 years of applicable experience  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or related technical field, or equivalent experience  Make architectural decisions for the team's AI/ML systems spanning training, serving, and integration with downstream applications, balancing performance, scalability, and cost  Prioritize AI/ML investments within the team's scope, weighing platform and tooling spend, compute infrastructure, and foundation model adoption against expected business value  Build and maintain the team's AI/ML delivery systems — covering both the AI solution pipeline (training, fine-tuning, data preparation, algorithm orchestration) and production operations (CI/CD for ML, deployment patterns, monitoring, rollback, lifecycle management) 

 must haves 

 Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.  Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.  Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.  Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.  Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.  Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously. 

Additional Notes

Please note: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from   $213,760 - $280,550   annually  ; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

At Lululemon, Investing In Our People Is a Top Priority. We Believe That When Life Works, Work Works. We Strive To Be The Place Where Inclusive Leaders Come To Develop And Enable All To Be Well. Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth

 Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans  Paid time off  Savings and retirement plan matching  Generous employee discount  Fitness & yoga classes  Parenthood top-up  Extensive catalog of development course offerings  People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few) 

Note: The incentive programs, benefits, and perks have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these incentive programs, benefits, and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

workplace arrangement 

In-person collaboration and connection is important to our culture. Work is performed onsite, minimum 4 days per week.

rows.title: Principal Technical Director - Neural Rendering
rows.descriptionText:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren't just places to consume content — they're places where communities build.

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Director with deep and broad rendering experience to lead a group of rendering engineers and researchers within our Research & Engineering team. You understand rendering end-to-end: its impact on production, on visuals, and on the quality of a game. You also know the research landscape, including neural rendering, and have a clear view of how graphics must evolve to shape the future of game worlds and experiences. You will help define what the intersection of rendering and machine learning means for the future of interactive entertainment and the creative process.

This is a hybrid role, onsite three days a week, in Montreal, Vancouver, or Redwood City.
