rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate problem solvers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to compose economic opportunity for all.

The Role

People are at the center of everything we do. The People Technology Solutions team (within our People Operations organization) provides the enabling technology foundation for candidate and employee experience at eBay. Our ecosystem is anchored in Workday HCM and extended through best-in-class SaaS platforms, custom applications, analytics, and emerging AI driven solutions.

We are looking for a product-minded Sr. People Technology Analyst to help shape and scale eBay’s recruiting technology experience. This role will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, TA Operations, IT, and other collaborators. It will focus on understanding business needs, defining product priorities, and delivering solutions. These solutions help candidates, hiring managers, and recruiters navigate the entire recruiting process.

Workday Recruiting is a core platform for this role, but the scope is broader than Workday configuration. The successful candidate will think end-to-end across the TA ecosystem, including integrated sourcing, screening & assessment, interview scheduling, and structured interview tools, skills data, reporting, user experience, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities. This person will help translate recruiting strategy into scalable technology solutions, and improve the candidate, manager and recruiter experiences at eBay.

This individual contributor role is a hybrid role with proximity to our Salt Lake City office. Working arrangements are Hybrid (3 days onsite/week) in the Salt Lake City office. Also, the ability to work flexible hours for global collaboration, when needed.

What You'll Accomplish

Serve as a product-minded technology partner for eBay’s recruiting ecosystem, with Workday Recruiting as the core platform.Contribute to roadmap development for recruiting technology enhancements, balancing business priorities, user needs, operational requirements, and technical feasibility.Partner with Talent Acquisition, TA Operations, IT, and other collaborators to understand needs, define requirements, and prioritize solutions.Partner with TA Operations to support and enhance the recruiting technology ecosystem, including interview scheduling platforms (Paradox), CRM platforms (Gem, Phenom People) and AI-enabled recruiting tools (HiredScore, Textio, BrightHire, CodeSignal etc).Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business and technical requirements into scalable solution builds and AI use cases, including user stories, process flows, business rules, solution concepts, and success measures.Lead configuration, testing, deployment, and optimization of Workday Recruiting for assigned projects.Identify and implement automation opportunities using AI and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Workday Developer Agent, Sana Agent Builder or similar platforms).Support development of custom applications using Workday Extend where tailored solutions are required.Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and calculated fields to enable data-driven decisions.Provide production support and issue resolution while identifying root causes and scalable improvements.Support transitions, communications, training, and adoption for new/improved processes and capabilities.Partner with IT and vendors to support integrations, data flows, technical dependencies, and platform governance.Participate in internal audits, SOX cycles, data privacy reviews, and compliance-related documentation as needed.Maintain documentation, including product requirements, process maps, test scripts, release notes, project plans, and support materials.Stay ahead of Workday, recruiting technology, skills, AI, and HR technology trends, and assess their applicability to eBay’s People technology ecosystem.


What You'll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Information Science, Human Resources, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.3-5 years of dynamic hands-on HRIS experience, including experience with HR SaaS-based systems3+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience with at least 2+ years of Workday Recruiting configuration experience.Current on emerging AI trends in HR technology and assess applicability to eBay’s people technology ecosystem.Strong functional expertise in recruiting end-to-end process.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to deliver scalable solutionsExcellent collaborator communication and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to take complex concepts and convey them simply to less technical audiencesWorking knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR).Ability to manage priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies and AI-enabled tools.


Preferred Qualifications

Workday certification in Recruiting; certifications in Workday HCM & other modules a plusExperience supporting recruiting ecosystem tools such as:Paradox, GoodTime (Interview Scheduling)Gem (CRM)HiredScore, Textio, BrightHire (AI/talent intelligence)Advanced Workday reporting expertise (calculated fields, matrix reports, dashboards).At least 1 year experience with Workday Onboarding and DocuSign integrations.Previous experience working in a service delivery model which includes a shared services organisationPrevious consulting experience with a consulting/software company or previous experience with a medium-to-large multinational companyPrevious experience bringing to bear Workday AI/ML features to improve outcomes in HR Operations and User ExperiencePrevious experience supporting global People processes across multiple regions (EMEA/APAC) a plus1 or more years experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude Code) to draft functional specifications, business requirements, test scripts, and training documentation. Accelerate report writing and calculated field logic design and/or 1 year of previous exposure to AI driven workflow automation/orchestration platforms or agent-building tools e.g. Sana Agent Builder, Google Agentspace, Glean, etc. (strongly preferred)Strong HR domain expertise with the ability to influence and promote leading practicesExperience building or supporting applications using Workday Extend a plus.

Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$86,800 - $150,100

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guidelines.

rows.title: Senior Director Owner Relations HUB - US & Canada
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

As the Senior Director, Owner Relations HUB (US & Canada), reporting to the Vice President, Owner Relations, you will lead Hilton's centralized Owner Relations HUB, providing strategic leadership for the teams responsible for supporting owners throughout the earliest stages of their Hilton journey.

You will oversee both the New to Hilton Owner Relations Team, supporting first-time owners from Franchise License Agreement execution through six months after hotel opening, and the Hilton Owner Support Team, supporting small ownership groups operating Hilton-branded hotels across the United States and Canada. Together, these organizations support approximately 2,000 ownership groups while delivering a consistent, scalable, and owner-centric experience that strengthens Hilton's relationships with owners and enables continued portfolio growth.

You will shape the future of Hilton's centralized owner support model by driving operational effectiveness, organizational capability, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement while developing exceptional leaders and teams.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Lead Hilton's centralized Owner Relations HUB, providing strategic and operational leadership for two Owner Relations verticals supporting approximately 2,000 ownership groups throughout the US and Canada.Establish the vision, operating model, service standards, and performance expectations for the HUB, ensuring exceptional owner experiences while delivering scalable, sustainable support.Lead a team of Directors, Senior Managers, Managers, and Analysts while building organizational capability, succession plans, and future leaders.Champion an owner-first culture that delivers proactive engagement, issue resolution, and exceptional service throughout the owner lifecycle.Drive operational excellence through process optimization, workflow improvements, automation, technology enablement, and continuous improvement initiatives.Develop scalable support frameworks for Owner Relations processes, including owner onboarding, issue resolution, ownership transitions, enterprise programs i.e. Hilton RISE, franchise fee inquiries, and enterprise initiatives.Establish key performance indicators, governance, and executive reporting that measure owner satisfaction, operational performance, service quality, and organizational effectiveness.Use owner feedback, operational metrics, and business insights to identify opportunities, improve service delivery, and influence enterprise priorities.Ensure seamless transitions between the New to Hilton Owner Relations Team and the Hilton Owner Support Team, creating a consistent experience throughout the owner lifecycle.Be the executive point of escalation for complex owner issues requiring enterprise coordination and executive visibility.Lead strategic initiatives that improve the scalability, consistency, and effectiveness of Owner Relations HUB Operations while supporting Hilton's continued growth.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Partner with Owner Relations field leadership to ensure seamless collaboration between centralized and regional owner support teams.Build trusted relationships with ownership groups, management companies, and above-property stakeholders throughout the United States and Canada.Collaborate with Development, Hotel Openings, Commercial Services, Revenue Management, Distribution, Brands, Brand Management, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, AD&C/PIPs, and Customer Experience teams to deliver exceptional owner support.Represent the voice of Hilton owners across enterprise initiatives, ensuring owner needs are incorporated into strategic decisions and operational improvements.Partner with senior leadership to develop long-term strategies that strengthen owner engagement, improve operational efficiency, and support Hilton's growth objectives.

Projects You'll Take Ownership Of

Leadership and continued evolution of Hilton's centralized Owner Relations HUB Operations model.Strategic oversight of two Owner Relations verticals supporting approximately 2,000 ownership groups across the United States and Canada.Develop and execute long-term strategies that improve owner satisfaction, operational excellence, and scalable service delivery.Organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership development across the HUB organization with the team you will manage.Enterprise initiatives supporting new owner onboarding, ownership transitions, QA/RISE coordination, owner communications, and operational improvements.Executive reporting, dashboards, and analytics that measure owner experience, operational performance, service quality, and business outcomes.Process improvement initiatives that leverage technology, automation, and best practices to simplify owner interactions and improve organizational efficiency.Governance and operational readiness that supports Hilton's expanding owner community and development pipeline.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

Ten (10) years of progressive professional experience in hospitality, franchise operations, owner relations, commercial strategy, customer success, operations, or related business functionsSeven (7) years of leadership experience, including leading leaders within a complex, matrixed organizationDemonstrated experience leading operational transformation, organizational change, or enterprise-wide process improvement initiativesExperience using operational data, analytics, and business insights to guide decision-makingExperience managing complex cross-functional initiatives across multiple partnersTravel up to 20%

It Would Be Useful If You Have

Experience in Owner Relations, Franchise Support, Hotel Operations, Commercial Services, or Brand PerformanceExperience leading centralized or shared-services organizationsKnowledge of hotel ownership structures, franchise operations, hotel development, and owner lifecycle managementExperience implementing Salesforce, workflow automation, AI-enabled support tools, or enterprise technology solutionsFamiliarity with hospitality performance metrics, including operations and commercial metrics (i.e., Stay Scores, RSI, CoStar, QA, RISE Reporting, owner Return on investment, and operational performance indicators)Master's Degree or MBA

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters mostHealth & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family coveredFinancial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's nextBenefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $145,000 – $210,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, and the Company's long-term incentive plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

rows.title: Tech Principal Product Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team responsible for delivering technology capabilities that modernize and optimize Williams-Sonoma's end-to-end supply chain. The team partners closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Technology to deliver scalable product capabilities that improve operational efficiency, inventory productivity, manufacturing performance, and customer experience. You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team that is responsible for continuous improvement of our supply chain by focusing on removing friction points for our internal and external customers by delivering a highly satisfying experience.

About The Role

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is in the business of enhancing the quality of our customers' lives at home. This critical Principal Product Manager role owns the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Williams-Sonoma's Manufacturing technology domain, supporting our in-house furniture and lighting manufacturing operations. This leader will define and deliver capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, production execution, inventory visibility, quality, scheduling, materials management, shop floor operations, and fulfillment while enabling scalable growth across our manufacturing network. This role operates across strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network. The right candidate will have deep experience with discrete manufacturing as well as the associated logistics and transportation activities and a techno-functional / Product Management background.

Responsibilities


 This role operates across product strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to modernize manufacturing capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network.  Own the Manufacturing product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities, identifying opportunities through customer insights, operational data, and hypothesis-driven product discovery focused on measurable business outcomes.  Monitor emerging manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, AI, and digital manufacturing trends, evaluating new technologies and industry practices that can improve Williams-Sonoma's competitive advantage.  Define product success metrics and measurement plans tied to manufacturing efficiency, production throughput, inventory accuracy, schedule adherence, quality, operational productivity, adoption, and business value realization. Continuously measure outcomes to guide product investment decisions and optimization.  Lead product discovery, business process analysis, and solution definition for manufacturing capabilities, translating business needs into product strategy, roadmaps, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized Jira backlogs that enable iterative Agile delivery.  Identify, prioritize, and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, shop floor productivity, quality, scheduling, operational efficiency, and business decision making while leveraging generative AI to improve product discovery, requirements quality, documentation, and team productivity.  Serve as the primary product leader across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Architecture, and Technology teams, aligning stakeholders around product vision, priorities, delivery, and measurable business value.  Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver iterative product capabilities using Agile methodologies while balancing business value, technical debt, scalability, and long-term platform health.  Serve as the manufacturing product subject matter expert, leading cross-functional exploration, making informed product recommendations, and communicating roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to business partners and senior Technology leadership.  Lead organizational readiness and product adoption activities, including stakeholder alignment, business process design, SOP documentation, training, UAT, hyper-care, and adoption measurement.  Ensure manufacturing solutions meet governance, security, audit, licensing, and compliance requirements while partnering with Internal Audit and Technology teams to establish appropriate operational controls. 


Criteria


 10 years of Product Management or techno-functional experience supporting Manufacturing, Supply Chain, ERP, or related enterprise technology platforms.  Experience with discrete manufacturing, configurable products, production planning, bills of material, routings, work centers, capacity planning, quality management, and manufacturing execution preferred.  Demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, drive executive alignment, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively across executive, operational, and technical audiences without direct authority.  Deep understanding of Microsoft Dynamics AX/Dynamics 365 Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management, Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement, Warehouse Management, and related manufacturing processes.  Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, and execution for complex enterprise platforms supporting manufacturing or supply chain operations.  Own the product lifecycle from discovery through adoption, continuously measuring business outcomes and incorporating customer feedback into future roadmap priorities.  Experience applying AI, generative AI, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics to improve manufacturing operations, product management practices, or business processes. Demonstrated ability to identify and deliver AI-enabled business capabilities.  Experience with related supply chain operations, order management, eCommerce and finance / accounting processes.  Experience leading large-scale business transformation initiatives from product discovery through implementation, including business process redesign, organizational change management, UAT, training, and production adoption.  Experience with the process of configurable products as they flow from the eCommerce customer’s orders through order management (OMS) and to Dynamics 365 for manufacturing and order fulfillment.  You have a proven ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, manage difficult tradeoffs, and evaluate new ideas with partners across the organization.  Experience in a large, multi-brand business preferred. Consulting experience is also desirable.  Experience creating and managing product backlogs, including writing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work within Jira for Agile software delivery.  Strong communication and negotiation skills and the ability to lead and influence others.  Bachelor's degree or more in Engineering, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent work experience.  This role requires being onsite in the WSI manufacturing Claremont, North Carolina office Monday through Thursday.  Some travel will be required to other WSI manufacturing and supply chain locations within the United States. (Manufacturing: Claremont, NC; Tupelo, MS; Portland, OR) 


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration). 

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance. 

 Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances. 

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

$81,120 - $135,120Annually*

Job Description
Be part of an amazing story
Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. They support Product Management, User Experience, & Technology teams with reporting and analysis, delivering crucial business intelligence. The analyst presents actionable insights to aid decision-makers and assists Macys.com’s A/B and multivariate testing programs. This involves designing and analyzing experiments in collaboration with internal clients like Marketing and Merchandising, as well as technology partners. The role requires multitasking through various project stages and delivering quality insights and recommendations regularly to drive business growth. Other duties as assigned.

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate problem solvers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to compose economic opportunity for all.

The Role

People are at the center of everything we do. The People Technology Solutions team (within our People Operations organization) supports the enabling technology foundation for candidate and employee experience at eBay. Our ecosystem is anchored in Workday HCM and complemented by outstanding SaaS platforms, custom applications, analytics, and next-generation technology innovations.

We are looking for a product-minded Senior People Technology Analyst to help build and expand eBay's People Team technology ecosystem. This role will partner closely with Global Payroll, People Operations, Finance, IT, Security, and external payroll vendors to understand business needs, define product priorities, and deliver scalable technology solutions that improve payroll operations, compliance, data quality, and employee experience.

While Workday and Payroll integrations form a core part of this role, the scope includes more than just Workday configuration. The successful candidate will approach payroll technology holistically, encompassing integrations, middleware, workflow automation, AI-enhanced capabilities, custom applications, reporting, and user experience. This person will support the transformation of payroll strategy into scalable technology solutions while continuously advancing operational efficiency and enabling future innovation.

This individual contributor opportunity involves a hybrid work format with presence expected at our Salt Lake City or Austin office. The role requires being onsite three days each week at one of these offices. Flexibility in working hours is also necessary to accommodate global teamwork as needed.

What You'll Do

Act as a product-focused technology collaborator for eBay's People and Payroll technology ecosystem, with Workday HCM functioning as the system of record.Contribute to the payroll technology roadmap by balancing business priorities, operational requirements, user experience, compliance, and technical feasibility.Collaborate with Global Payroll, People Operations, Finance, IT, Security, and external payroll vendors to understand business needs, define requirements, prioritize improvements, and deliver scalable solutions.Lead technology initiatives supporting payroll processes, including: Payroll vendor integrations, API Employee data interfaces Time and attendance integrations


Benefits And Compensation Data Flows

Tax and compliance interfaces

Banking and payment integrations

Year-end payroll technology readiness

Collaborate with IT integration teams and external vendors to build, develop, test, and support secure, reliable, and scalable integrations between Workday and payroll providers.Translate business and technical requirements into user stories, business process flows, solution builds, business rules, success metrics, and implementation plans.Partner with technical teams to build and support APIs, Workday web services, middleware solutions, and integration frameworks.See chances to improve operation processes using automation, AI, and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Workday Developer Agent, Sana Agent Builder, Workday Extend or similar technologies).Contribute to building custom applications through Workday Extend in cases where specialized payroll or People Operations solutions are necessary.Develop reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and data validations that improve People Team accuracy, operational visibility, and decision making.Provide production support, troubleshoot integration issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement scalable corrective actions.Support releases, regression testing, deployment planning, and post-production validation activities.Partner with IT and Security to ensure integrations and payroll solutions meet enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and governance standards.Support change management, communications, documentation, training, and adoption for new payroll technology capabilities.Take part in internal audits, SOX controls, data privacy assessments, and compliance-related documentation.Maintain functional and technical documentation including requirements, solution builds, process maps, test scripts, release notes, support documentation, and integration inventories.Stay informed about Workday advancements, payroll technology developments, AI functionalities, integration methods, and new HR technology options, evaluating their relevance to eBay's People technology ecosystem.


What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Human Resources, Business, or equivalent experience.3–5 years of hands-on HRIS, payroll technology, enterprise applications, or related experience.3+ years of experience supporting Workday HCM, including experience with payroll-related business processes, integrations, or configuration.Experience partnering with payroll vendors and multi-functional technology teams to deliver integration and system improvements.Solid understanding of payroll processes, employee master data, and HR and Payroll integrations.Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into scalable technical solutions.Experience assisting with enterprise integrations, APIs, middleware, Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Workday web services, or similar integration technologies.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, able to pinpoint root causes and propose scalable improvements.Strong collaborator management and communication abilities with the capacity to convey technical ideas to non-technical audiences.Practical understanding of payroll regulations, SOX controls, data privacy, and information security considerations.Ability to prioritize multiple tasks independently in a fast-paced global environment.Up to date on emerging AI trends in HR technology and capable of evaluating their relevance within eBay's People technology ecosystem.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience assisting global payroll processes across various countries and regions.Experience working with enterprise payroll providers such as Dayforce, Safeguard Global, Deel or similar global payroll platforms.Familiarity with Workday Payroll, Payroll Interface, Cloud Connect, Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Workday APIs, or Workday Orchestrate.Experience developing or maintaining applications using Workday Extend.Experience with Workday reporting, calculated fields, dashboards, composite reports, and Prism Analytics.Previous experience demonstrating AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency, documentation, issue resolution, testing, workflow automation, or employee self-service.1 or more years experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude Code) to draft functional specifications, business requirements, integration documentation, test scripts, release notes, training materials, and crafting user documentation.Experience with workflow automation or platforms for building agents (e.g., Sana Agent Builder, Glean, or similar technologies) is strongly preferred.Experience supporting global People Operations across several regions (EMEA/APAC/LATAM) is strongly preferred.

$86,800 - $150,100

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). rows.title: Sr HRIS Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

The HR Technology & Analytics team modernizes how HR works across Williams-Sonoma, Inc. We combine reliable enterprise systems, trusted workforce data and practical digital innovation to make HR services simpler, faster and more insightful for associates, managers and HR partners. We collaborate closely with HR, Corporate Systems, Information Security, Legal, Finance and vendors to turn business needs into scalable solutions.

About The Role

The Senior HR Technology Analyst sits at the intersection of HR operations, workforce data and digital innovation. You will serve as a functional and data steward for the company's enterprise HCM platform, currently Oracle HCM, and a portfolio of connected HR applications. You will lead system projects, releases, data management, reporting and production support while helping shape the future HR technology roadmap through platform evaluation, AI, digital assistants and workflow automation. This is an opportunity to improve the systems HR relies on today while influencing how the technology ecosystem evolves next.

What You Will Do


  Own enterprise HCM data and functional operations. Serve as a functional and data steward for the company's enterprise HCM platform, currently Oracle HCM. Manage workforce structures, position and organization data, store and location setup, user access and related processes while maintaining data integrity, documentation and controls.  Lead HR technology projects from idea to adoption. Drive enhancements, releases and cross-functional initiatives through intake, prioritization, requirements, process design, testing, implementation, stabilization and change adoption in partnership with HR, Corporate Systems and vendors.  Strengthen HR data operations and system reliability. Oversee recurring and mass data activities, interfaces, audits, certifications and production support; reconcile data, resolve complex issues and improve work through standardization, stronger controls and automation.  Turn workforce data into actionable insight. Deliver government, compensation, operational and ad hoc reporting; create and maintain practical Power BI dashboards; and help leaders understand trends, risks and opportunities.  Shape the future of HR through AI and automation. Own and improve digital assistants and knowledge experiences, identify high-value use cases, research emerging capabilities, lead pilots, automate workflows, monitor quality and adoption, and establish responsible practices for privacy, security, accuracy and human oversight.  Expand and evolve the connected HR technology ecosystem. Support electronic I-9, organization charting, digital records and other HR applications while contributing to technology roadmaps, vendor and platform evaluations, integrations, implementation planning and transition-readiness activities.


What You Will Bring


  Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, Analytics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.  Five or more years of progressive experience in HR technology, HRIS, HR data, people analytics or a related function.  Experience supporting a major enterprise HCM platform, with strength in HR data management, system enhancements, testing and production support. Oracle HCM preferred.  Demonstrated project management and business analysis skills, including the ability to translate business needs into requirements and move complex work through implementation and adoption.  Strong reporting and analytical skills using Excel and HCM reporting tools, plus working knowledge of Power BI and the ability to reconcile data across systems.  A collaborative, improvement-oriented mindset, with strong communication, sound judgment and an interest in applying AI and automation to real HR challenges while protecting confidential employee data.


Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits Tax-free commuter benefits A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-development Advisor (Mentor) program Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series


WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

rows.title: Tech Principal Product Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team responsible for delivering technology capabilities that modernize and optimize Williams-Sonoma's end-to-end supply chain. The team partners closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Technology to deliver scalable product capabilities that improve operational efficiency, inventory productivity, manufacturing performance, and customer experience. You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team that is responsible for continuous improvement of our supply chain by focusing on removing friction points for our internal and external customers by delivering a highly satisfying experience.

About The Role

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is in the business of enhancing the quality of our customers' lives at home. This critical Principal Product Manager role owns the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Williams-Sonoma's Manufacturing technology domain, supporting our in-house furniture and lighting manufacturing operations. This leader will define and deliver capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, production execution, inventory visibility, quality, scheduling, materials management, shop floor operations, and fulfillment while enabling scalable growth across our manufacturing network. This role operates across strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network. The right candidate will have deep experience with discrete manufacturing as well as the associated logistics and transportation activities and a techno-functional / Product Management background.

Responsibilities


 This role operates across product strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to modernize manufacturing capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network.  Own the Manufacturing product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities, identifying opportunities through customer insights, operational data, and hypothesis-driven product discovery focused on measurable business outcomes.  Monitor emerging manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, AI, and digital manufacturing trends, evaluating new technologies and industry practices that can improve Williams-Sonoma's competitive advantage.  Define product success metrics and measurement plans tied to manufacturing efficiency, production throughput, inventory accuracy, schedule adherence, quality, operational productivity, adoption, and business value realization. Continuously measure outcomes to guide product investment decisions and optimization.  Lead product discovery, business process analysis, and solution definition for manufacturing capabilities, translating business needs into product strategy, roadmaps, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized Jira backlogs that enable iterative Agile delivery.  Identify, prioritize, and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, shop floor productivity, quality, scheduling, operational efficiency, and business decision making while leveraging generative AI to improve product discovery, requirements quality, documentation, and team productivity.  Serve as the primary product leader across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Architecture, and Technology teams, aligning stakeholders around product vision, priorities, delivery, and measurable business value.  Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver iterative product capabilities using Agile methodologies while balancing business value, technical debt, scalability, and long-term platform health.  Serve as the manufacturing product subject matter expert, leading cross-functional exploration, making informed product recommendations, and communicating roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to business partners and senior Technology leadership.  Lead organizational readiness and product adoption activities, including stakeholder alignment, business process design, SOP documentation, training, UAT, hyper-care, and adoption measurement.  Ensure manufacturing solutions meet governance, security, audit, licensing, and compliance requirements while partnering with Internal Audit and Technology teams to establish appropriate operational controls. 


Criteria


 10 years of Product Management or techno-functional experience supporting Manufacturing, Supply Chain, ERP, or related enterprise technology platforms.  Experience with discrete manufacturing, configurable products, production planning, bills of material, routings, work centers, capacity planning, quality management, and manufacturing execution preferred.  Demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, drive executive alignment, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively across executive, operational, and technical audiences without direct authority.  Deep understanding of Microsoft Dynamics AX/Dynamics 365 Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management, Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement, Warehouse Management, and related manufacturing processes.  Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, and execution for complex enterprise platforms supporting manufacturing or supply chain operations.  Own the product lifecycle from discovery through adoption, continuously measuring business outcomes and incorporating customer feedback into future roadmap priorities.  Experience applying AI, generative AI, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics to improve manufacturing operations, product management practices, or business processes. Demonstrated ability to identify and deliver AI-enabled business capabilities.  Experience with related supply chain operations, order management, eCommerce and finance / accounting processes.  Experience leading large-scale business transformation initiatives from product discovery through implementation, including business process redesign, organizational change management, UAT, training, and production adoption.  Experience with the process of configurable products as they flow from the eCommerce customer’s orders through order management (OMS) and to Dynamics 365 for manufacturing and order fulfillment.  You have a proven ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, manage difficult tradeoffs, and evaluate new ideas with partners across the organization.  Experience in a large, multi-brand business preferred. Consulting experience is also desirable.  Experience creating and managing product backlogs, including writing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work within Jira for Agile software delivery.  Strong communication and negotiation skills and the ability to lead and influence others.  Bachelor's degree or more in Engineering, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent work experience.  This role requires being onsite in the WSI manufacturing Claremont, North Carolina office Monday through Thursday.  Some travel will be required to other WSI manufacturing and supply chain locations within the United States. (Manufacturing: Claremont, NC; Tupelo, MS; Portland, OR) 


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration). 

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance. 

 Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances. 

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

Job Description

About the Team

Our Internal Audit team plays a strategic role in helping the business navigate risk while enabling growth and innovation. Working across global operations with colleagues based throughout the U.S. and Singapore, we bring diverse perspectives and deep expertise to deliver independent assurance, practical insights, and meaningful improvements across technology, finance, operations, and compliance.

About The Role

Technology is transforming every aspect of our business—from cloud computing and AI to digital commerce and cybersecurity. As Senior Manager, Technology Risk - Audit and Assurance , you will play a critical role in providing independent assurance over the company's technology risks, governance, and control environment while helping strengthen confidence in how technology enables our business.

Reporting to the VP of SOX & Internal Audit, you will lead our Technology Risk & Assurance program, including oversight of our global IT SOX program and risk-based technology assurance activities across modern technology environments. This role combines deep technical expertise with sound business judgment to evaluate technology risks, assess the effectiveness of controls, and provide meaningful insights that support executive leadership and the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors.

More than a traditional audit role, this position offers the opportunity to influence how technology risk is understood and managed across the organization. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Information Security, Product, Enterprise Technology, Finance, and external auditors to provide independent perspectives that strengthen governance while supporting innovation and business objectives.

We're looking for a collaborative leader who is intellectually curious, energized by emerging technologies, and passionate about continuously improving how assurance is delivered through automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Provide independent, pragmatic recommendations that balance risk management with business objectives.  Monitor emerging technology, cybersecurity, regulatory, and AI-related risks and incorporate them into assurance activities.  Translate technical findings into clear business insights for executive leadership and the Audit Committee.

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson is recruiting for a Quality & Compliance (Q&C) End-to-End (E2E) Distribution Excellence Lead to be located in Coppell Texas.

About MedTech

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

The Quality & Compliance (Q&C) End-to-End (E2E) Distribution Excellence lead supports the identification, development and execution of end-to-end distribution quality and compliance programs at the major MedTech distribution hubs. This role drives priorities from strategy through implementation by partnering closely with Distribution Hubs, Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Commercial, Transportation, and other collaborators to align work, remove barriers, and deliver distribution excellence outcomes.

This role exists to provide dedicated execution leadership for complex, end-to-end distribution quality and compliance priorities that require cross-site coordination, clear ownership, rapid issue resolution, and consistent follow-through to protect market supply, improve distribution reliability, and support service to customers and patients across all product platforms managed in the main distribution hubs. Supports all MedTech businesses.

The role reports directly into the Q&C E2E Distribution Excellence Director.

Key Responsibilities

In accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws/regulations and Corporate Johnson & Johnson, procedures and guidelines, this position will:

Implement distribution quality improvement initiatives and programs that improve quality, compliance, cost, service, and supply continuity, with clear achievements, owners, and performance measures.Support a structured governance to advance program execution, support portfolio reviews, prioritize risks, resolve issues, and enable timely leadership decisions to ensures execution subject area across scope, schedule, cost, and quality.Develop or support cases for improvement initiatives; track delivery progress, lead risks and dependencies, and ensure completion within defined scope, timing, budget, and quality expectations.Support cross-site/functional collaborator alignment to accelerate delivery, remove barriers, resolve execution gaps, ensuring priorities are coordinated across distribution centers, Quality, Supply Chain, and project teams.Own resolution management for events that may impact market supply, customer service, product availability, quality, or compliance by coordinating issue, driving containment follow-up, aligning root cause actions, tracking closure, and communicating status to collaborators.Lead or support deployment and implementation of selected quality programs.Analyze end-to-end distribution performance to recommend and implement improvement initiatives for the major distribution hubs (MLC & CDC, EDC, RDC and others as required).Design, develop, deliver and sustain data-driven process improvements, digital tools, automated solutions, reports, and dashboards that improve visibility, strengthen execution, support business requirements, and communicate findings to collaborators.Provide analytics and insights to support recommendations, cases, and execution plans, including investment trade-off analysis, value realization tracking, service and compliance metrics, and portfolio performance insights.Enables clarity through clear, data-driven reporting and insights.Responsible for communicating business-related issues or opportunities to next management levelResponsible for following all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices as applicable.Responsible for ensuring personal and Company compliance with all Federal, State, local and Company regulations, policies, and procedures. Performs other duties assigned as needed

Qualifications/Requirements

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Information Technology, Data Science or, or a related technical field.Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality, Engineering, or Compliance within a regulated industry (e.g., medical devices, pharmaceuticals, healthcare).Working knowledge of quality management systems and applicable regulatory standards, including FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, and related global requirements.Strong communication, collaboration, decision-making, analytical thinking, problem-solving, prioritization, and partner management skills.Cross-functional team leadership.Strong communication, collaboration, decision-making, analytical thinking, problem-solving, prioritization, and collaborator management and alignment and influencing skills.

Preferred

Experience developing data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).Lean, six sigma and process excellence tools/methodologies.Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools required; experience with ERP systems, warehouse management systems, Minitab, Microsoft Project, or quality management platforms.Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.Ability to perform duties in accordance with policies and procedures and in to comply civil rights requirements.

Other

Proficiency (oral & written) in the English language is required.20% Domestic Travel percentage is required.Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position. Relocation support may be provided for qualified candidates in accordance with company policy.

Job Description

We are searching for the best talent for Senior Director, Global AI Fluency to be in Raritan, NJ

About Innovative Medicine

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

Purpose

The Senior Director, Global AI Fluency defines and leads the global AI fluency strategy for the Global Commercial Strategy Organization. This role is accountable for establishing the enterprise capability agenda, operating model, adoption priorities, and governance approach required for commercial teams to use artificial intelligence responsibly, effectively, and at scale. The Senior Director sets strategy for and oversees the design, delivery, and scaling of practical AI learning experiences, adoption interventions, and workflow integration that accelerate AI-enabled commercial transformation.

This leader will establish a globally consistent capability framework while enabling appropriate regional and functional adaptation across commercial, medical, market access, and related functions. The role will translate advances in generative AI, agentic AI, and digital productivity into role-based learning journeys, priority workflow adoption, measurable business outcomes, and sustained changes in ways of working.

The Senior Director will partner closely with GCSO leadership, regional business teams, Human Resources, J&J Learning and Development, Technology, Legal, Privacy, Healthcare Compliance, Information Security, and enterprise AI governance teams. This leader will influence executive stakeholders and connect across the J&J ecosystem, including R&D Data Science, regional AI teams, regional Learning and Development teams, and technology development teams that are building related capabilities.

The Senior Director, Global AI Fluency will develop and steward the AI fluency budget for GCSO and own recommendations for investment prioritization, resource allocation, vendor engagement, scale-up decisions, and value/ROI measurement across GCSO.

This leader will report into the VP, AI Strategy and Execution within the Global Commercial Data and AI department in GCSO.

You Will Be Responsible For

Define and lead the global AI fluency strategy and multi-year roadmap for GCSO. Establish the enterprise capability framework, proficiency standards, strategic priorities, operating model, governance approach, and adoption objectives that enable responsible AI use and AI-driven commercial transformation.Design and scale the AI fluency capability ecosystem, including role-based learning journeys, certifications, academies, immersive experiences, leadership programs, communities of practice, and enterprise adoption infrastructure covering AI literacy, responsible use, prompt practices, generative AI, agentic AI, and human-AI collaboration.Drive enterprise adoption and change management by partnering with business leaders to identify priority workflows, address barriers, embed AI into everyday work, and sustain behavior change through clear accountabilities and reinforcement mechanisms. Ensure AI fluency efforts translate into measurable productivity, commercial effectiveness, operating model, employee experience, and responsible AI outcomes.Establish governance, measurement, and executive reporting for AI fluency. Define proficiency assessments, adoption measures, program effectiveness indicators, and business outcome metrics aligned with responsible AI, privacy, security, healthcare compliance, and enterprise risk requirements.Build and manage strategic relationships with internal and external partners, including technology providers, learning partners, academic institutions, industry organizations, and enterprise AI stakeholders, to bring relevant innovation, leading practices, and scalable solutions into GCSO.Represent GCSO in relevant enterprise AI capability, learning, and development forums. Sponsor experimentation that validate new learning methods and AI-enabled ways of working before broader scale-up. Maintain awareness of external developments in AI, learning science, organizational transformation, and the evolving regulatory environment. 

Qualifications / Requirements

Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in business, organizational psychology, learning sciences, data science, artificial intelligence, technology management, or a related field preferred.Experience leading global, enterprise-scale transformation, digital/AI adoption, capability building, and change management in complex, regulated, matrixed environments is required.Strong understanding of generative AI, agentic AI, digital productivity tools, enterprise adoption models, and responsible AI principles.Ability to translate emerging technology into practical, role-based adoption strategies, executive-ready recommendations, and measurable business value.Experience developing global capability frameworks, learning strategies, change plans, governance models, and adoption measurement approaches.Demonstrated executive influence, facilitation, and communication skills, including the ability to frame trade-offs, align senior stakeholders, and drive enterprise decisions.Experience influencing executive stakeholders, shaping investment recommendations, and governing enterprise programs with measurable business impact.Ability to lead across functions, regions, cultures, and time zones in a highly matrixed environment while balancing global consistency with local relevance.Strong analytical, program management, portfolio prioritization, and budget stewardship skills.Commitment to inclusive leadership, and ethical, compliant application of AI. 

Other

This position will require up to 20% domestic and international travel.

We are Bloomberg Enterprise Data - fast paced, innovative, and growing. We partner closely with our clients to understand their businesses, data requirements, and financial technology needs. Corporations are a strategic growth segment for Enterprise Data. Corporate treasury, capital markets, investor relations, and finance teams increasingly rely on high-quality market and reference data to manage funding, hedging, benchmarking, and reporting.

We are seeking a Product Manager to grow Bloomberg’s Enterprise Data business within the corporations segment. Unlike asset-class roles, this position is defined by its target client: you will develop deep understanding of corporate workflows and build data products that serve corporate treasurers, capital markets and investor relations teams, and finance functions.

We’ll Trust You To

 Define the segment strategy and product roadmap for corporations, identifying the data products and use cases with the greatest commercial potential. Develop deep understanding of corporate workflows — treasury and cash management, funding and debt issuance, FX and rates hedging, peer and credit benchmarking, investor relations, and regulatory and ESG reporting. Map corporate data needs to Bloomberg’s data estate across pricing, reference, credit, and ESG, and define solutions that fit corporate delivery and consumption models. Partner with corporate clients to understand their challenges and validate product direction. Work with Sales and Marketing to build segment awareness, drive adoption, and attain commercial outcomes. Manage product specification, prioritisation, and backlog through an agile process across Data, Engineering, and Client Solutions.

 5+* years in product management, or equivalent, within financial data, analytics, banking, or corporate finance. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don't miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Product Development and Operations Functional Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth and Transformation on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team, you will be responsible for...

Supporting product development and engineering transformation initiatives by gathering business requirements and translating them into functional requirements and user storiesDefining and improving product lifecycle and application lifecycle management use cases, including bill of materials management, engineering change control, requirements management, document management, code management, version control, software lifecycle management, and product configurationSupporting process design, data model design, and functional design documentation for product lifecycle management and application lifecycle management capabilitiesCollaborating with technical teams and client stakeholders to support integrations across computer-aided design systems, coding platforms, enterprise resource planning systems, and manufacturing systemsParticipating in testing, deployment, post-go-live support, training development, and user adoption activities while contributing to project delivery timelines and client communications

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanorAbility to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

You will work with engineering, R&D, product management, supply chain and manufacturing teams to improve speed to market, product quality, collaboration, and lifecycle visibility, while helping implement and optimize technology enabled solutions.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Product Design, or a technical field5+ years of experience in product development, product management, new product introduction, manufacturing operations, product costing, design for value, complexity reduction, product commercialization, or software development lifecycle managementExperience with end-to-end product lifecycle processes, including design, release, change, and configuration, or application lifecycle management processesExperience working in or with engineering or research and development environmentsAbility to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Experience with product lifecycle management or engineering data management systemsExperience designing and implementing product lifecycle management and application lifecycle management processes and data modelsExperience in Aerospace & Defense, Automotive, Consumer, Industrial Manufacturing, Life Sciences, or High TechExperience with product lifecycle management and application lifecycle management platforms, including Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill, Dassault ENOVIA, SAP PLM, Siemens Polarion, PTC Codebeamer, Jama Software, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or JiraExperience with design for value, parametric cost modeling, or modular configurable product designExperience with software-defined products, software development lifecycle optimization, virtual simulation-driven testing, systems engineering, or artificial intelligence-enabled product development capabilities

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
